66327.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片（B）幾乎全為核圓、染色質細緻、細胞質深藍且帶空泡的原紅血球（proerythroblast）樣細胞；切片（C）呈高度細胞密集的片狀浸潤，CD71（D）與 E-cadherin（E）膜染色陽性證實為紅血球系，符合急性紅血球白血病（pure erythroid leukemia）。
features: Panel A: peripheral blood with rare atypical blasts showing deeply basophilic cytoplasm, one large with a blue cytoplasmic rim
Panel B: hypercellular aspirate dominated by immature erythroid precursors with round nuclei, fine chromatin, nucleoli and intensely basophilic, occasionally vacuolated cytoplasm
Panel B: few maturing normoblasts and scant granulocytic elements
Panel C: hypercellular core biopsy with sheets of immature cells and scattered hemoglobinized erythroid cells
Panels D-E: many cells with membranous CD71 and E-cadherin positivity, confirming erythroid lineage
66327.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows rare circulating blasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm. The bone marrow aspirate is markedly cellular and dominated by immature erythroid precursors, many proerythroblast-like, with round nuclei, fine chromatin, nucleoli and intensely basophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm, accompanied by few maturing normoblasts and reduced granulopoiesis. The core biopsy is hypercellular with sheets of immature cells that express CD71 and E-cadherin by immunohistochemistry. Findings are consistent with acute erythroid leukemia; in a child, NUP98 rearrangement testing is warranted.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic erythroid hyperplasia shows full maturation with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and hypersegmented neutrophils, whereas AEL has a predominance (at least 30%) of proerythroblasts and corrects neither with B12 nor folate.
Megakaryoblasts can also have basophilic blebbed cytoplasm but are CD41/CD61 positive and CD71/E-cadherin negative.

ddx.dx: Parvovirus B19 giant pronormoblasts / erythroid recovery
ddx.vs: Parvovirus shows scattered giant pronormoblasts with intranuclear inclusions amid erythroid aplasia rather than sheets of proerythroblasts.

ddx.dx: Small round blue cell tumor (e.g., neuroblastoma, rhabdomyosarcoma)
ddx.vs: Metastatic tumors in children are CD71/E-cadherin negative and form cohesive clusters with lineage-specific markers.

66199.recognize_zh: 中央一顆巨大的前紅血球母細胞（giant pronormoblast），直徑數倍於旁邊的嗜中性球，核大而圓、染色質細緻，細胞質深藍色並在邊緣有多個小泡狀突起（cytoplasmic blebs，「狗耳」樣）；此為小病毒 B19 感染造成純紅血球再生不良的典型線索。
features: Giant erythroid precursor, several times the diameter of the adjacent neutrophil
Large round nucleus with finely granular dispersed chromatin occupying most of the cell; nucleoli indistinct
Narrow rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear pale zone
Multiple small basophilic cytoplasmic blebs projecting from the cell surface (dog-ear-like pseudopods)
Paucicellular surrounding field with a neutrophil, a small dense round cell and scattered red cells; no maturing erythroid precursors nearby
66199.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a paucicellular field containing a giant pronormoblast, several times the size of an adjacent neutrophil. The cell has a large round nucleus with finely dispersed chromatin, indistinct nucleoli and a rim of deeply basophilic cytoplasm with multiple peripheral cytoplasmic blebs. Maturing erythroid precursors are not seen in this field, although a single field cannot establish erythroid hypoplasia. Findings are suggestive of parvovirus B19 infection, as confirmed serologically in this patient, and correlation with reticulocyte count and parvovirus PCR is recommended.

ddx.vs: Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of more than 80% erythroid precursors with at least 30% proerythroblasts, TP53 alterations and dysplasia, rather than isolated giant pronormoblasts in a hypocellular erythroid series.
Megaloblastic proerythroblasts are accompanied by abundant maturing megaloblasts with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant myeloid forms.
Megakaryoblasts also show cytoplasmic blebs but are smaller, may shed platelets and express CD41/CD61 rather than E-cadherin or glycophorin.
Tumor cells usually cluster, show prominent nucleoli and irregular nuclei, and lack the deeply basophilic erythroid cytoplasm with perinuclear halo.

exam.answer_en: Parvovirus B19 infection — giant pronormoblast with fine chromatin, deeply basophilic cytoplasm and dog-ear cytoplasmic blebs
pearls_zh: 考法：指巨大紅血球前驅細胞問名稱與病因；答 giant pronormoblast，Parvovirus B19。
機轉：B19 以 P antigen（globoside）為受體，感染並破壞紅血球前驅細胞，造成暫時性紅血球生成停止；網狀紅血球極低。
臨床情境：慢性溶血病人（如 hereditary spherocytosis、sickle cell）發生 transient aplastic crisis；免疫低下者為慢性 pure red cell aplasia。
診斷：B19 PCR（DNA）；免疫低下者抗體反應差，serology 可能陰性。慢性 PRCA 可用 IVIG 治療。
骨髓切片可見核內病毒包涵體（lantern cell），B19 IHC 可確認。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易被誤認為 pure erythroid leukemia 或 megakaryoblast；PEL 為大片紅血球前驅細胞且多有 TP53 異常，此處為紅血球系減少中出現零星巨大前母細胞。

quiz.q: 此巨大細胞稱為什麼？最可能的病因與其細胞受體為何？
quiz.a: Giant pronormoblast；Parvovirus B19，受體為 P antigen（globoside）。

66007.recognize_zh: 兩顆成熟嗜中性球的細胞質布滿粗大、深紫色的毒性顆粒（toxic granulation），比一般嗜中性球淡粉紅的細顆粒明顯深而粗，符合嚴重感染時的毒性變化。
features: Two mature segmented neutrophils of normal size
Cytoplasm filled with coarse, dark purple-blue granules (toxic granulation) that are more prominent than normal neutrophilic granules
Nuclei with 3–5 lobes and condensed chromatin
Cytoplasmic vacuolation is subtle at most in this field; distinct Döhle bodies are not evident
Normochromic red cells with scattered platelets; no immature granulocytes in view
66007.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two segmented neutrophils with abundant coarse, dark purple cytoplasmic granules, markedly more prominent than normal secondary granules, representing toxic granulation. Cytoplasmic vacuolation is subtle in this field and distinct Döhle bodies are not clearly seen. Red cells are normochromic, and platelets are present without clumping. Findings are consistent with toxic neutrophil changes, suggestive of a systemic inflammatory response such as sepsis in the appropriate clinical setting.

ddx.vs: Alder-Reilly granules are large, dark and present in all leukocyte lineages (including lymphocytes and monocytes) in a patient with mucopolysaccharidosis, independent of infection.
Growth factor therapy causes identical toxic-appearing granulation and Döhle bodies, distinguished by the medication history and often a left shift with myelocytes.
Chédiak-Higashi shows few giant, irregular fused granules rather than numerous uniformly distributed coarse granules.
Delayed processing causes vacuolation and nuclear degeneration without coarse toxic granulation; a fresh smear resolves it.

exam.answer_en: Toxic granulation in neutrophils — coarse dark purple cytoplasmic granules, reactive to severe infection/inflammation
pearls_zh: 考法：指深紫粗顆粒問名稱；答 toxic granulation，並追問其他 toxic change：Döhle bodies、cytoplasmic vacuolation。
Toxic granules 是加速成熟下保留染色性的 primary（azurophilic）顆粒；Döhle body 為殘留的 rough ER。
Toxic vacuolation 與菌血症/敗血症關聯較強；三者合併常伴 left shift。
G-CSF 治療可產生完全相同的毒性變化，判讀前需確認用藥史。
exam.pitfall_zh: 染色過度鹼性或時間過長可讓正常顆粒變深，形似毒性顆粒；應比較同片其他嗜中性球並參考臨床。另與 Alder-Reilly anomaly 區分：後者淋巴球與單核球也有粗顆粒。

quiz.q: 圖中兩顆嗜中性球胞質的變化稱為什麼？除此之外還有哪兩種 toxic change？
quiz.a: Toxic granulation；Döhle bodies 與 toxic vacuolation。

65815.recognize_zh: 密集的白血球中有大量骨髓細胞與後骨髓細胞，並散在數顆佈滿深紫黑色顆粒的嗜鹼性球，另有少數分節嗜中性球與帶狀核；顆粒球左移合併嗜鹼性球增多，符合 CML。
features: Marked leukocytosis with myelocytes and metamyelocytes predominating
Several basophils with coarse dark purple-black granules obscuring the nucleus
Immature granulocytes with round to indented nuclei, clumped chromatin and lilac granular cytoplasm, some with small vacuoles
Bands and segmented neutrophils present; no granulocytic dysplasia
Occasional larger immature cell with finer chromatin, but blasts not obviously increased
Many background platelets; red cells normocytic
65815.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis with a left-shifted but complete granulocytic series, dominated by myelocytes and metamyelocytes, with bands and segmented neutrophils. Several basophils are present in this field, indicating absolute basophilia. Blasts are not conspicuously increased and there is no dysplasia. Platelets are abundant. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive; a formal differential count is required to exclude accelerated or blast phase.

ddx.vs: Reactive leukocytosis lacks basophilia and shows toxic changes with fewer myelocytes.
Blast phase requires 20% or more blasts or an extramedullary blast proliferation, not seen in this field.
aCML shows dysgranulopoiesis with basophils under 2%.

exam.answer_en: Chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive — myelocyte/metamyelocyte-rich leukocytosis with several basophils (absolute basophilia)
pearls_zh: 考法：單一視野出現多顆嗜鹼性球，考官會問「下一步要計算什麼」：完整分類計數的母細胞與嗜鹼性球百分比，以排除疾病進展。
Blast phase：WHO 5th 與 ICC 2022 皆以周邊血或骨髓母細胞 ≥20% 或髓外母細胞增生定義；出現淋巴母細胞增加即使 <20% 也需警覺 lymphoid blast phase。
追蹤進展時需做骨髓 karyotype 找 additional chromosomal abnormalities（如 +8、第二個 Ph、i(17q)、−7/7q−、3q26.2 重組），高風險 ACA 預後較差。
TKI 失敗時需檢測 ABL1 kinase domain 突變以選藥；blast phase 通常需 TKI 合併化療並考慮 allo-HSCT。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把稍大、染色質較細的未成熟細胞當成母細胞增加而誤判進展：CML 中 promyelocyte 與 myelocyte 常見，母細胞需以完整計數判定，不能以單一視野下結論。

quiz.q: CML 病人若周邊血母細胞達多少百分比即定義為 blast phase？
quiz.a: ≥20%（WHO 5th 與 ICC 2022）

65623.recognize_zh: MPO 免疫染色下，骨小樑旁排成厚帶的大型細胞胞質強陽性、呈粗顆粒狀，核圓且偏位，形態像前骨髓細胞/骨髓細胞，而遠離骨小樑的區域多為 MPO 陰性小細胞、成熟分葉顆粒球稀少；符合 ELANE 先天性嚴重嗜中性球低下的前骨髓細胞階段成熟停滯。
features: MPO IHC on bone marrow trephine, higher power
Thick paratrabecular band of large MPO-positive cells with abundant coarse granular cytoplasmic staining
Positive cells have round to oval, often eccentric nuclei with visible nucleoli, resembling promyelocytes/myelocytes
Few small MPO-positive segmented neutrophils in the intertrabecular space
Intertrabecular areas composed mainly of MPO-negative small round cells (erythroid precursors/lymphocytes)
65623.describe_en: Myeloperoxidase immunostain of the bone marrow trephine highlights an expanded paratrabecular layer of large granulocytic precursors with abundant, coarsely granular MPO-positive cytoplasm and round, eccentric nuclei, morphologically corresponding to promyelocytes and early myelocytes. Mature segmented MPO-positive neutrophils are sparse in the intertrabecular spaces, which are populated predominantly by MPO-negative small cells. This pattern indicates arrested granulocytic maturation at the promyelocyte/myelocyte stage. In a child with a pathogenic ELANE variant, findings are consistent with severe congenital neutropenia; given G-CSF exposure and risk of clonal evolution, blasts should be assessed with CD34 and cytogenetic/molecular studies.

ddx.dx: Recovering marrow after chemotherapy or G-CSF effect
ddx.vs: Regenerating marrow shows a synchronized left shift that progresses to mature neutrophils on follow-up, without persistent maturation arrest or an ELANE variant.
APL shows sheets of atypical promyelocytes with Auer rods and PML::RARA replacing the marrow, rather than a paratrabecular layer with preserved erythropoiesis.

ddx.dx: Evolution to MDS/AML in severe congenital neutropenia
ddx.vs: Would show increased CD34+ blasts, dysplasia and acquired CSF3R/RUNX1 mutations or monosomy 7.
Marrow shows normal or increased granulopoiesis with maturation to band/segmented forms and antineutrophil antibodies.

65559.recognize_zh: 治療後低細胞密度骨髓中只剩小的細胞聚落，抹片僅見少數芽細胞；聚落中的非典型細胞 CD34 陰性（只染到血管內皮）、CD117 陽性，c-MYC 核強陽性，提示 CD34 陰性的 NPM1 突變 AML 殘存病灶。
features: Aspirate smear with rare large blasts showing high N:C ratio and basophilic cytoplasm among red cells (panel A)
Low-power biopsy with hypocellular marrow and a small residual cellular focus (panel B)
Higher power aggregate of immature-appearing cells with enlarged irregular nuclei in a fatty stroma (panel C)
CD34 staining restricted to endothelial cells and rare cells, with neoplastic cells negative (panel D)
Many aggregate cells CD117 positive (panel E) with strong nuclear c-MYC in a subset of atypical cells (panel F)
65559.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows rare blasts. The core biopsy is predominantly hypocellular after therapy, with small cellular aggregates composed of immature-appearing cells with enlarged irregular nuclei. By immunohistochemistry, the aggregates are negative for CD34, which highlights only endothelium, and positive for CD117, and a subset of atypical cells shows strong nuclear c-MYC staining. The CD34-negative, CD117-positive, c-MYC-positive aggregates are suspicious for residual AML; with PCR positivity for NPM1 mutation, findings are consistent with measurable residual AML with NPM1 mutation.

ddx.vs: Regenerating islands show orderly trilineage maturation with only scattered CD117+ cells and lack strong c-MYC expression in atypical cells.
Mast cells are CD117 positive but are spindled, tryptase and CD25 positive, and associated with fibrosis and eosinophils.
CD34 would highlight the aggregates, whereas NPM1-mutated AML is typically CD34 negative, requiring NPM1 PCR or cytoplasmic NPM1 immunostain.

65559.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD34, CD117, c-MYC

65239.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中可見深藍細胞質的嗜鹼性紅血球母細胞與顆粒球前驅細胞，其中數顆細胞的細胞質或覆蓋於核上出現多個圓形打孔狀透明空泡（punched-out vacuoles），是 VEXAS 前驅細胞空泡的典型表現。
features: Basophilic erythroblast with deep blue cytoplasm and perinuclear clearing
Myeloid precursors (promyelocytes, myelocytes) with azurophilic granules
Multiple round punched-out clear vacuoles in precursor cytoplasm, some overlying the nucleus
Bands and segmented neutrophils with coarse granulation
No increase in blasts in this field
65239.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows maturing granulocytic and erythroid precursors, including basophilic erythroblasts with deeply basophilic cytoplasm. Several precursors contain multiple round, punched-out clear cytoplasmic vacuoles, some superimposed over the nucleus. Mature granulocytes show coarse granulation, and blasts are not increased. In a patient with a UBA1 p.Met41Leu variant, findings are consistent with the cytoplasmic vacuolization of myeloid and erythroid precursors characteristic of VEXAS syndrome.

ddx.vs: Copper deficiency produces similar precursor vacuoles, so it is excluded by normal copper/ceruloplasmin and confirmed VEXAS by UBA1 mutation.
Toxic vacuoles are reversible after exposure withdrawal and lack a somatic UBA1 variant.
Pure erythroid leukemia shows sheets of vacuolated proerythroblasts exceeding 80% with erythroid predominance, rather than orderly trilineage maturation.
Artifactual vacuoles are irregular and also appear in red cells and background, whereas these are sharp and confined to precursor cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: VEXAS syndrome — punched-out cytoplasmic vacuoles in myeloid and erythroid precursors (somatic UBA1 mutation)
pearls_zh: 考法：指前驅細胞內圓形打孔狀空泡，問「年長男性＋反覆發炎（軟骨炎、皮疹、發燒）＋巨球性貧血」該驗什麼：UBA1。
遺傳：造血幹細胞的 X-linked UBA1 somatic mutation，熱點為 p.Met41（Thr/Val/Leu），患者幾乎皆為男性。
名稱：Vacuoles、E1 enzyme、X-linked、Autoinflammatory、Somatic；常伴 macrocytosis、血小板低下、MDS 與靜脈血栓。
空泡主要見於 myeloid 與 erythroid 前驅細胞，但並非特異，須結合臨床與基因檢測。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 copper deficiency、酒精或 linezolid／chloramphenicol 毒性的前驅細胞空泡混淆；靠自體發炎臨床表現與 UBA1 突變區分。

quiz.q: 老年男性有反覆發炎與此圖的前驅細胞空泡，應驗哪個基因？
quiz.a: UBA1（somatic，codon Met41）

65303.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中兩顆分葉核嗜中性球的周圍各自被一圈小血小板緊密環繞（platelet satellitism），而遠離白血球處血小板很少，這是 EDTA 引起的體外假性血小板低下現象。
features: Two segmented neutrophils each rimmed by a ring of adherent platelets
Platelets are small to normal-sized with granular purple staining
Few free platelets elsewhere in the field
Neutrophil nuclei and cytoplasm otherwise unremarkable
Red cells with preserved central pallor; overexposed image limits red cell assessment
65303.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two segmented neutrophils, each surrounded by a rosette of adherent platelets, with few free platelets elsewhere in the field. The neutrophils and the platelets themselves are morphologically unremarkable, and no platelet clumps are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with platelet satellitism, an in vitro EDTA-dependent phenomenon that can cause spurious thrombocytopenia; a repeat count in citrate-anticoagulated blood is recommended.

ddx.vs: Platelet clumping forms free-lying platelet aggregates, often at the feathered edge, rather than rings adhering to neutrophils.
True thrombocytopenia shows uniformly sparse platelets on the smear without platelets sequestered around leukocytes, and persists in citrate samples.
Phagocytosed platelets lie within the neutrophil cytoplasm rather than attached around the cell membrane.

exam.answer_en: Platelet satellitism — rosettes of platelets adhering around neutrophils (EDTA-dependent in vitro artifact causing pseudothrombocytopenia)
pearls_zh: 考法：自動計數血小板低但病人無出血，考官指中性球周圍一圈血小板問現象與處置；答 platelet satellitism，改用 citrate 或 heparin 管重抽並看抹片。
機轉：EDTA 暴露 GPIIb/IIIa 抗原決定位，自體抗體將血小板橋接到中性球 FcγRIII（CD16）；僅發生於體外，無臨床出血意義。
臨床意義：避免不必要的血小板輸注、骨髓檢查或延誤手術/抗凝治療；報告應註明 pseudothrombocytopenia。
exam.pitfall_zh: 常被當成真的血小板低下，或誤認為中性球吞噬血小板；satellitism 的血小板貼在細胞膜外圍呈花環，吞噬的血小板則位於細胞質內。

quiz.q: 圖中中性球周圍的血小板環稱為什麼？如何取得正確的血小板數？
quiz.a: Platelet satellitism；改用 citrate（或 heparin）抗凝管重抽並校正稀釋後計數。

65175.recognize_zh: 小腸切除標本穿孔處可見穿透腸壁的密集淋巴球浸潤並使絨毛變形，高倍下為單一形態的中小型淋巴球、核不規則，並侵入腺窩上皮（epitheliotropism）；免疫染色 CD4 強陽性、CD8 陰性、TCRβF1 陽性、TCRδ 陰性，為 CD4 陽性變異的 MEITL。
features: Small intestinal resection with a perforation site (arrow) and a dense transmural lymphoid infiltrate
Expansion of the mucosa with blunted, distorted villi at low power
Sheets of monotonous small to medium lymphocytes with slightly irregular round nuclei, dispersed chromatin and a thin rim of clear cytoplasm
Epitheliotropism with neoplastic cells infiltrating crypt epithelium
Immunostains: diffuse strong CD4 positivity, CD8 negative (rare scattered positive cells), TCR betaF1 positive, TCR delta negative
65175.describe_en: Resected small intestine shows a perforation associated with a dense, transmural lymphoid infiltrate that expands and distorts the villous architecture. At high power the infiltrate consists of monotonous small to medium-sized lymphocytes with round to slightly irregular nuclei, dispersed chromatin and pale cytoplasm, with prominent epitheliotropism into crypts; no significant inflammatory background or necrosis is seen in these fields. The neoplastic cells are diffusely and strongly positive for CD4 and TCR betaF1 and negative for CD8 and TCR delta. Findings are consistent with monomorphic epitheliotropic intestinal T-cell lymphoma with an unusual CD4-positive phenotype.

ddx.vs: EATL arises in celiac disease with pleomorphic medium to large cells, a prominent inflammatory background and necrosis, and is usually CD56 negative, unlike this monotonous CD56+ infiltrate without celiac changes.

ddx.dx: Indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder of the GI tract
ddx.vs: The indolent disorder shows small bland cells confined mostly to the lamina propria without transmural destructive growth or prominent epitheliotropism, with a low Ki-67.
ENKTL is angiocentric with necrosis and is EBER positive, whereas this tumor is EBER negative.
RCD II shows aberrant intraepithelial lymphocytes with villous atrophy but no mass-forming transmural sheets of lymphoma cells.

65175.stain: H&E; IHC: CD4, CD8, TCR betaF1, TCR delta

65111.recognize_zh: Giemsa 骨髓抹片可見紅血球系前驅細胞形態異常：雙核與核分葉（出芽）的大型紅母細胞、核質發育不同步，部分晚期紅母細胞細胞質帶有粗顆粒；但環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblasts）必須靠普魯士藍鐵染色證實，本圖並未呈現鐵染色。
features: Erythroid precursors at various stages with round nuclei and coarsely clumped chromatin
Dyserythropoiesis: large binucleated/lobulated early erythroblasts with nuclear budding and deeply basophilic cytoplasm (lower right)
Megaloblastoid features with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and irregular cytoplasmic margins
Some erythroid cells with coarse cytoplasmic dots/granules and pale, frayed cytoplasm
Ring sideroblasts not demonstrable on this Romanowsky stain; iron stain required
65111.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows erythroid precursors with dysplastic features, including binucleated and nuclear-budding erythroblasts, megaloblastoid nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and irregular, frayed cytoplasm, with occasional coarse cytoplasmic granules. Granulocytic cells present in the fields are not specifically assessable for dysplasia. Ring sideroblasts cannot be evaluated on this Giemsa-stained preparation; the reported Prussian blue stain showing 70% ring sideroblasts, together with refractory macrocytic anemia, supports myelodysplastic syndrome with ring sideroblasts (SF3B1 testing recommended).

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic change shows open sieve-like chromatin with giant metamyelocytes and corrects with vitamin replacement, without ring sideroblasts on iron stain.
Congenital forms are typically microcytic and present in young patients, rather than macrocytic anemia with dysplasia in an elderly patient.
Copper deficiency produces ring sideroblasts with cytoplasmic vacuoles in myeloid and erythroid precursors and neutropenia, reversible with correction.

ddx.dx: MDS/MPN with SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis
ddx.vs: Morphology of erythroid precursors overlaps; this entity requires platelets >=450 x10^9/L with atypical large megakaryocytes.

64855.recognize_zh: 箭頭指的兩顆紅血球母細胞，細胞質邊緣或核旁有數顆小而圓、深紫色的點狀包涵體，形態類似 Howell-Jolly 小體；同視野還有核碎裂的細胞，代表紅系造血不良（dyserythropoiesis）。
features: Erythroblasts (arrows) with round nuclei and moderately clumped chromatin
Multiple small round dark-purple Howell-Jolly body-like inclusions within erythroblast cytoplasm
Some inclusions distributed at the cytoplasmic periphery forming a beaded rim
Cells with fragmented/clumped nuclear chromatin and a large cell with coarse chromatin strand (left)
Background myeloid precursors, a segmented neutrophil and scattered red cells
64855.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows erythroid precursors containing multiple small, round, dense basophilic cytoplasmic inclusions resembling Howell-Jolly bodies (arrows). Additional cells show nuclear fragmentation, and a mixture of myeloid precursors and a segmented neutrophil are present. The inclusions represent nuclear fragments indicative of dyserythropoiesis. Findings are consistent with dyserythropoietic changes as seen in myelodysplastic neoplasm, pending exclusion of nutritional, toxic and drug-related causes.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic change shows large erythroblasts with open, finely stippled chromatin and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony, correcting with B12/folate.
Pappenheimer bodies are finer, irregular clustered granules that are Prussian blue positive, unlike round DNA-containing fragments.
Apoptotic cells show globally shrunken, condensed nuclear debris with cytoplasmic eosinophilia, rather than a viable nucleus with small discrete fragments.
Hyposplenism shows Howell-Jolly bodies in circulating mature red cells, not in marrow erythroblasts with other dysplastic features.

64983.recognize_zh: 活體染色抹片中，含藍色網狀顆粒的網狀紅血球聚集成大團塊，而周圍沒有網狀物的成熟紅血球則分散、不參與凝集，這種只凝集網狀紅血球的現象就是本張的重點。
features: Large clumps composed almost exclusively of reticulocytes containing dark blue precipitated reticulum
Mature red cells without reticulum dispersed singly around the aggregates, not agglutinated
Aggregates are three-dimensional, irregular clusters rather than linear rouleaux stacks
Background red cells show mild shape variation and crenation
Few scattered small blue granular debris at edges of aggregates
64983.describe_en: Peripheral blood supravital (reticulocyte) stain shows large irregular clusters composed of reticulocytes containing blue-staining precipitated reticulum, while mature red cells lacking reticulum remain dispersed and non-agglutinated. The clumps are three-dimensional rather than linear, arguing against rouleaux. Selective agglutination of reticulocytes suggests an antibody directed at an antigen expressed preferentially on young red cells. In an EBV-infected child with hemolysis, findings are consistent with post-infectious reticulocyte-selective agglutination; direct antiglobulin test and cold agglutinin studies are recommended.

ddx.vs: Cold agglutinins clump both mature and immature red cells and disperse on warming to 37 °C, rather than sparing mature cells.
Rouleaux form linear coin-like stacks of all red cells in thick areas and disperse with saline replacement.
Warm AIHA typically shows spherocytes and polychromasia with a positive IgG DAT, with agglutination being uncommon.
Stain precipitate forms extracellular granules over cells in random distribution, not intracellular reticulum confined to clumped cells.

64727.recognize_zh: A 圖 PET-CT 右肝周邊有一個 FDG 高攝取的分葉狀病灶；B 圖腫瘤細胞呈片狀 CD138 細胞膜強陽性；C 圖 Diff-Quik 抹片見偏心核、核仁明顯、部分雙核的漿細胞樣腫瘤細胞，符合肝臟髓外漿細胞瘤。
features: PET-CT: lobulated hypoattenuating lesion at the periphery of the right hepatic lobe with intense rim-to-diffuse FDG avidity
IHC: diffuse, strong membranous CD138 staining in sheets/nests of tumor cells
Cytology: dyscohesive plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei and moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Nuclear pleomorphism with prominent nucleoli, binucleate forms, and high N:C ratio in a subset
Background of small mature lymphocytes and blood
64727.describe_en: Composite figure. PET-CT (A) shows a lobulated hypoattenuating mass at the periphery of the right hepatic lobe with marked FDG avidity. The biopsy immunostain (B) demonstrates sheets of tumor cells with strong, diffuse membranous CD138 positivity. The Diff-Quik-stained cytologic preparation (C) shows dyscohesive plasmacytoid cells with eccentric nuclei, moderate basophilic cytoplasm, variable nuclear pleomorphism, prominent nucleoli, and occasional binucleation. Findings are consistent with extraosseous (hepatic) plasmacytoma with atypical, immature features; light-chain restriction and exclusion of systemic myeloma should be documented.

ddx.vs: PBL cells are larger immunoblastic cells with a very high Ki-67, often EBER-positive and in immunocompromised hosts, whereas plasmacytoma retains recognizable plasma cell morphology and is usually EBV-negative.
HCC cells are polygonal with trabecular architecture and express HepPar-1/arginase-1, not CD138 with light-chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Metastatic neuroendocrine or poorly differentiated carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinomas are cohesive and keratin-positive; CD138 can stain epithelium, so kappa/lambda restriction and CD79a/MUM1 are needed to confirm plasma cell lineage.

ddx.dx: Secondary hepatic involvement by multiple myeloma
ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; marrow examination, serum/urine M-protein, and skeletal survey distinguish systemic myeloma from solitary plasmacytoma.

64663.recognize_zh: 周邊血液抹片中兩顆相鄰的嗜中性球，細胞質有空泡，內含多簇大小一致、深藍紫色的小圓球菌，呈成對或短鏈排列，屬被吞噬的球菌（菌血症）；此為 Romanowsky 染色，無法判斷革蘭氏陽性與否，需靠血液培養。
features: Two adjacent neutrophils with vacuolated cytoplasm
Numerous intracytoplasmic uniform, round, dark blue-purple cocci arranged in pairs, small clusters and short chains
Nuclei of the neutrophils are partly obscured and displaced by the bacterial load
Background red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis; no extracellular organisms clearly identified
Gram reaction cannot be assessed on this Romanowsky-stained smear
64663.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophils with vacuolated cytoplasm containing numerous uniform, dark blue-purple intracytoplasmic cocci arranged in pairs, small clusters and short chains. Extracellular organisms are not clearly identified, and background red cells show mild anisopoikilocytosis. Intracellular bacteria in circulating neutrophils indicate high-grade bacteremia and warrant immediate notification and blood cultures; the Gram reaction and species cannot be determined on a Romanowsky stain. Findings are consistent with phagocytosed cocci, subsequently identified as Enterococcus faecalis on culture.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are fine, evenly dispersed azurophilic granules throughout the cytoplasm, not discrete uniform cocci in pairs and chains within vacuoles.
These cocci look the same on a Wright stain; clusters versus chains on Gram stain and culture are required to distinguish them from Enterococcus.
Precipitate is irregular in size, lies above the focal plane and also appears over red cells and background, whereas these cocci are uniform and confined to neutrophil vacuoles.
Morulae are a single mulberry-like cluster of tiny inclusions within a vacuole, rather than multiple discrete larger cocci in pairs and chains.

64471.recognize_zh: 關節液抹片中有許多大型圓形細胞，核質比高、染色質細緻、細胞質深藍且無顆粒，和旁邊帶粉紅顆粒、分葉核的中性球明顯不同，符合 AML 芽細胞浸潤關節液。
features: Numerous large round blasts, clearly larger than adjacent neutrophils
High N:C ratio with round to slightly irregular nuclei and fine, dispersed chromatin
Scant to moderate deeply basophilic, agranular cytoplasm
Admixed neutrophils and maturing granulocytes with pink granular cytoplasm and lobulated or band-shaped nuclei
Cells clustered in a cellular cytospin-type preparation; rare red cells
64471.describe_en: Cytocentrifuge preparation of synovial (knee joint) fluid is highly cellular, containing numerous large blasts admixed with neutrophils and maturing granulocytes. The blasts have round to slightly irregular nuclei with fine chromatin, high N:C ratios, and deeply basophilic agranular cytoplasm; Auer rods are not evident at this magnification. Nuclear detail is partly limited by the bluish stain quality. In correlation with flow cytometry showing a CD34-positive myeloid blast population, findings are consistent with involvement of the joint fluid by acute myeloid leukemia.

ddx.dx: Septic or crystal arthritis with reactive cells
ddx.vs: Inflammatory effusions are dominated by neutrophils and macrophages/synoviocytes without a population of large high N:C blasts with fine chromatin.
Lymphoblasts may look similar and require flow cytometry: here the blasts express CD13/CD33 with CD34 rather than CD19/cCD3 lineage markers.
Synoviocytes and macrophages have abundant grey vacuolated cytoplasm and lower N:C ratio with oval eccentric nuclei.

64279.recognize_zh: 右上一顆巨大多核細胞，約有五到六個大而深染的核、細胞質豐富且嗜鹼性，一側細胞質內含有另一顆偏粉紅的細胞（細胞吞噬現象），旁邊的淋巴球小得多，符合肋膜積液中的轉移性癌細胞。
features: Very large multinucleated atypical cell, many times the size of adjacent lymphocytes
Five to six large, round to oval hyperchromatic nuclei with smooth contours
Abundant basophilic cytoplasm with a finely vacuolated paler zone
Intracytoplasmic engulfed cell with pink cytoplasm and a folded nucleus, suggesting cell-in-cell engulfment (cannibalism)
Scattered small lymphocytes and a monocytoid cell in a clean background; image slightly out of focus
64279.describe_en: Pleural fluid cytospin shows a markedly enlarged multinucleated atypical cell with five to six hyperchromatic nuclei and abundant basophilic cytoplasm. Within its cytoplasm is an engulfed cell with pink cytoplasm and a lobated nucleus, consistent with cell-in-cell engulfment. The background contains a few small lymphocytes and a mononuclear cell; the focus is slightly soft, which limits evaluation of nucleoli. In the context of a known lung carcinoma, findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma cells in the pleural fluid, with confirmatory immunocytochemistry on cell block recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive mesothelial cells may be binucleated or multinucleated but have evenly spaced uniform nuclei, two-tone cytoplasm with a brush border and calretinin/WT1 positivity.
Histiocytic giant cells have small bland nuclei with fine chromatin and foamy cytoplasm and are CD68 positive and keratin negative.
Megakaryocytes have a single multilobated nucleus and granular pink cytoplasm, not multiple separate hyperchromatic nuclei.

64151.recognize_zh: 三顆受感染紅血球整個被寄生蟲占滿，內有分散的棕褐色瘧色素與粉紅/紅紫色染色質團，上方兩顆各有一個偏心的染色質塊，符合間日瘧（P. vivax）配子體；下方那顆有兩點染色質，也可能是早期裂殖體。
features: Infected red cells nearly filled by a single rounded parasite, at least as large as uninfected red cells
Abundant scattered fine golden-brown hemozoin pigment throughout the parasite
Single compact eccentric magenta chromatin mass in two parasites (gametocyte pattern)
One parasite with two chromatin dots, possibly an early schizont rather than a gametocyte
Schuffner stippling and red cell enlargement not clearly assessable at this resolution; no ring forms or banana-shaped gametocytes
64151.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows scattered red cells occupied by large rounded parasites that fill most of the host cell and contain diffusely scattered brown hemozoin pigment. Two parasites have a single compact eccentric chromatin mass, consistent with gametocytes, while a third has two chromatin dots and may represent an early schizont. Crescent-shaped gametocytes and multiple fine ring forms are not seen, although Schuffner stippling and host cell enlargement are difficult to assess at this magnification. Findings are consistent with Plasmodium vivax infection with circulating gametocytes; parasitemia quantification and confirmatory PCR or antigen testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: P. ovale also produces round gametocytes with Schuffner dots, but infected cells are often oval with fimbriated edges and the parasite is more compact with coarser pigment; PCR distinguishes them reliably.
P. malariae gametocytes occur in normal-sized or smaller red cells without stippling and with coarse dark pigment, alongside band-form trophozoites.
P. falciparum gametocytes are crescent or banana shaped, and trophozoites/schizonts are rarely seen in peripheral blood.
Babesia forms small rings and tetrads without hemozoin pigment and without large gametocytes.

exam.answer_en: Plasmodium vivax gametocytes — large round parasites filling red cells with scattered brown hemozoin and a single eccentric chromatin mass
pearls_zh: 考法：指占滿紅血球的圓形蟲體問「哪一種瘧原蟲、哪個時期？」圓形配子體可排除 P. falciparum（香蕉形）；vivax 受感染紅血球變大並有 Schüffner dots。
P. vivax 與 P. ovale 有肝內休眠體（hypnozoites）會復發，根治需 primaquine 或 tafenoquine，用藥前必須檢測 G6PD。
P. vivax 偏好侵犯網狀紅血球，入侵依賴 Duffy antigen；Duffy 陰性者較不易感染但並非絕對。
抹片判讀：厚片偵測敏感度較高，薄片用來鑑定種別與計算寄生率；配子體代表具傳染力。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 P. ovale 或 P. malariae 混淆；ovale 感染的紅血球常呈橢圓、邊緣鬚狀，malariae 的紅血球不變大且無 Schüffner dots，vivax 則紅血球變大並有點狀顆粒。

quiz.q: 此種瘧疾治療後仍可能復發的原因為何？根治用藥前需檢查什麼？
quiz.a: 肝內 hypnozoites；使用 primaquine/tafenoquine 前需檢測 G6PD。

64023.recognize_zh: 左上角可見一顆一側平直、呈半月形的紅血球碎片（helmet cell/schistocyte）；但此張染色偏灰、倍率高而視野內多數紅血球是橢圓形（ovalocyte），只有少數碎片，單憑這張不足以判斷碎片數量。
features: Single helmet-shaped red cell fragment with a straight cut edge and pointed ends (upper left)
Most red cells oval to elliptical with preserved central pallor
Mild anisocytosis
A small platelet and a few small refractile particles in the background
Poor staining quality and greyish color cast limit assessment
64023.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear (high power; suboptimal, greyish staining) shows red cells with mild anisocytosis, most of which are oval to elliptical with preserved central pallor. A single helmet-shaped fragment with a straight cut border is present at the upper left, consistent with a schistocyte. Only a few cells are in this field, so the schistocyte proportion cannot be estimated, and the predominance of ovalocytes is not explained by fragmentation. The image supports the presence of a schistocyte, but quantification over multiple fields (ICSH: >1% suggests microangiopathic hemolysis) and correlation with platelet count and hemolysis markers are required.

ddx.vs: Keratocytes retain a central ruptured vacuole remnant with two horn-like projections, whereas a helmet cell has one straight cut edge without a vacuole.
In HE most red cells are elliptical with occasional fragments in severe forms, whereas MAHA shows many fragments of varying shape in a background of normal discocytes.

ddx.dx: Smear artifact (cells cut at the feathered edge)
ddx.vs: Artifactual fragments cluster at the thin edge and share a uniform orientation, while true schistocytes are distributed throughout the monolayer.

63831.recognize_zh: 一顆非常巨大的細胞含有二十多個彼此分開、大小相近的圓形至卵圓形細胞核，聚集在細胞一側，另一側為大量帶細小紫紅色顆粒的淡藍紫色細胞質，這種「多個獨立核」的型態是破骨細胞（osteoclast），不是分葉相連的巨核細胞。
features: Very large multinucleated cell with more than 20 discrete, separate nuclei
Nuclei uniform, round to oval, with fine chromatin and small nucleoli, clustered toward one side
Abundant cytoplasm, blue-gray near the nuclei and paler peripherally, with numerous fine azurophilic granules
Irregular cell border; surrounding red cells and a few platelets
63831.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a very large multinucleated cell containing numerous (more than 20) discrete, uniform round to oval nuclei with fine chromatin and small nucleoli, clustered eccentrically. The abundant cytoplasm is gray-blue to lilac with fine azurophilic granules and an irregular border. The nuclei are clearly separate rather than lobes of a single nucleus. Findings are consistent with an osteoclast.

ddx.vs: A megakaryocyte has a single large multilobated nucleus with connected lobes and platelet-producing granular cytoplasm, whereas an osteoclast has many separate, uniform nuclei.
Osteoblasts are separate mononuclear cells with eccentric nuclei and a perinuclear hof, often in groups, not a single syncytial cell.

Histiocytic giant cells arise in granulomas with epithelioid histiocytes and have nuclei arranged peripherally or haphazardly, without the granular cytoplasm of osteoclasts in a normal marrow background.

ddx.dx: Multinucleated tumor giant cell (e.g., metastatic carcinoma, Reed-Sternberg cell)
ddx.vs: Tumor giant cells show nuclear pleomorphism, hyperchromasia and prominent nucleoli, unlike the uniform bland nuclei here.

exam.answer_en: Osteoclast — giant cell with numerous discrete uniform nuclei and granular cytoplasm (not a megakaryocyte)
pearls_zh: 考法：骨髓抹片巨大多核細胞，問「巨核細胞還是破骨細胞」；答 osteoclast，依據為多個彼此分離、大小一致且帶小核仁的核，而非單一多葉相連核。
來源與標記：osteoclast 源自單核球/巨噬細胞系，TRAP 陽性、CD68 陽性；巨核細胞則 CD61、CD42b 陽性。
搭檔細胞 osteoblast：單核、核偏心、淡染區遠離核（不緊貼核），常成群，易誤認為漿細胞；兒童骨髓與骨轉換增加時較常見。
Osteoclast 增加見於骨轉換上升狀態：副甲狀腺機能亢進、Paget disease、腎性骨病變、骨轉移或骨髓瘤骨病灶附近。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常被誤認為巨核細胞；巨核細胞為單一分葉相連核、染色質較粗、無明顯核仁，osteoclast 則是十幾到數十個獨立圓核且各有小核仁。

quiz.q: 此巨大多核細胞為何種細胞？與巨核細胞最主要的核型態差異是什麼？
quiz.a: Osteoclast（破骨細胞）；多個獨立分離的圓核（巨核細胞為單一多葉相連核）

63639.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中細胞沿抹片條帶分布、細胞量高，散佈許多體積大的巨核細胞，左側還有巨核細胞聚集成群，提示巨核細胞增生，符合 MDS/MPN 伴環狀鐵粒母細胞與血小板增多的骨髓表現。
features: Low-power aspirate with cellular trails of hematopoietic cells
Increased numbers of megakaryocytes scattered across the field
Megakaryocytes vary in size, including large forms, with a loose cluster at the left edge
Mixed myeloid and erythroid precursors in the background
Individual cytologic detail (dysplasia, ring sideroblasts) not assessable at this magnification
63639.describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows cellular trails with abundant hematopoietic elements. Megakaryocytes are conspicuously increased, varying in size and including large forms, with a loose cluster at the left margin. Cytologic detail such as dysplasia cannot be evaluated at this magnification. The findings of megakaryocytic hyperplasia are consistent with a myeloproliferative component and, together with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis, support myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with ring sideroblasts and thrombocytosis.

ddx.vs: ET also shows increased large megakaryocytes but lacks erythroid dysplasia and ≥15% ring sideroblasts on iron stain.
PMF megakaryocytes are atypical with cloud-like hyperchromatic nuclei in dense clusters, with granulocytic proliferation and reticulin fibrosis on biopsy.
ITP shows increased megakaryocytes with thrombocytopenia rather than thrombocytosis and no dysplasia or ring sideroblasts.

63575.recognize_zh: 數個大型單核細胞鬆散聚成一群，核小而偏心、橢圓形，胞質豐富呈霧狀藍紫色且邊界模糊，淡染區離核有一段距離，這是成骨細胞（osteoblasts）的典型外觀，與核旁有淡染區（hof）的漿細胞不同。
features: Loose aggregate of about six large mononuclear cells with abundant, wispy, ill-defined cytoplasm
Single oval nucleus per cell, eccentrically placed and often near the cell margin
Finely granular chromatin with inconspicuous nucleoli; no nuclear atypia
Abundant blue-lavender finely granular cytoplasm with a pale zone separated from the nucleus
Background of stacked red cells and small platelet clumps
63575.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (May-Grünwald-Giemsa) shows a loose cluster of large mononuclear cells with eccentric oval nuclei, fine chromatin, and abundant pale basophilic cytoplasm with ill-defined borders. Some cells show a pale cytoplasmic clear zone located away from the nucleus. There is no significant nuclear pleomorphism, nuclear molding, or mitotic activity to suggest a malignant cohesive cluster. Findings are consistent with normal osteoblasts. (This image appears identical to another osteoblast example in the collection.)

ddx.vs: Plasma cells are smaller, with coarse clock-face chromatin, deep blue cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof abutting the nucleus rather than a Golgi zone separated from it.
Carcinoma clusters are tightly cohesive with high N:C ratio, pleomorphic nuclei and prominent nucleoli.
Mast cells contain dense metachromatic purple granules and histiocytes have vacuolated cytoplasm with phagocytic debris, unlike the smooth basophilic osteoblast cytoplasm.

exam.answer_en: Normal osteoblasts — cluster of large mononuclear cells with eccentric nuclei, wispy cytoplasm and a Golgi zone away from the nucleus
pearls_zh: 考官常把成群 osteoblast 放進「找癌細胞」的題目：答案是正常成骨細胞，因為沒有核多形性、核互嵌（molding）或分裂象。
與轉移癌區分：癌細胞團較緊密、核質比高、核仁明顯、核互嵌；必要時切片以 cytokeratin IHC 確認。
成骨細胞鹼性磷酸酶（ALP）陽性；兒童與青少年骨髓抽吸較常見，成人則見於骨重塑活躍時。
與漿細胞比較：osteoblast 較大、核偏心甚至像被擠出細胞外、淡染 Golgi 區離核；漿細胞 hof 緊貼核旁。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為漿細胞群或轉移癌；靠淡染區不貼核、胞質邊界模糊、核溫和且無互嵌來辨認成骨細胞。

quiz.q: 這群大型單核細胞最可能是什麼細胞？
quiz.a: Osteoblasts（成骨細胞）

63383.recognize_zh: 這是血液分析儀畫面：RBC 1.12、HCT 11.8% 被低估，MCV 105.4、MCHC 44.9 g/dL 不合生理地升高，並跳出「RBC Agglutination?」「PLT Clumps?」旗標；MCHC 大於 36 伴隨這些旗標，就要想到冷凝集素造成的假性數值。
features: CBC: WBC 25.36 x10^3/uL, RBC 1.12 x10^6/uL, HGB 5.3 g/dL, HCT 11.8%, MCV 105.4 fL, MCH 47.3 pg, MCHC 44.9 g/dL
Physiologically impossible MCHC (above 36 g/dL) with spuriously high MCV and MCH, while hemoglobin is measured correctly
RBC flags: RBC Agglutination?, Turbidity/HGB Interference?, Anisocytosis, Anemia, Reticulocytosis; PLT flag: PLT Clumps?
NRBC 7.50 x10^3/uL (29.6/100 WBC), reticulocytes 7.78%, IG 6.2%, neutrophilia and monocytosis flagged
RBC histogram with broad, abnormal distribution and scattergrams showing reticulocyte and NRBC populations
63383.describe_en: This is a non-morphologic automated hematology analyzer report. The red cell count and hematocrit are falsely low and the MCV, MCH and a physiologically impossible MCHC of 44.9 g/dL are falsely high, while hemoglobin itself is unaffected, and the analyzer flags possible RBC agglutination and platelet clumps. This pattern is characteristic of cold agglutinin interference, in which red cell doublets and clusters are counted as single large cells. Reticulocytosis, circulating nucleated red cells and leukocytosis support an active hemolytic or marrow-stress state. Warming the sample to 37 degrees Celsius and rerunning, together with smear review, is recommended to obtain accurate indices.

ddx.vs: Turbidity falsely raises hemoglobin (and MCH/MCHC) while RBC count and MCV are unaffected, and plasma replacement corrects it, whereas warming corrects cold agglutinin artifact.
Spherocytosis raises MCHC only modestly (about 36-38 g/dL) with a normal or low MCV, not a markedly elevated MCV with MCHC above 40.
Genuine macrocytosis has a normal MCHC and a hematocrit concordant with hemoglobin (about three times the Hb value).

exam.answer_en: Spurious CBC from cold agglutinins — MCHC 44.9 g/dL with falsely low RBC/HCT, high MCV and RBC agglutination flag
pearls_zh: 考法：考官給 CBC 問「哪個數值不合理？」答 MCHC >36 g/dL 生理上不可能，搭配 RBC Agglutination? 旗標指向冷凝集素。
機轉：凝集團被計為單一大顆粒 → RBC 計數偏低、MCV 偏高；HCT 由 RBC×MCV 計算而偏低；HGB 為溶血後測量故正確，於是 MCHC 假性升高。
處理：檢體置 37°C 保溫後重測，MCHC 回到正常範圍即證實冷凝集素干擾；嚴重者可用溫食鹽水置換血漿。
MCHC 假性升高的其他原因：脂血或高膽紅素使 HGB 假性升高（此時 RBC 計數正常）；spherocytosis 的 MCHC 雖升高但不會達 44 g/dL。
exam.pitfall_zh: MCHC 升高易直接歸因於 hereditary spherocytosis；HS 的 MCHC 僅輕度升高，大於 40 並伴 RBC 計數偏低與凝集旗標應先懷疑冷凝集素。

quiz.q: 這份 CBC 中哪一個指數生理上不可能？最簡單的確認方法是什麼？
quiz.a: MCHC 44.9 g/dL（>36）；檢體 37°C 保溫後重測

63255.recognize_zh: 未染色濕片（wet mount）中佈滿大小不一、完美圓形、中央透亮並帶深色折光邊緣的球體，彼此不含核或內部結構；這種高折光性的圓形液滴是脂肪球，符合檢體中含有脂肪顆粒（脂肪栓塞），可再以油紅 O 或 Sudan 染色確認。
features: Unstained wet mount viewed through the microscope eyepiece
Numerous perfectly round, smooth-contoured globules of widely varying size
Globules are homogeneous and clear centrally with dark, refractile rims
No nuclei, internal structure, or biconcave shape; no cell outlines within the globules
Globules crowd together without deforming into polyhedral shapes
63255.describe_en: Unstained wet-mount preparation of material from the blood sample shows numerous round, smooth, homogeneous globules of widely varying size with clear centers and dark refractile rims. The globules lack nuclei or internal structure and do not have the biconcave shape of red cells. The appearance is characteristic of lipid droplets. In the clinical context of suspected fat embolism with analyzer interference and neutrophils containing fat vacuoles, the findings are consistent with fat globules in the specimen; confirmation with Oil red O or Sudan staining is recommended.

ddx.vs: Air bubbles have very thick, dark black rims with a bright center and usually lie in a different focal plane or at the coverslip edge, whereas lipid droplets have thinner refractile rims and stain with Oil red O.

ddx.dx: Red blood cells or red cell ghosts
ddx.vs: Red cells are uniform, about 7-8 µm, biconcave and pale pink-yellow, unlike the markedly variable-sized refractile globules here.
Starch granules are faceted with a central hilum and show a Maltese-cross pattern under polarized light, unlike smooth round lipid droplets.

63127.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片中，骨小樑周圍與部分間質有成片、較密的淋巴樣細胞浸潤，與旁邊含脂肪的殘存造血區形成對比；骨小樑旁（paratrabecular）分布提示濾泡性淋巴瘤系列侵犯。
features: Low-power bone marrow core biopsy with several bony trabeculae
Dense cellular infiltrate hugging trabecular surfaces (paratrabecular) and extending into interstitium
Adjacent areas of residual trilineage hematopoiesis with interspersed fat
Focal hemorrhage/eosinophilic stromal change in upper left field
Individual cytology not assessable at this magnification
63127.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows a variably cellular marrow with a dense lymphoid infiltrate distributed along bony trabeculae and extending into the interstitium, alternating with areas of residual hematopoiesis and fat. Focal hemorrhage is present. Cytologic grade cannot be assessed at this magnification and requires high-power examination and immunohistochemistry. In the context of the accompanying stains, the paratrabecular pattern is consistent with marrow involvement by follicular lymphoma, here with large-cell transformation.

ddx.vs: Low-grade FL forms paratrabecular aggregates of small cleaved centrocytes with low Ki-67, whereas transformed disease shows sheets of large centroblast-like cells with mitoses.
Metastases form cohesive nests with desmoplasia and are keratin- or melanocytic-marker positive and CD45/CD20 negative.
cHL shows scattered Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells in a fibrotic mixed inflammatory background, CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and CD20 usually negative.

62999.recognize_zh: CD117 免疫染色可見成片、成束排列的紡錘形細胞呈強烈細胞質/膜陽性，細胞質內顆粒狀染色，符合非典型紡錘形肥大細胞浸潤（系統性肥大細胞增生症）。
features: Dense, strongly CD117-positive infiltrate forming sheets and streaming fascicles
Positive cells are predominantly spindled/elongated, with granular cytoplasmic and membranous staining
Occasional rounder positive cells at the edge of the infiltrate
Adjacent areas of CD117-negative small round cells with blue counterstain
Infiltrate is cohesive and aggregate-forming rather than scattered single cells
62999.describe_en: CD117 immunostain shows a dense infiltrate of strongly positive cells arranged in sheets and streaming fascicles. The positive cells are predominantly spindle-shaped with granular cytoplasmic and membranous staining, while adjacent small round cells are negative. Findings are consistent with an aggregate of atypical spindled mast cells, supporting the major criterion of systemic mastocytosis when correlated with tryptase and CD25/CD2 co-expression.

ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are scattered, round and non-aggregated (not dense clusters of >=15 cells) and are CD25-negative.
GIST is also CD117+ spindle-cell but is DOG1+, tryptase-negative and occurs as a soft-tissue mass rather than a hematolymphoid infiltrate.
Blasts are round with fine chromatin and co-express CD34/MPO, and are tryptase-negative, unlike spindled mast cells.

62935.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中一個分葉核嗜中性球的細胞質內含多顆大而不規則的深洋紅色顆粒，大小遠超過正常顆粒，周圍紅血球正常大小、正常色素；嗜中性球內的巨大顆粒是 Chediak-Higashi 症候群的典型線索。
features: Segmented neutrophil with several large, round to irregular, deep magenta cytoplasmic granules
Giant granules clearly larger than normal specific granules
Remaining neutrophil cytoplasm pale pink
Normocytic normochromic red cells with a few crenated forms
Normal-appearing platelets in background
62935.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a segmented neutrophil containing several large, irregular, deep magenta cytoplasmic granules that are much larger than normal neutrophilic granules. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic with a few crenated forms, and platelets appear normal. No left shift or toxic changes are evident. Findings are consistent with the giant granules of Chediak-Higashi syndrome.

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are fine, uniform, and diffusely distributed, not a few giant irregular granules.
Pseudo-CH granules arise from fused azurophilic granules in leukemic or dysplastic cells, accompanied by blasts or dysplasia.
Phagocytosed organisms are uniform in shape (cocci, yeast) and often in vacuoles, unlike variably sized magenta granules.

exam.answer_en: Chediak-Higashi syndrome — segmented neutrophil containing several giant magenta cytoplasmic granules
pearls_zh: 考法：看到嗜中性球內少數大顆洋紅色顆粒，問機轉：LYST 突變導致溶酶體/顆粒融合異常，形成巨大溶酶體。
功能缺陷：嗜中性球趨化與殺菌能力下降、NK 與 cytotoxic T 細胞功能受損，易反覆感染與 HLH。
血小板缺乏 dense granules，造成出血傾向；可有進行性神經退化。
Allogeneic HSCT 可矯正血液/免疫缺陷，但無法阻止神經症狀進展。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為被吞噬的細菌或黴菌：病原體形狀規則（球菌、酵母）且常在空泡內；CHS 顆粒大小不一、不規則且為洋紅色。

quiz.q: Chediak-Higashi 症候群除感染外，哪兩個臨床特徵常一起考？
quiz.a: Partial oculocutaneous albinism 與出血傾向（血小板 dense granule 缺乏）

62871.recognize_zh: 低倍下多片腸胃道黏膜切片，固有層被瀰漫性、密集的淋巴樣細胞浸潤而擴張，把腺窩彼此推開；腺窩本身多保留、無明顯破壞或潰瘍。低倍只能看出「固有層擴張的瀰漫浸潤」，診斷需靠高倍與免疫表型。
features: Multiple fragments of gastrointestinal mucosal biopsy
Lamina propria diffusely expanded by a dense, basophilic cellular infiltrate
Crypts spaced apart by the infiltrate but largely preserved, without obvious destruction
No mass-forming sheets with necrosis or ulceration identifiable at this magnification
Low-power view; cytologic detail not assessable
62871.describe_en: Low-power view of multiple gastrointestinal mucosal biopsy fragments shows the lamina propria diffusely expanded by a dense cellular infiltrate that separates and displaces the crypts. The crypts appear largely preserved without evident destruction, ulceration, or necrosis at this magnification. Cytologic features of the infiltrating cells cannot be assessed at this power. The pattern of diffuse, non-destructive lamina propria expansion is compatible with the reported diagnosis of indolent T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder, which requires high-power morphology, immunohistochemistry, and TCR clonality studies for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Shows crypt architectural distortion, cryptitis/crypt abscesses, and basal plasmacytosis rather than a monotonous non-destructive infiltrate.
May also expand the lamina propria, but is a CD20+ B-cell infiltrate often with lymphoepithelial lesions.
Tends to produce transmural or mass lesions with marked epitheliotropism and a high proliferation index.
Forms nodular aggregates of CD5+/cyclin D1+ B cells rather than a diffuse T-cell infiltrate.

62807.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片細胞密度高，三系造血細胞增生，巨核細胞散在且形態大致正常，間質夾雜淋巴球；網狀纖維染色顯示網狀纖維明顯增加，無明顯異型巨核細胞群聚，符合自體免疫性全骨髓增生合併骨髓纖維化的表現。
features: Markedly hypercellular marrow with near-absent fat and preserved bony trabeculae (A)
Trilineage hematopoiesis with scattered megakaryocytes lacking tight clusters or bizarre hyperchromatic nuclei (B)
Admixed small lymphocytes and plasma cells in the interstitium (B)
Diffuse increase in reticulin fibers with an interlacing network on reticulin stain (C)
No osteosclerosis or obvious blast sheets identified
62807.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis and relatively preserved maturation. Megakaryocytes are increased but dispersed, without tight clustering or the bizarre, hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei typical of primary myelofibrosis, and there is an interstitial infiltrate of small lymphocytes. Reticulin stain shows a diffuse increase in reticulin fibers. In the appropriate clinical and serologic context, findings are consistent with autoimmune myelofibrosis (autoimmune panmyelosis with myelofibrosis).

ddx.vs: PMF shows clustered, atypical megakaryocytes with hyperchromatic cloud-like nuclei and a JAK2/CALR/MPL driver mutation, whereas autoimmune myelofibrosis has non-atypical megakaryocytes and no clonal driver.
MDS with fibrosis shows dysplastic small or hypolobated megakaryocytes and cytopenias with clonal cytogenetic or molecular abnormalities.
APMF has increased CD34-positive blasts (at least 20%) and dysplastic megakaryocytes, which are not seen here.

ddx.dx: Metastatic tumor or lymphoma with secondary fibrosis
ddx.vs: Secondary fibrosis is associated with an infiltrate of tumor or lymphoma cells detectable by keratin or lymphoid immunostains.

62743.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中母細胞呈兩群：較小、染色質細緻、細胞質少的淋巴母細胞樣細胞，與較大、細胞質灰藍、核摺疊的單核球樣母細胞；流式細胞儀顯示CD19+的B系母細胞與另一群CD64+、CD33+、CD15+的單核系細胞，符合KMT2A重組的混合表型急性白血病。
features: Peripheral blood with numerous blasts of heterogeneous size (A)
Smaller blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin and scant basophilic cytoplasm (lymphoblast-like)
Larger blasts with moderate grey-blue cytoplasm and folded or indented nuclei (monoblast/promonocyte-like)
Flow cytometry: dominant CD19-positive, CD20-negative, CD10-negative blast population (red) (B)
Separate population (green) expressing CD64, CD33, CD13/33 and CD15 with dim CD14, indicating monocytic differentiation (B)
62743.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis with numerous blasts of heterogeneous appearance, including smaller lymphoblast-like cells with fine chromatin and scant cytoplasm, and larger cells with moderate grey-blue cytoplasm and folded nuclei resembling monoblasts or promonocytes. Flow cytometry demonstrates a predominant CD19-positive blast population lacking CD10 and CD20, together with a distinct population expressing CD64, CD33 and CD15 with minimal CD14, indicating monocytic lineage. The coexistence of separate B-lymphoblastic and monocytic blast populations is consistent with mixed-phenotype acute leukemia (bilineal B/myeloid), which in conjunction with t(4;11)(q21;q23) represents MPAL with KMT2A-AFF1 rearrangement.

ddx.vs: KMT2A-rearranged B-ALL is typically CD10-negative with aberrant CD15 or CD33 expression on the same blasts, whereas MPAL requires a separate population or lineage-defining monocytic markers (CD64, CD14, lysozyme).

ddx.dx: Acute monocytic leukemia with KMT2A rearrangement
ddx.vs: AML with KMT2A rearrangement lacks a CD19-positive B-lymphoblast population with CD79a/PAX5 expression.
Lineage switch is a sequential change in phenotype over time rather than two simultaneous populations at diagnosis.

62679.recognize_zh: 低倍 CD21 染色顯示許多形狀不規則、蛇行狀互相連接的濾泡樹突細胞網（FDC meshworks），密集分布整個切片，網內可見空隙；證實淋巴結被大量擴大的腫瘤性濾泡占據。
features: Low power: numerous expanded, irregular and serpiginous CD21-positive follicular dendritic cell meshworks
Meshworks closely packed and focally interconnected
Reticular (network-like) staining pattern with small central holes
Some meshworks appear disrupted/fragmented with paler centers
Intervening interfollicular zones CD21 negative
62679.describe_en: CD21 immunohistochemistry at low power highlights numerous closely packed, irregular and serpiginous follicular dendritic cell meshworks distributed throughout the node, some interconnected and focally attenuated centrally. The intervening interfollicular zones lack FDC networks. The meshworks confirm a follicular architecture corresponding to the CD20/CD10-positive nodules. Findings are consistent with follicular lymphoma, follicular pattern.

ddx.vs: Reactive follicles have round, well-spaced FDC meshworks, whereas here meshworks are crowded, irregular and back-to-back.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma arising in follicular lymphoma
ddx.vs: Areas of DLBCL show loss of FDC meshworks, which are retained throughout this field.

ddx.dx: Nodal T-follicular helper cell lymphoma (angioimmunoblastic type)
ddx.vs: AITL shows expanded perivascular FDC meshworks outside follicles around HEVs, not discrete nodular meshworks.

62615.recognize_zh: 體液細胞塊中一團圓形細胞呈清楚的環狀細胞膜 CD45 陽性，證明這群大細胞為造血淋巴來源而非上皮細胞；PEL 常保留 CD45 表現。
features: Single cohesive-appearing aggregate of round cells in effusion cell block
Membranous/ring-like CD45 staining in most cells, strong in many
Positive cells include larger cells with vesicular nuclei and smaller lymphocytes
Few isolated faintly stained or degenerated cells in background
Some cells show weak or equivocal staining due to section plane
62615.describe_en: CD45 (leukocyte common antigen) immunohistochemistry on an effusion cell block shows an aggregate of round cells with predominantly strong membranous staining, including the larger atypical cells and admixed small lymphocytes. The aggregate pattern could raise concern for a cohesive epithelial cluster, but CD45 positivity establishes hematolymphoid lineage. In a large-cell effusion lymphoma that lacks B-cell markers and immunoglobulin and is HHV8/LANA-positive, CD45 expression is consistent with primary effusion lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma clusters are CD45-negative and keratin/claudin-4/MOC31-positive.
Mesothelial cells are CD45-negative and calretinin/WT1/D2-40-positive.
Myeloma cells are often CD45-negative or dim and show monotypic light chains, whereas PEL is commonly CD45-positive and Ig-negative.

62551.recognize_zh: CD10 在腫瘤細胞呈弱到中度、完整的細胞膜網狀染色，細胞核大且可見明顯小核仁；表示生發中心 B 細胞（GCB）表現型，雙打擊淋巴瘤多屬此型。
features: Weak to moderate complete membranous CD10 staining in the majority of tumor cells
Large cells with vesicular nuclei and one to several distinct nucleoli visible on the hematoxylin counterstain
Cohesive-appearing sheets with a honeycomb membrane outline
No follicular distribution of staining
62551.describe_en: CD10 immunohistochemistry shows weak to moderate, complete membranous staining in the majority of neoplastic cells, producing a honeycomb pattern across diffuse sheets. The counterstained nuclei are large and vesicular with distinct nucleoli. CD10 positivity indicates a germinal center B-cell phenotype, which is the usual immunophenotype of high-grade B-cell lymphoma with MYC and BCL2 rearrangements, and is also seen in Burkitt lymphoma and GCB-type DLBCL.

ddx.vs: Burkitt is also CD10-positive but is BCL2-negative with a Ki67 near 100% and MYC rearrangement only.
ABC-type DLBCL is CD10-negative and MUM1-positive and rarely carries BCL2 with MYC rearrangement.
MCL is usually CD10-negative and cyclin D1-positive.

62487.recognize_zh: 同一視野中出現兩顆顆粒粗大深紫的嗜鹼性球，另有一顆嗜中性球，背景血小板偏多；嗜鹼性球比例偏高提示 CML 加速期。
features: Two basophils with coarse, dark metachromatic granules overlying the nuclei
One segmented neutrophil with condensed lobed nucleus
Basophils outnumber neutrophils in this field
Increased platelets scattered in the background
Red cells normocytic with mild anisocytosis; no blasts seen
62487.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two basophils with coarse dark granules and a single segmented neutrophil, with platelets appearing increased. Red cells are largely normocytic with mild anisocytosis, and no blasts are identified in this field. The relative prominence of basophils suggests basophilia. In BCR::ABL1-positive CML, peripheral basophils of at least 20% support accelerated phase, which must be confirmed by a full differential count.

ddx.vs: Chronic phase basophilia is usually below 20%, so quantification on a full differential is needed to separate phases.
Circulating mast cells are larger with oval nuclei not obscured by granules and are CD117/tryptase positive, whereas basophils have lobulated nuclei covered by granules.
Other MPNs may show mild basophilia but lack BCR::ABL1.

62423.recognize_zh: 抹片薄邊處兩顆白血球：上方嗜中性球雙葉核、細胞質佈滿粗大深紫色毒性顆粒（toxic granulation）；下方細胞核圓至腎形、細胞質淡而帶顆粒與小空泡——這些反應性變化提示感染或發炎（如敗血症）。
features: Neutrophil with bilobed nucleus and cytoplasm filled with coarse, dark purple toxic granules
Second cell (monocyte-like) with round to reniform nucleus and pale cytoplasm containing coarse granules and fine vacuoles
Cytoplasmic vacuolization in the leukocytes
Red cells at the thin feathered edge with crenation/drying artifact
No blasts or intracellular organisms clearly identified in this field
62423.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, photographed near the feathered edge, shows two leukocytes with prominent reactive changes. A neutrophil contains abundant coarse, dark toxic granules, and an adjacent monocyte-like cell has a round to reniform nucleus with pale, granular and finely vacuolated cytoplasm. Red cells show crenation related to the thin edge of the smear. No organisms are identified in this field. Findings are consistent with reactive leukocyte changes (toxic granulation and cytoplasmic vacuolization), suggestive of infection or systemic inflammation such as sepsis.

ddx.vs: Growth factor therapy produces identical toxic granulation and Döhle bodies, so drug history is needed to separate it from sepsis.
Alder-Reilly granules are present in all leukocyte lineages including lymphocytes and are not accompanied by vacuolization or clinical infection.
Prolonged EDTA storage causes neutrophil vacuoles without toxic granulation, so a fresh smear resolves the question.
Promyelocytes and myelocytes have round nuclei with nucleoli or less condensed chromatin, whereas these cells have mature segmented or reniform nuclei.

exam.answer_en: Reactive (toxic) leukocyte changes — neutrophil with coarse toxic granulation and cytoplasmic vacuolization, suggesting infection/sepsis
pearls_zh: 考法：要求說出三大毒性變化：toxic granulation、Döhle bodies、cytoplasmic vacuolization，並指出圖中出現哪幾種。
臨床連結：嗜中性球空泡化與菌血症/敗血症相關性較高，應提醒臨床抽血培養；常與左移（bands 增加）同時出現。
非感染原因：G-CSF 治療、妊娠、燒傷或發炎也可見毒性顆粒；血液檢體放置過久亦會出現假性空泡。
toxic granulation 為原本的 primary granules 因成熟加速而保留嗜天青染色，並非新的病原或包涵體。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Alder-Reilly anomaly：其粗大顆粒見於所有嗜中性球甚至淋巴球、與黏多醣症相關且無感染；毒性顆粒伴空泡、Döhle bodies 並隨感染改善消失。

quiz.q: 列出嗜中性球的三種毒性變化，並指出哪一種最提示菌血症。
quiz.a: Toxic granulation、Döhle bodies、vacuolization；vacuolization

62359.recognize_zh: 密集的腫瘤細胞全部為藍色 CD8 陰性，只有少數散在的小型反應性 T 細胞呈棕色陽性，可作為內部陽性對照。
features: Diffuse sheet of medium-sized cells with irregular oval nuclei, CD8-negative
Rare scattered small CD8-positive cells with strong membranous/cytoplasmic staining (reactive T cells)
Positive internal control cells confirm adequate staining
Tumor nuclei show fine chromatin on hematoxylin counterstain
62359.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD8 shows that the diffuse population of tumor cells is negative. Scattered small reactive T cells are strongly positive and serve as an internal control. Combined with CD4 expression, the tumor shows a CD4-positive, CD8-negative profile, which in the context of CD3 and TdT positivity is consistent with T-lymphoblastic leukemia/lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Double-positive cortical T-LBL would show CD8 expression in the tumor sheet, not only in scattered cells.

ddx.dx: Cytotoxic peripheral T-cell or NK/T-cell lymphoma
ddx.vs: These are frequently CD8+ with TIA-1/granzyme expression and are TdT-negative.

62295.recognize_zh: EDTA 抹片中箭頭指出三團血小板凝集，團內有數顆體積偏大的血小板，其餘視野游離血小板稀少，紅血球形態正常，說明自動計數偏低是凝集造成的假性血小板減少（spurious thrombocytopenia），應以檸檬酸管重測。
features: Three discrete clumps of aggregated platelets marked by arrows
Several enlarged platelets within the aggregates
Relatively few free-lying single platelets outside the clumps
Normocytic, normochromic red cells without fragments
No platelet satellitism around leukocytes in this field
62295.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear from an EDTA-anticoagulated specimen shows three discrete platelet aggregates, marked by arrows, containing platelets of variable size including several large forms. Single free platelets outside the aggregates are relatively few. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic without schistocytes, and no leukocytes with platelet satellitism are present in this field. Findings indicate in vitro platelet clumping causing a spuriously low automated platelet count, confirmed by a normal count on a citrated sample.

ddx.vs: ITP shows evenly scattered, often large platelets that are genuinely reduced without clumps, and the count remains low in citrate.
Giant platelets in MYH9-related disease or Bernard-Soulier syndrome are dispersed singly rather than aggregated, with a persistently low count in any anticoagulant.
Satellitism shows platelets adhering around neutrophils rather than free-standing platelet clumps.
True consumptive thrombocytopenia shows a low count on smear review and in citrate, without in vitro aggregates.

exam.answer_en: Spurious (pseudo)thrombocytopenia — platelet clumps on the EDTA smear causing a falsely low automated platelet count
pearls_zh: 考法：給一張血小板很少但有團塊的抹片，問「血小板真的低嗎、下一步做什麼」：先看抹片邊緣（feathered edge）找團塊，再以 citrate 管重抽計數。
機轉：EDTA-dependent 抗體（多針對 GPIIb/IIIa 上被 EDTA 暴露的抗原決定位）在體外造成血小板凝集，屬實驗室假象，無出血風險。
citrate 管計數需乘以稀釋校正係數（約 1.1）；也可用 fingerstick 直接抹片或 heparin 管，部分病人在 citrate 仍會凝集。
其他原因：抽血困難導致部分凝固、GP IIb/IIIa inhibitor（如 abciximab）、platelet satellitism；大血小板被計成紅血球也會使計數偏低。
臨床意義：健康捐血者或無出血症狀卻血小板低，要先排除假性，避免不必要的輸血、骨髓檢查或延誤手術。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易被當成真性血小板低下（如 ITP）而直接處置：抹片可見血小板團塊、單顆血小板稀少，且 citrate 管重測數值正常即可區分。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指的結構是什麼？此捐血者自動計數血小板偏低，應如何確認真實數值？
quiz.a: Platelet clumps（EDTA 引起凝集）；改用 sodium citrate 管重抽計數並看抹片確認

62103.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中可見大片交錯束狀排列的梭形細胞增生，細胞之間有裂隙狀血管腔與外滲紅血球；免疫染色顯示梭形細胞核呈棕色陽性（符合 HHV-8 LANA），配合 HIV 背景，指向 Kaposi 肉瘤侵犯骨髓。
features: Panel A: bone marrow core with extensive replacement of marrow by a cellular spindle cell lesion
Panel B: fascicles of spindle cells forming slit-like vascular spaces with extravasated red cells and scattered hyaline/clear vacuoles
Panel C: strong nuclear brown immunoreactivity in the spindle cells, consistent with HHV-8 (LANA)
Panel D inset: red chromogen stain highlighting spindle cell fascicles (antibody not labeled)
Panels E-G: additional IHC stains highlighting infiltrating clusters and large dark-staining cells (antibodies not labeled)
Low-resolution composite limits nuclear detail and marker identification
62103.describe_en: Composite of bone marrow core biopsy images. At low power (A) the marrow is extensively effaced by a cellular lesion, and at high power (B) it is composed of intersecting fascicles of spindle cells forming slit-like vascular channels with extravasated erythrocytes. Immunohistochemistry (C) shows diffuse nuclear positivity in the spindle cells, consistent with HHV-8 LANA, and additional stains (D-G; antibodies not labeled in the figure) highlight the infiltrate and scattered clusters of large positive cells. The image resolution limits evaluation of individual markers. In a patient with HIV, findings are consistent with extensive bone marrow involvement by Kaposi sarcoma.

ddx.vs: Fibrotic stroma lacks slit-like vascular spaces with extravasated red cells and is negative for HHV-8 LANA and endothelial markers.

ddx.dx: Systemic mastocytosis with spindled mast cells
ddx.vs: Spindled mast cell aggregates are tryptase/CD117/CD25-positive and HHV-8-negative, without vascular slits.
Shows endothelial markers with greater nuclear pleomorphism and anastomosing vessels, but lacks nuclear HHV-8 LANA staining.
Consists of spindled histiocytes that are CD68-positive and packed with acid-fast bacilli, and HHV-8-negative.

62103.stain: H&E; IHC (HHV-8 LANA and others, unlabeled)

61975.recognize_zh: 低倍 CD20 免疫染色中，真皮浸潤裡有大片 CD20 陽性 B 細胞聚集區，與陰性（藍色）的 T 細胞區交錯分布，並環繞圓形的纖維性結構；T 細胞病灶中混有大量反應性 B 細胞，是 CD4+ 小/中型 T 細胞增生性疾病的常見背景。
features: Low-power view of a dense dermal lymphoid infiltrate
Large confluent aggregates of CD20-positive B cells, some nodular
Intermixed CD20-negative zones representing the T-cell component
Rounded fibrous structures (adnexal or vascular profiles) surrounded by the infiltrate
Numerous B cells in a mixed rather than monotonous distribution
61975.describe_en: Low-power CD20 immunostain on a skin biopsy shows a dense dermal lymphoid infiltrate containing large, partly nodular aggregates of CD20-positive B cells intermixed with CD20-negative T-cell-rich areas, surrounding rounded fibrous adnexal or vascular structures. The B cells constitute a substantial, reactive-appearing component of the infiltrate. A prominent reactive B-cell population is characteristic of primary cutaneous CD4-positive small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorder, but it requires light-chain studies to exclude a primary cutaneous B-cell lymphoma.

ddx.dx: Primary cutaneous marginal zone lymphoproliferative disorder
ddx.vs: This entity shows CD20+ marginal zone B cells and monotypic plasma cells by kappa/lambda ISH, with reactive T cells as the minority rather than a PD-1+ CD4+ T-cell predominance.
Follicle center lymphoma shows sheets or follicles of CD20+/BCL6+ centrocytes and centroblasts, often with disrupted CD21 meshworks, rather than a T-cell-dominant infiltrate.
Pseudolymphoma has reactive germinal centers with polarized BCL2-negative follicles and polytypic plasma cells, without an atypical PD-1+ medium-sized T-cell population.

61911.recognize_zh: TCR-βF1染色下，皮下脂肪與真皮間的淋巴樣浸潤中有一部分細胞呈棕色陽性（αβ型T細胞），另有相當比例細胞為陰性；陽性提示浸潤至少部分為αβ T細胞，陰性者可能為γδ T或NK細胞，HV-LPD可以是T或NK細胞型，需搭配CD56、TCRγ與EBER判讀。
features: TCR-beta-F1 positivity in a subset of lymphoid cells within the subcutaneous and deep dermal infiltrate
Positive cells are small to medium-sized with membranous and cytoplasmic staining, some with fine dendritic-like processes
A substantial proportion of infiltrating cells is negative
Adipocytes and stromal cells negative; positive cells distributed interstitially and between fat cells
61911.describe_en: TCR-beta-F1 immunohistochemistry on the subcutaneous and deep dermal lymphoid infiltrate shows staining of a subset of small to medium-sized lymphocytes distributed interstitially and between adipocytes, while a substantial proportion of the infiltrate is negative. This indicates that at least part of the infiltrate consists of alpha-beta T cells, and the negative cells may represent NK cells or gamma-delta T cells. Hydroa vacciniforme lymphoproliferative disorder may be of cytotoxic T-cell (alpha-beta or gamma-delta) or NK-cell lineage, so this stain should be interpreted with CD56, TCR-gamma, cytotoxic markers and EBER.

ddx.vs: Gamma-delta TCL is uniformly TCR-beta-F1-negative and TCR-gamma-positive, EBER-negative, whereas this infiltrate contains a beta-F1-positive subset.
SPTCL is diffusely beta-F1-positive and CD8-positive with adipocyte rimming and EBER negativity.
ENKTL of NK type is beta-F1-negative and CD56-positive with angiodestruction, necrosis and EBER positivity.

61847.recognize_zh: CD68 染色中，成群的大型泡沫狀組織球呈強烈顆粒狀細胞質陽性，被陰性的梭形纖維母細胞與纖維間隔分隔成巢狀；證實浸潤細胞為組織球系，符合 Erdheim-Chester 病。
features: Clusters and sheets of large histiocytes with strong granular cytoplasmic CD68 staining
Foamy cytoplasmic texture preserved within positive cells
Intervening fibrous septa with CD68-negative spindle fibroblasts
Scattered small CD68-positive histiocytes within stroma
Thin-walled vessels negative for CD68
61847.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD68 highlights nests and sheets of large histiocytes with strong granular cytoplasmic positivity, many retaining a foamy cytoplasmic appearance. The positive cells are separated by fibrous septa containing CD68-negative spindle fibroblasts and vessels. CD68 confirms histiocytic lineage but is not specific; in combination with CD163 and factor XIIIa positivity, CD1a/Langerin negativity, and BRAF V600E or other MAPK alterations, findings are consistent with Erdheim-Chester disease.

ddx.vs: LCH cells are weak/dot-like for CD68 and strongly positive for CD1a and Langerin, which are negative in ECD.
RDD histiocytes are CD68+ as well but are strongly S100 positive with emperipolesis.
Reactive foamy macrophages share CD68 positivity, so distinction requires clinical-radiologic features and MAPK pathway mutation testing.
Fibrohistiocytic tumors are dominated by spindle cells with only scattered CD68+ macrophages rather than sheets of CD68+ foamy histiocytes.

61719.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片 CD56 免疫染色：大量中等大小、染色質細緻的腫瘤細胞呈明顯細胞膜／胞質棕色陽性，陽性細胞密集散布於浸潤區，與 CD4、CD123 共同陽性時即指向 BPDCN。
features: Many intermediate-sized tumor cells with crisp membranous and cytoplasmic CD56 staining
Positive cells are numerous and diffusely distributed, admixed with negative cells
Negative cells include smaller background hematopoietic elements with round blue nuclei
Tumor nuclei round to slightly irregular with fine chromatin on hematoxylin counterstain
Scattered hemosiderin-like brown granular pigment is present and should not be mistaken for staining
61719.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for CD56 on a bone marrow biopsy highlights numerous intermediate-sized neoplastic cells with membranous and cytoplasmic positivity, distributed diffusely through the section. Admixed smaller hematopoietic cells are negative, and scattered granular brown pigment is present in the background. CD56 expression is characteristic of, but not specific for, blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm, and must be interpreted together with CD4, CD123, TCF4 and TCL1 positivity and lack of lineage-specific markers. Findings support involvement by BPDCN in the appropriate immunophenotypic context.

ddx.vs: NK/T-cell lymphoma is CD56+ but also cytoplasmic CD3+, cytotoxic granule+ and EBER+, and is CD123/TCF4-negative.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with monocytic differentiation (including myeloid sarcoma)
ddx.vs: Monocytic AML can be CD4+/CD56+ but expresses lysozyme, CD14/CD163 and often MPO, and lacks the uniform CD123-bright/TCF4/TCL1 profile.
Myeloma cells are CD56+ but are CD138+ with cytoplasmic light-chain restriction and show plasmacytoid cytology with abundant cytoplasm.

61655.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片可見單一形態的細胞片狀排列，胞質豐富、呈淡粉紅細顆粒狀且細胞邊界清楚，核圓至摺疊、部分呈雙葉狀，符合 APL 異常前骨髓細胞在切片上的表現。
features: Monotonous sheets of cells with abundant finely granular pink cytoplasm
Distinct cell borders producing a mosaic pattern
Nuclei round to indented, some folded or bilobed, with fine chromatin
Near-complete replacement of normal hematopoiesis
Background hemorrhage (extravasated red cells)
61655.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at high power shows diffuse sheets of monotonous cells with abundant, finely granular eosinophilic cytoplasm and distinct cell borders. Nuclei are round to indented, with some folded or bilobed forms and fine chromatin. Normal hematopoietic elements are nearly absent, and interstitial hemorrhage is present. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia in the appropriate context; PML::RARA confirmation is required.

ddx.vs: AML with maturation has blasts with scantier cytoplasm and a spectrum of maturing myeloid cells rather than a monotonous granular population; PML::RARA is negative.
Monoblasts/promonocytes have abundant gray cytoplasm and delicately folded nuclei but lack coarse granules and are MPO weak with CD14/CD163/lysozyme positivity.
Mast cells are tryptase- and CD117-positive with metachromatic granules and are MPO-negative, whereas APL cells are strongly MPO-positive.

61591.recognize_zh: 高倍下肝竇內浸潤細胞形態混雜：核大、染色質細緻帶小核仁或核有摺痕的未成熟髓系/單核系細胞，夾雜深黑小圓核的紅血球前驅細胞與分節核中性球；多系混合而非單一母細胞群，是 JMML 肝臟浸潤的特徵。
features: Sinusoids between hepatocyte plates filled by a polymorphous hematopoietic infiltrate
Immature myelomonocytic cells with round to reniform/folded nuclei, vesicular fine chromatin and small nucleoli
Erythroid precursors with small, round, very dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Scattered segmented and band granulocytes
Elongated endothelial nuclei lining sinusoids; hepatocytes preserved
61591.describe_en: High-power H&E section of liver shows sinusoids expanded by a polymorphous hematopoietic infiltrate between intact hepatocyte plates. The infiltrate consists of immature myelomonocytic cells with round to folded nuclei, fine vesicular chromatin and small nucleoli, admixed with erythroid precursors with dense round nuclei and scattered band and segmented granulocytes. A monotonous sheet of blasts is not present, and megakaryocytes are not identified in this field. Findings are consistent with hepatic sinusoidal involvement by juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia in the appropriate clinical and genetic setting.

ddx.vs: Includes megakaryocytes and orderly erythroid/granulocytic maturation without monocytic predominance and occurs in a non-clonal setting.
Composed of a monotonous population of blasts with little maturation, highlighted by CD34/CD117.
Cells have grooved, coffee-bean nuclei with eosinophils and are CD1a/langerin-positive, mainly in portal tracts/bile ducts.

61527.recognize_zh: PAX5 染色中周圍小型反應性 B 細胞呈深褐色強核染，中央一群大型 Hodgkin/lacunar 細胞核只呈淡而弱的 PAX5 陽性，這種「大細胞弱陽性、小 B 細胞強陽性」的對比是 CHL 的經典免疫染色表現。
features: Clusters of small background B cells with strong dark brown nuclear PAX5 staining
Central aggregate of large Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg and lacunar cells with weak, pale nuclear PAX5
Large cells show vesicular, lobated or binucleate nuclei outlined by the faint stain
Admixed PAX5-negative small T cells and histiocytes (blue nuclei)
Large cell with faint granular cytoplasmic blush at top center, likely nonspecific
61527.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain for PAX5 on a lymph node shows clusters of small reactive B cells with strong nuclear staining at the periphery of the field. A central aggregate of large Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg and lacunar cells, some with lobated or binucleate nuclei, shows weak nuclear PAX5 staining that is distinctly dimmer than the background B cells. Intervening small T cells and histiocytes are negative. Weak PAX5 expression in the large neoplastic cells is characteristic of classic Hodgkin lymphoma, here of nodular sclerosis type in conjunction with the H&E findings.

ddx.vs: LP cells show strong PAX5 and CD20 of equal intensity to background B cells, with OCT2/BOB1 retained and CD30/CD15 negative.
ALCL tumor cells are PAX5-negative, whereas these large cells retain weak PAX5.

ddx.dx: Primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma or mediastinal gray zone lymphoma
ddx.vs: PMBL cells show strong PAX5 and CD20 in sheets; gray zone lymphoma has sheets of pleomorphic cells with strong PAX5/CD20 and CD30 expression.

exam.answer_en: Classic Hodgkin lymphoma, nodular sclerosis — HRS/lacunar cells with weak nuclear PAX5 versus strongly positive background B cells
pearls_zh: 考法：要你比較同一視野的兩種強度—大型 HRS 細胞 PAX5 弱陽性、小 B 細胞強陽性；這個對比本身就是答案，並可作為內部對照。
PAX5 弱陽性證明 HRS 細胞源自 B 細胞；B 細胞轉錄程式大量流失（CD20、CD79a、OCT2、BOB1 下降）是 CHL 的特徵。
鑑別用途：ALCL 的腫瘤細胞 PAX5 陰性，可藉此區分 CD30+ 大細胞；NLPHL 的 LP 細胞則 PAX5、CD20、OCT2 強陽性。
PAX5 弱陽性加上 CD30+、CD15+、CD45 陰性即構成 CHL 的經典免疫表型組合。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把弱陽性判為陰性而改考慮 ALCL，或把強陽性判為 DLBCL/NLPHL；關鍵是以背景小 B 細胞為對照，HRS 細胞為明確但較淡的核染。

quiz.q: 這張 PAX5 染色中，大型 HRS 細胞與周圍小 B 細胞的染色強度有何差異？這支持什麼診斷？
quiz.a: HRS 細胞弱陽性、小 B 細胞強陽性；classic Hodgkin lymphoma

61463.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫染色中，陽性（棕色）細胞呈線狀、條索狀聚集於竇狀隙內（intrasinusoidal），與周圍陰性的造血細胞分開，這種竇內分布型態是肝脾 T 細胞淋巴瘤的典型線索。
features: Bone marrow core with preserved fat and hypercellular hematopoietic tissue
Immunostain highlights cohesive clusters of positive cells arranged in linear and branching cords, conforming to sinusoidal spaces
Positive cells are small to medium-sized and densely packed within dilated sinusoids
Intervening interstitial hematopoietic cells are largely negative
