Subtle intrasinusoidal distribution would be difficult to appreciate on H&E alone
61463.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy immunostain shows a hypercellular marrow in which positive lymphoid cells are distributed predominantly within sinusoids, forming linear, branching and cord-like aggregates between fat spaces. The intervening hematopoietic elements are negative. The specific antibody is not labeled; the pattern is typical of a T-cell marker such as CD3. An intrasinusoidal T-cell infiltrate of this type is characteristic of hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma in the appropriate clinical and immunophenotypic context (CD3+, CD4-/CD8-, TCR gamma-delta, cytotoxic TIA-1+/granzyme B-, isochromosome 7q).

ddx.vs: Also shows intrasinusoidal CD8+ T-cell rows but the cells are CD8+ and TCR alpha-beta with activated cytotoxic markers, lacking i(7q).
Cells are surface CD3-negative, CD56+, and EBER-positive, with a more interstitial and less sinusoid-restricted pattern.
Intrasinusoidal cells are large and CD20+/PAX5+ rather than small to medium T cells.
Reactive T cells are scattered and sparse rather than forming dense cohesive cords, and lack clonal TCR rearrangement.

exam.answer_en: Hepatosplenic T-cell lymphoma — T-cell marker immunostain highlights intrasinusoidal lymphoid infiltrate in marrow
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍看陽性細胞排列成線狀、分支狀的 sinusoidal 分佈，問「這種浸潤型態最典型的淋巴瘤」→ HSTCL。
典型表型：CD3+、CD4−/CD8−（部分 CD8+）、CD5−、TCR γδ（少數 αβ）、TIA-1+ 但 granzyme B/perforin 常陰性。
特徵性細胞遺傳：isochromosome 7q [i(7q)]，常合併 trisomy 8；STAT5B/STAT3、SETD2 突變常見。
臨床：年輕男性、肝脾腫大、無淋巴結腫大、血小板低下；與免疫抑制（如 thiopurine 合併 anti-TNF 治療 IBD）相關，預後極差。
骨髓 H&E 常只呈細微改變，需靠 CD3/CD2 等 IHC 才看得出竇內浸潤。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 T-LGL leukemia 的竇內浸潤；T-LGL 多為 CD8+ αβ、granzyme B+、病程緩慢且無明顯肝脾腫大，HSTCL 則為 CD4/CD8 雙陰性 γδ 伴 i(7q)。

quiz.q: 此骨髓 T 細胞標記染色呈現何種浸潤型態？最常伴隨的細胞遺傳異常為何？
quiz.a: Intrasinusoidal pattern；isochromosome 7q

61399.recognize_zh: 低倍周邊血液抹片中可見數顆中大型、核質比高且核染色質細緻的母細胞，並混有單核球樣細胞、帶狀嗜中性球及一顆有核紅血球，呈未成熟造血細胞出現於周邊血液的樣貌，符合急性骨髓性白血病。
features: Several medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio, round to oval nuclei and scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm
Occasional cells with folded or kidney-shaped nuclei and more cytoplasm (monocytoid/immature myeloid cells)
A nucleated red blood cell and a band neutrophil present
Small mature lymphocyte for size comparison
Red cells show mild anisocytosis; nuclear and cytoplasmic detail limited at this magnification
61399.describe_en: Low-power peripheral blood smear shows scattered circulating blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio and round to oval nuclei, accompanied by monocytoid/immature myeloid cells with folded nuclei, a band neutrophil, a nucleated red blood cell and a small lymphocyte. Red cells show mild anisocytosis. Auer rods and nucleolar detail cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Findings are suggestive of acute myeloid leukemia with circulating blasts and immature hematopoietic cells, to be confirmed by blast enumeration and flow cytometry.

ddx.vs: Leukoerythroblastosis shows a spectrum of maturing myeloid cells and teardrop cells with few blasts, rather than a blast-dominant population.
CMML shows persistent monocytosis with mature monocytes and fewer than 20% blasts/promonocytes.
Lymphoblasts lack monocytoid/myeloid accompaniment and are MPO-negative and TdT-positive.

61335.recognize_zh: 中央有一顆淋巴樣細胞，細胞質少、呈淡藍色，細胞核深度摺疊呈腦迴狀／花瓣狀多葉（cerebriform），與旁邊的嗜酸性球、嗜中性球與空泡化的單核球／巨噬細胞明顯不同，符合皮膚 T 細胞淋巴瘤（Sézary 細胞）侵犯骨髓。
features: Central lymphoid cell with scant rim of pale blue cytoplasm and a deeply folded, lobulated (cerebriform) nucleus with dense chromatin and no visible nucleolus
Adjacent eosinophil with bilobed-to-trilobed nucleus and orange-red granules (upper left)
Segmented neutrophil with round separated lobes and pale granular cytoplasm (right)
Vacuolated monocyte/macrophage with folded nucleus and gray-blue cytoplasm (lower left)
Red cells in thin areas; occasional platelet clumps and stain precipitate
61335.describe_en: Aspirate smear shows a mixture of mature cells, including an eosinophil, a segmented neutrophil and a vacuolated monocyte/macrophage. Among them is an atypical lymphoid cell with scant pale blue cytoplasm and a markedly convoluted, lobulated cerebriform nucleus with condensed chromatin and inconspicuous nucleoli. A single cell is insufficient to quantify involvement, and interstitial infiltration should be assessed on the core biopsy with immunohistochemistry. In a patient with mycosis fungoides or Sézary syndrome, the finding is consistent with involvement by cutaneous T-cell lymphoma (Sézary-type cells).

ddx.vs: Flower cells show polylobated clover-leaf nuclei with more cytoplasmic basophilia, and HTLV-1 serology and CD25 positivity distinguish it.
Only occasional mildly indented nuclei with preserved CD7/CD26 expression, without a clonal CD4+ population.
Has abundant gray-blue vacuolated cytoplasm and lacy chromatin, unlike the scant cytoplasm and dense chromatin of the cerebriform lymphocyte.
Cells have a single visible nucleolus and cytoplasmic blebs, with very high lymphocyte counts and TCL1 rearrangement.

61271.recognize_zh: 此抹片可見幾團粉紅色、細絲網狀的物質，上面疊著紅血球輪廓，另有散在的小至中型、核深染、細胞質極少的圓形細胞；在神經母細胞瘤骨髓轉移的背景下，這些網狀物質可對應神經纖維基質（neuropil）或破碎的腫瘤細胞，但本張解析度與染色品質有限，無法明確辨認成團的腫瘤細胞。
features: Several pink, finely fibrillary to lacy aggregates with overlying red cell outlines (neuropil-like material versus smudged/crushed cells)
Scattered small to intermediate round cells with dense hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Occasional normal marrow elements, including a band neutrophil and a cell with distorted nucleus
No cohesive clusters or rosettes clearly identified in this field; arrow points to an area without a distinct cell
Eyepiece photograph with strong pink-yellow cast and blurred detail, limiting interpretation
61271.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows scattered pink fibrillary aggregates with a lacy texture, overlapped by red cells, together with scattered small round cells with dense nuclei and scant cytoplasm and occasional maturing granulocytes. Cohesive tumor clusters or Homer Wright rosettes are not clearly seen in this field, and the color cast and focus limit assessment of chromatin and cytoplasmic detail. The fibrillary material may represent neuropil or crushed tumor cells, but this is not definitive on this image alone. Findings are suggestive of, but not diagnostic for, marrow involvement by neuroblastoma; correlation with other fields, biopsy and immunohistochemistry (PHOX2B, synaptophysin, CD56) is required.

ddx.vs: Smear artifact produces bare nuclear streaks without true fibrillary neuropil or molded tumor clusters, and is common in hypocellular or traumatic aspirates.
Platelet aggregates are granular purple rather than fibrillary pink and lack associated small round tumor cells.
These also form small round blue cell clusters but lack neuropil; distinguished by myogenin/desmin or CD99/NKX2.2 immunostains.
Lymphoblasts are dispersed singly without clusters or fibrillary matrix and express TdT/CD19 or CD3 rather than neural markers.

61207.recognize_zh: 影像中央一個組織球的細胞質內擠滿大小一致、約 2–4 µm 的卵圓形小體，每個周圍帶有透明暈（halo），符合莢膜組織漿菌（Histoplasma capsulatum）的細胞內酵母型。
features: Macrophage (partly obscured by adjacent cells) containing a cluster of numerous small, uniform oval yeast-like organisms about 2-4 um
Each organism has a small eccentric purple-staining body surrounded by a clear halo (pseudocapsule artifact)
Organisms are intracellular and tightly packed, without hyphae or budding chains
Background of maturing myeloid cells (bands, metamyelocytes, myelocytes) and fat vacuoles of a marrow aspirate
A thin strand of stretched nuclear/fibrin material crosses the field (smear artifact)
61207.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixed population of maturing granulocytic precursors with scattered fat vacuoles. A histiocyte in the center contains numerous small, uniform, oval intracellular yeast forms measuring approximately 2-4 um, each with a small dense chromatin dot and a surrounding clear halo; no hyphae are seen. Findings are consistent with intracellular Histoplasma capsulatum; confirmation with fungal culture, antigen testing or special stains (GMS/PAS) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania amastigotes have a distinct rod-shaped kinetoplast next to the nucleus and lack the clear halo, and they do not stain with GMS or PAS.
T. marneffei yeasts are more variable, elongated and divide by a central transverse septum rather than budding; travel history to Southeast Asia and culture help separate them.
Toxoplasma organisms are crescent-shaped with a central nucleus and no halo, and are GMS/PAS negative.
C. glabrata yeasts are slightly larger, may show pseudohyphae in tissue, and are identified by culture rather than morphology alone.

exam.answer_en: Histoplasmosis in bone marrow — macrophage packed with uniform 2–4 µm intracellular yeasts with clear halos, no kinetoplast
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指組織球內一群帶透明暈的小圓體，問病原 → Histoplasma capsulatum；關鍵是大小一致、有 halo、以窄基出芽（narrow-based budding）繁殖、無 kinetoplast。
特殊染色：GMS、PAS 陽性（真菌細胞壁）；Leishmania 為原蟲，GMS/PAS 陰性，可藉此區分。
診斷工具：尿液與血清 Histoplasma antigen 敏感度高，適合 disseminated disease；並送 fungal culture、血液培養。免疫低下（HIV、TNF inhibitor、移植）者較易瀰漫性感染。
治療：中重度瀰漫性感染先用 liposomal amphotericin B，再改 itraconazole 維持；瀰漫性組織漿菌症可合併 HLH 與血球低下。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤認為 Leishmania（Leishman-Donovan bodies）：Leishmania 有核加上旁邊棒狀 kinetoplast、無透明暈且 GMS 陰性；Histoplasma 有 halo、無 kinetoplast。亦需與 Talaromyces 的橫隔分裂區分。

quiz.q: 圖中組織球內帶透明暈的小酵母最可能是哪種病原？與 Leishmania 區分的形態特徵是什麼？
quiz.a: Histoplasma capsulatum；Leishmania 有棒狀 kinetoplast，Histoplasma 沒有（且 GMS/PAS 陽性）

61143.recognize_zh: CD2 免疫染色下，只有少數小型圓核細胞呈強陽性（背景 T/NK 細胞），左下一顆大型、細胞質豐富的細胞呈細顆粒狀弱陽性，其餘卵圓至腎形核的腫瘤細胞大多陰性，符合肥大細胞白血病中 CD2 僅少數腫瘤細胞表現。
features: Scattered small lymphocytes with dense round nuclei show strong membranous/cytoplasmic CD2 staining
Rare large cell with abundant cytoplasm shows weak, fine granular cytoplasmic CD2 positivity
Majority of cells are medium to large with oval, indented or reniform nuclei, fine chromatin and pale cytoplasm, negative for CD2
Loosely cohesive diffuse infiltrate; no specific architecture assessable at this magnification
Light hematoxylin counterstain; no significant nonspecific background staining
61143.describe_en: CD2 immunohistochemistry on a biopsy involved by a diffuse infiltrate of medium to large cells with oval to reniform nuclei and pale cytoplasm. The majority of the infiltrating cells are negative, while rare large cells show weak granular cytoplasmic staining. Strong CD2 staining is seen in scattered small, round lymphocytes that represent background T/NK cells. Aberrant CD2 expression is limited to rare neoplastic cells; this finding supports, but in isolation does not establish, involvement by neoplastic mast cells, and correlation with tryptase, CD117 and CD25 is required.

ddx.vs: In a reactive infiltrate the CD2-positive cells are small lymphocytes, whereas here the dominant large cell population is largely CD2 negative and requires tryptase/CD117 confirmation.
Monocytic blasts also have reniform nuclei but express CD14/CD163/lysozyme and lack tryptase and CD25 co-expression.
LCH cells have grooved nuclei with eosinophil-rich background and are CD1a/langerin positive, tryptase negative.

61079.recognize_zh: 網狀纖維染色下，血管周圍的網狀纖維被撐開成多層同心圓狀，淋巴瘤細胞夾在各層纖維之間呈袖套狀包繞血管（angiocentric pattern），這是中樞神經原發 DLBCL 的特徵性生長方式。
features: Silver-impregnated reticulin fibers (black) around blood vessels split into multiple concentric layers
Tumor cells infiltrate between the reticulin layers, forming perivascular cuffs (angiocentric growth)
Several small vessels with thickened, concentrically laminated reticulin collars
Surrounding dense diffuse cellular infiltrate with only delicate background reticulin
Individual cytology not assessable on this special stain
61079.describe_en: Reticulin stain of the brain lesion shows a diffuse cellular infiltrate with striking angiocentric growth: perivascular reticulin fibers are split into multiple concentric layers by infiltrating tumor cells, forming onion-skin-like cuffs around both large and small vessels. The intervening parenchyma shows only delicate reticulin. Cytologic detail cannot be evaluated on this stain. Findings are consistent with the perivascular growth pattern of primary diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the CNS, to be confirmed with H&E and B-cell immunostains.

ddx.vs: Glioblastoma shows pseudopalisading necrosis and microvascular proliferation, with GFAP+ tumor cells lacking layered perivascular reticulin cuffs.
Inflammatory cuffs are thin, composed of small mixed T cells and macrophages, and do not split reticulin into multiple layers with large atypical cells.
Carcinoma forms cohesive nests surrounded by reticulin rather than individual cells between reticulin layers, and is keratin positive.
LYG shows angiocentric and angiodestructive polymorphous infiltrates with EBV+ large B cells in a T-cell-rich background, typically in lung.

exam.answer_en: Primary DLBCL of the CNS — reticulin stain showing angiocentric growth with perivascular reticulin split into concentric layers
pearls_zh: 考法：只給銀染問生長模式 → 腫瘤細胞侵入血管周圍網狀纖維層之間，形成同心圓洋蔥皮狀袖套（angiocentric growth）。
PCNSL 多為 CD20+、MUM1+ 的 non-GCB DLBCL，常位於腦室旁深部白質，MRI 呈均勻顯影病灶。
懷疑 PCNSL 時切片前避免類固醇；治療以 high-dose methotrexate 為基礎。
分期需評估眼睛（vitreoretinal lymphoma）與 CSF，並以全身影像排除全身性淋巴瘤續發 CNS 侵犯。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為腦炎或脫髓鞘的反應性血管周圍淋巴球袖套；反應性袖套薄、由小 T 細胞組成，不會把網狀纖維撐開成多層，也沒有大型非典型細胞。

quiz.q: 此網狀纖維染色中血管周圍多層同心圓纖維代表何種生長模式？最可能診斷？
quiz.a: Angiocentric (perivascular) growth；primary CNS DLBCL

61015.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央一顆橢圓形細胞的細胞質塞滿深紫黑色、粗大密集的嗜鹼性顆粒，幾乎蓋住核，邊界圓滑，是正常肥大細胞（mast cell）；周圍的細胞質深藍、核偏位的細胞是漿細胞，可作為對照。
features: Central oval cell with cytoplasm densely packed with coarse dark purple metachromatic granules that partially obscure the nucleus
Round-to-oval central nucleus, not lobated; no cytoplasmic spindling or hypogranularity
Adjacent plasma cells with deep blue cytoplasm, eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hof
Mixed granulocytic precursors with fine pink-purple granules and a cell with coarse strand-like chromatin (possible mitotic figure/disrupted cell) at lower right
Background of red cells and fine granular debris from ruptured cells
61015.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a mixed hematopoietic population including maturing granulocytic precursors and several plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and basophilic cytoplasm. In the center there is a round-to-oval mast cell whose cytoplasm is filled with coarse, dark purple metachromatic granules that partly obscure a round, non-lobated nucleus. The mast cell shows no spindling, hypogranularity or nuclear lobation. The findings represent a morphologically normal bone marrow mast cell; atypical spindle-shaped or hypogranular mast cells in aggregates would be required to raise concern for systemic mastocytosis.

ddx.vs: Basophils are smaller with a lobated/segmented nucleus and fewer, larger, water-soluble granules, whereas mast cells are larger with a round nucleus and densely packed granules.

ddx.dx: Atypical mast cell of systemic mastocytosis
ddx.vs: Neoplastic mast cells are spindle-shaped, hypogranular, have bilobed/eccentric nuclei and express CD25/CD2/CD30, unlike this round, fully granulated cell.
Promyelocytes have azurophilic red-purple primary granules, a visible nucleus with a Golgi zone and less dense granule packing.
Macrophages are larger with abundant cytoplasm containing irregular golden-brown to blue-black clumps of variable size plus debris, and are Prussian blue-positive.

exam.answer_en: Normal bone marrow mast cell — round/oval cell packed with coarse dark metachromatic granules obscuring a round non-lobated nucleus
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指中央顆粒密集的細胞問「mast cell 還是 basophil」，並要你指出旁邊細胞質深藍、核偏心的 plasma cell 作對照。
Mast cell 染色：toluidine blue 呈 metachromasia、tryptase 與 CD117（KIT）IHC 陽性；basophil 則 CD117 陰性、CD123 陽性，flow 可區分。
Systemic mastocytosis 主要準則是骨髓等組織內多灶性緻密 mast cell 聚集（≥15 顆）；次要準則包含 >25% spindle/atypical 形態、KIT D816V、CD25/CD2/CD30 異常表現、serum tryptase >20 ng/mL。
形態正常的 mast cell 增加可見於反應性骨髓，例如 lymphoplasmacytic lymphoma、aplastic anemia 或慢性腎病，不等於 mastocytosis。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常誤為 basophil：basophil 較小、核分葉、顆粒較少且大小不一並可覆蓋核；mast cell 較大、核圓不分葉、顆粒細密均勻塞滿細胞質。

quiz.q: 圖中央顆粒密集的細胞是什麼？哪一種 IHC 標記可幫你與 basophil 區分？
quiz.a: Mast cell；CD117（KIT）或 tryptase 陽性（basophil 為 CD117 陰性）

60887.recognize_zh: 軟組織腫塊中可見斜向穿過的粉紅色骨骼肌纖維被大量大型腫瘤細胞包圍浸潤；腫瘤細胞核不規則、染色質呈芽細胞樣，部分胞質嗜酸性，且有纖維血管隔分隔，符合原發部位的肺泡型橫紋肌肉瘤。
features: Diffuse sheets of large round to oval tumor cells infiltrating between entrapped, diagonally oriented eosinophilic skeletal muscle fibers
Irregular hyperchromatic nuclei with blastic chromatin, focal nuclear molding and scattered mitoses/apoptotic bodies
Scant to moderate pale eosinophilic, sometimes vacuolated cytoplasm; occasional larger cells with more abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm (rhabdomyoblast-like)
Thin fibrovascular septa traversing the tumor
Discohesive cells with retraction spaces
60887.describe_en: High-power hematoxylin and eosin-stained section of a forearm soft-tissue mass shows sheets of large, discohesive malignant cells infiltrating around entrapped skeletal muscle fibers that course diagonally across the field. The tumor cells have irregular, hyperchromatic nuclei with blastic chromatin, scant to moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm and occasional cells with more abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm; mitotic and apoptotic figures are present. Thin fibrovascular septa separate groups of cells, although a well-formed alveolar pattern is not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with a malignant small round blue cell tumor, in keeping with alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma when supported by desmin and diffuse myogenin staining.

ddx.vs: Embryonal RMS shows variably cellular myxoid stroma with spindle cells and patchy myogenin, lacking the fibrovascular septa and diffuse myogenin/FOXO1 fusion of the alveolar type.
Ewing sarcoma cells are more uniform with fine chromatin and clear cytoplasm, CD99/NKX2.2 positive and myogenin negative.

ddx.dx: Lymphoblastic or Burkitt lymphoma of soft tissue
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are CD45 positive with B/T lineage markers and TdT (lymphoblastic) or CD10/MYC (Burkitt), and desmin/myogenin negative.
Myeloid sarcoma may contain eosinophilic myelocytes and is MPO, CD33, CD117 or lysozyme positive.

60823.recognize_zh: CD30 免疫染色中，大部分大型腫瘤細胞為陰性，只有零星幾顆大細胞呈弱至中度胞質/膜狀棕色染色；在灰區淋巴瘤中，CD30 表現不一致、未如典型何杰金細胞般強陽性。
features: Sheet of medium-to-large cells with vesicular, irregular nuclei, most negative for CD30
Rare scattered large cells with weak to moderate cytoplasmic/membranous CD30 staining
No Golgi (paranuclear dot) accentuation evident in the positive cells
No diffuse strong CD30 expression across the large cell population
60823.describe_en: CD30 immunohistochemistry shows that the large atypical cell population is predominantly negative, with only rare scattered large cells demonstrating weak to moderate cytoplasmic and membranous staining. Strong membranous and Golgi-pattern CD30 staining typical of Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells is not seen. In conjunction with the morphology and the remaining immunopanel, this limited CD30 expression supports a B-cell lymphoma with features intermediate between diffuse large B-cell lymphoma and classic Hodgkin lymphoma (mediastinal gray zone lymphoma).

ddx.vs: cHL shows strong CD30 in essentially all Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells with membranous and Golgi staining, together with weak/absent CD20 and Oct-2.
PMBL often shows weak heterogeneous CD30 but has uniform strong CD20/Oct-2 with CD23/MAL expression and lacks CD15.
ALCL shows strong uniform CD30 in nearly all tumor cells with a T-cell or null phenotype.

60631.recognize_zh: 眼球切片可見葡萄膜上的腫瘤結節，PET-CT 顯示整條中軸骨骼瀰漫性攝取增加，而周邊血與骨髓抹片出現巨大、細胞質豐富且呈聚團的非造血細胞，提示葡萄膜黑色素瘤瀰漫性骨髓侵犯。
features: Enucleated globe (H&E, whole mount) with a nodular intraocular mass arising from the uveal tract
Tumor on high power composed of sheets of discohesive epithelioid cells with hyperchromatic nuclei; no obvious melanin pigment at this resolution
PET-CT: diffuse, symmetric FDG uptake throughout the axial skeleton (vertebrae, pelvis, ribs, proximal long bones)
Peripheral blood: single very large circulating cell with eccentric nucleus and abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm (arrow)
Bone marrow aspirate: cohesive cluster of large tumor cells with round nuclei, visible nucleoli and pale gray-blue cytoplasm, distinct from surrounding myeloid cells
60631.describe_en: Composite figure. Section of the enucleated eye shows a nodular uveal tumor composed of sheets of epithelioid cells with pleomorphic, hyperchromatic nuclei. Whole-body PET-CT demonstrates diffuse hypermetabolism of the axial and proximal appendicular skeleton. The peripheral blood smear contains a rare very large non-hematopoietic cell with abundant vacuolated cytoplasm, and the bone marrow aspirate shows cohesive clusters of large tumor cells with prominent nucleoli set among normal hematopoietic elements. Melanin pigment is not clearly appreciable at this resolution, so immunostains (SOX10, HMB-45, Melan-A) are needed for confirmation. Findings are consistent with metastatic uveal melanoma with diffuse bone marrow involvement and circulating tumor cells.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma clusters are also cohesive but lack melanin and are cytokeratin positive and SOX10/HMB-45 negative, whereas uveal melanoma is the reverse.
Blasts are dispersed, have scant cytoplasm and form no cohesive clusters, whereas these tumor cells are much larger, clustered and CD45 negative.
Megakaryocytes have lobulated nuclei and osteoclasts have multiple separate uniform nuclei, unlike the clusters of individual mononuclear tumor cells here.
Histiocytes are single cells with engulfed blood cells and bland nuclei rather than cohesive aggregates of atypical cells with nucleoli.

60695.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一個巨噬細胞內塞滿無色、具稜角（長方形或六角形）的折光性結晶，偏光顯微鏡下呈多彩強雙折射，為胱胺酸（cystine）結晶沉積，提示胱胺酸症（cystinosis）。
features: Macrophage with cytoplasm packed by numerous colorless, refractile, angular crystals (rectangular to polygonal/hexagonal) (B)
Crystals displace the nucleus to the periphery and give the cell a glassy, stuffed appearance
Polarized light (A): strong multicolored birefringence of the intracellular crystals, standing out against a dark background
Surrounding marrow shows normal-appearing maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements
60695.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a histiocyte distended by innumerable colorless, refractile, angular rectangular to polygonal crystals that push the nucleus aside; the background hematopoiesis appears otherwise unremarkable in this field. Under polarized light the intracellular crystals display intense, multicolored birefringence. Findings are consistent with cystine crystal deposition in marrow macrophages, suggestive of cystinosis; confirmation by leukocyte cystine measurement and CTNS genetic testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Immunoglobulin crystals are eosinophilic/pale blue needle or rhomboid shapes that are usually weakly or non-birefringent and are light-chain restricted by IHC, often with a plasma cell neoplasm.
Oxalate crystals are birefringent rosettes or sheaves in marrow causing fibrosis and granulomatous reaction, often extracellular and in primary hyperoxaluria with renal failure.
Gaucher cells have fibrillar wrinkled tissue-paper cytoplasm without discrete refractile crystals or birefringence.
Charcot-Leyden crystals are slender bipyramidal needles derived from eosinophils rather than clustered polygonal crystals within macrophages.

captions: Polarized light: brightly birefringent crystals within a macrophage
Wright-Giemsa: macrophage packed with colorless angular cystine crystals

60567.recognize_zh: 初診時骨髓抹片 (A) 為核偏一側、細胞質深藍、部分有明顯核仁的非典型漿細胞；復發時 (C) 細胞轉為核質比高、核仁明顯、具手鏡狀細胞質突起（箭頭）的小至中型母細胞樣細胞，形似急性淋巴母細胞白血病，但 CD138 膜染與 kappa 原位雜交 (E, F) 陽性，證實為漿母細胞轉化。
features: Panel A (initial aspirate): atypical plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, abundant basophilic cytoplasm, perinuclear hof and some prominent central nucleoli
Panel B (initial biopsy): sheets of plasma cells with eccentric nuclei and conspicuous nucleoli
Panel C (follow-up aspirate): small-to-intermediate cells with high N:C ratio, open chromatin, prominent nucleoli and hand-mirror cytoplasmic projection (arrow)
Panel D (follow-up biopsy): interstitial infiltrate of cells with scant cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli among fat
Panel E: strong membranous CD138 in the infiltrate
Panel F: kappa light chain ISH with strong dark signal in tumor cells
60567.describe_en: The initial bone marrow aspirate and biopsy show atypical plasma cells with eccentric nuclei, abundant basophilic cytoplasm and a subset with prominent central nucleoli. The follow-up aspirate is replaced by small-to-intermediate cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, prominent nucleoli and hand-mirror cytoplasmic projections, and the biopsy shows an interstitial infiltrate of similar cells with scant cytoplasm. The infiltrate is strongly CD138 positive by immunohistochemistry and kappa positive by in situ hybridization. Findings are consistent with plasmablastic transformation of plasma cell myeloma mimicking acute lymphoblastic leukemia rather than a therapy-related acute leukemia.

ddx.vs: Lymphoblasts are TdT+/CD34+/CD19+ and CD138 negative without kappa restriction, whereas transformed myeloma cells remain CD138+ with the original kappa light chain.
Myeloblasts express MPO/CD33/CD117 and lack CD138 and monotypic light chain.
Plasmablastic lymphoma is typically extramedullary, EBV-positive and MYC-rearranged, without a prior myeloma history or lytic lesions.

60567.stain: Wright-Giemsa; H&E; IHC: CD138; ISH: kappa

60439.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片以脂肪為主、造血細胞僅呈細條狀分布在脂肪細胞之間，其中可見紅血球前驅細胞群（圓核深染）夾雜少數髓系細胞與巨核細胞；兒童全血球減少合併此種片狀低細胞性造血灶，符合兒童難治性血球減少症（refractory cytopenia of childhood）的切片表現。
features: Adipocyte-rich marrow with hematopoietic cells confined to thin cords and small interstitial foci
Foci dominated by erythroid precursors with round, dense, hyperchromatic nuclei (erythroid predominance)
Scattered myeloid precursors with more open chromatin and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm
Occasional megakaryocytes present within the foci; no sheets of blasts
Interstitial extravasated red cells; no fibrosis, granulomas, or infiltrate evident at this power
60439.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, medium-high power) shows a fat-predominant field in which hematopoietic elements form thin interstitial cords and small patchy foci. The foci are composed predominantly of erythroid precursors with round hyperchromatic nuclei, admixed with fewer maturing myeloid cells and occasional megakaryocytes. No increase in blasts, lymphoid aggregates, granulomas, or metastatic cells is seen. In a child with pancytopenia, this patchy hypocellular hematopoiesis with erythroid predominance is consistent with refractory cytopenia of childhood, in the appropriate clinical and cytogenetic context.

ddx.vs: Aplastic anemia usually shows markedly reduced or absent megakaryocytes and lacks the patchy erythroid islands with left-shifted maturation and megakaryocytic dysplasia typical of refractory cytopenia of childhood.

ddx.dx: Inherited bone marrow failure syndrome (e.g., Fanconi anemia)
ddx.vs: Morphology can be identical; chromosome breakage testing and germline sequencing are required to separate them.

ddx.dx: Hypocellular AML or MDS with excess blasts
ddx.vs: These show increased CD34-positive blasts (clusters or >5% aspirate blasts), which are not seen here.

60375.recognize_zh: 中倍骨髓切片可見整片單調、密集排列的中型芽細胞取代骨髓，脂肪空泡幾乎消失，僅零星殘存深染的紅血球前驅細胞與含鐵血黃素，符合復發 B-ALL 的瀰漫浸潤。
features: Diffuse, densely packed sheets of monotonous medium-sized cells
Cells with scant cytoplasm and round to irregular nuclei with fine chromatin
Marked hypercellularity with near absence of fat spaces
Scattered small clusters of residual erythroid precursors with dark round nuclei
Occasional brown hemosiderin-laden macrophages; megakaryocytes not identified
60375.describe_en: Intermediate-power view of the bone marrow biopsy shows a markedly hypercellular marrow diffusely replaced by sheets of monotonous medium-sized cells with scant cytoplasm and finely dispersed nuclear chromatin. Only scattered small clusters of residual erythroid precursors are present, megakaryocytes are not identified, and occasional hemosiderin-laden macrophages are seen. Findings are consistent with diffuse marrow involvement by relapsed B-lymphoblastic leukemia in the context of the immunohistochemical results.

ddx.vs: Cannot be separated reliably at this power; lineage requires MPO/CD117 versus TdT/CD79a/PAX5 staining.

ddx.dx: Diffuse marrow involvement by small B-cell lymphoma (e.g., CLL)
ddx.vs: CLL cells are small with clumped chromatin and form proliferation centers, and are TdT-/CD34-.
Hematogones are interstitial and admixed with normal trilineage hematopoiesis rather than forming diffuse effacing sheets.

60183.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中紅血球系前驅細胞比例高，可見晚期紅母細胞核出現分葉、出芽及輪廓不規則，並有一個核形不規則、疑似晚期有絲分裂的細胞，屬於明顯的紅血球系發育異常（dyserythropoiesis）。
features: Erythroid precursors at all stages, from basophilic proerythroblast to orthochromatic normoblasts
Late erythroblast with multilobated (cloverleaf-like) nucleus, consistent with nuclear budding/irregularity
Erythroid precursor with dense, irregularly contoured nucleus suggestive of an abnormal late mitosis
Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony: clumped nuclei with still-polychromatic cytoplasm
Several large disrupted/bare nuclei (smudged cells) in the background
60183.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows prominent erythroid precursors spanning all stages of maturation. Several late erythroblasts show nuclear lobulation, budding and irregular contours, and one cell has a dense irregular nucleus suggestive of an abnormal late mitotic figure. Nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony is present. Scattered disrupted bare nuclei are seen in the background. These dyserythropoietic changes support a myelodysplastic neoplasm; the blast percentage (not assessable from this field) determines the subtype, here reported as MDS with excess blasts.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic change shows uniformly open, sieve-like chromatin with giant bands and hypersegmented neutrophils, and resolves with vitamin replacement.
CDA is a lifelong isolated erythroid disorder without increased blasts or dysplasia in other lineages.

ddx.dx: Toxic / reactive dyserythropoiesis (alcohol, chemotherapy, arsenic, copper deficiency)
ddx.vs: Clinical history, nutritional studies and absence of clonal cytogenetic abnormalities favor a reactive cause.
Pure erythroid leukemia requires >80% erythroid cells with ≥30% proerythroblasts, far more primitive cells than seen here.

exam.answer_en: Dyserythropoiesis in MDS with excess blasts — late erythroblasts with nuclear lobulation/budding, irregular contours and nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著核呈苜蓿葉狀分葉或出芽的晚期紅母細胞問發育異常類型——答 nuclear budding／multilobation，並舉其他紅系發育異常：多核、核間橋、核碎裂、megaloblastoid、ring sideroblasts。
輔助染色：Prussian blue 看 ring sideroblasts；PAS 陽性紅母細胞可見於 MDS 與 erythroid 腫瘤，但非特異。
MDS 次分類由 blast 比例決定（EB-1/EB-2 或 WHO 5th IB1/IB2），單看紅系發育異常無法決定亞型，需 500 顆細胞分類計數。
排除非腫瘤原因：B12/葉酸缺乏（megaloblastic 變化最像）、銅缺乏、酒精、砷、化療、HIV，以及先天性 CDA。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與 megaloblastic anemia 混淆；兩者都有核質不同步與核分葉，但 megaloblastic 伴巨大 bands/metamyelocytes 與 hypersegmented neutrophils，且 B12/葉酸低、補充後可恢復。

quiz.q: 圖中晚期紅母細胞核呈分葉、出芽，屬於何種發育異常？在診斷 MDS 前最需要排除哪一種可逆性營養缺乏？
quiz.a: Dyserythropoiesis（nuclear budding/lobulation）；維生素 B12/葉酸缺乏（亦需排除銅缺乏）。

60119.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小梁間仍有不少脂肪空泡，標註為相對兒童年齡偏低的細胞量；造血區呈單調、密集的小圓細胞分布，缺乏正常三系混雜的樣貌，需高倍與免疫染色確認是芽細胞浸潤。
features: Low power core biopsy with bony trabeculae and intertrabecular marrow containing abundant fat spaces
Cellularity reduced relative to expected pediatric cellularity (per label)
Hematopoietic areas appear monotonous with densely packed small round cells
Megakaryocytes not readily identified at this magnification
No fibrosis or granulomas evident at low power
60119.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at low power shows trabecular bone with intertrabecular marrow containing numerous fat spaces, hypocellular for the patient's age. The hematopoietic areas appear monotonous and composed of densely packed small round cells, with megakaryocytes not readily identified. Cytologic detail is limited at this magnification, and high-power examination and immunostains are needed to characterize the infiltrate. In conjunction with the aspirate and immunophenotype, findings are consistent with involvement by T-lymphoblastic leukemia in a hypocellular marrow.

ddx.vs: Aplastic marrow is markedly fatty with residual cells being lymphocytes, plasma cells and stroma rather than monotonous immature cells; CD34/TdT and aspirate blast counts separate them.
Hypocellular MDS shows dysplastic megakaryocytes and myeloid/erythroid lineages with possible CD34+ blasts, not a CD3+ lymphoblast infiltrate.
Blasts in hypocellular AML are myeloid (MPO, CD117, CD33) rather than T-lineage.

60055.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片的顆粒（particle）幾乎全由大小不一的脂肪空泡與藍色基質構成，其間幾乎看不到造血細胞，周圍僅有紅血球背景，符合低細胞性（paucicellular）骨髓，提示再生不良性貧血。
features: Marrow particle composed predominantly of round, variably sized clear fat vacuoles
Intervening blue-staining stromal strands with very few recognizable hematopoietic cells
No megakaryocytes or clusters of granulocytic/erythroid precursors identifiable in the particle
Background of peripheral blood red cells with sparse scattered nucleated cells
Low magnification; individual cell morphology cannot be assessed
60055.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low power shows a marrow particle composed predominantly of adipocyte vacuoles and stromal elements, with markedly reduced hematopoietic cells. Megakaryocytes and trilineage precursors are not appreciated within the particle, and the surrounding trails consist largely of peripheral blood red cells. Evaluation of cytologic detail is limited at this magnification. Findings indicate a paucicellular (fatty) marrow particle, consistent with aplastic anemia in the appropriate clinical context; correlation with the trephine biopsy and PNH flow cytometry is recommended.

ddx.vs: A hemodilute sample lacks particles or shows cellular particles diluted by blood, whereas here the particles themselves are present but composed almost entirely of fat.
Hypocellular MDS shows dysplastic residual precursors, increased blasts, or clonal cytogenetics, which require assessment of the residual cells and biopsy rather than particle cellularity alone.
Elderly marrow may be fatty but retains proportional trilineage hematopoiesis in particles and is not accompanied by pancytopenia.

21271.recognize_zh: 高倍下組織球細胞質內可清楚看到許多小圓形酵母菌，中央有一點深色核樣物、外圍有透明空暈，把組織球撐大，細胞核被推擠到一側，符合組織胞漿菌（Histoplasma capsulatum）。
features: Enlarged histiocytes with vesicular oval nuclei and small nucleoli
Cytoplasm filled with numerous tiny round-oval yeasts with a central basophilic dot and a clear halo
Organisms relatively uniform in size (small, well under red cell diameter)
Interlacing collagen bands and scattered lymphocytes between histiocytes
No hyphae, kinetoplasts or large capsules seen
21271.describe_en: High-power view of a tissue section shows enlarged histiocytes whose cytoplasm is distended by many small, uniform, round-to-oval yeast forms, each with a central basophilic dot and a surrounding clear halo. Collagen bands and scattered lymphocytes separate the parasitized histiocytes, and no hyphae, capsules or kinetoplasts are seen. Findings are consistent with histoplasmosis; GMS or PAS staining should confirm narrow-based budding yeasts, and culture or urine antigen testing is recommended.

ddx.vs: Leishmania shows a nucleus plus a rod-shaped kinetoplast and does not stain with GMS.
Cryptococcus is larger and more variable in size with a thick mucicarmine-positive capsule.
Talaromyces shows elongated sausage-shaped forms with a central septum from fission.
Blastomyces yeasts are much larger (8-15 um), thick-walled and show broad-based budding.

exam.answer_en: Histoplasmosis — histiocytes distended by small uniform yeasts with central basophilic dot and clear halo, no kinetoplast or capsule
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍圖考官會問「這些小體跟 Leishmania 怎麼分」；答案：Histoplasma 只有一個中央點與 halo、無 kinetoplast，GMS/PAS 陽性。
大小鑑別：Histoplasma 約 2–4 µm 且大小一致；Cryptococcus 較大且大小不一、有 mucicarmine 陽性莢膜；Blastomyces 更大且為寬基出芽。
確診：GMS 找窄基出芽酵母、培養、尿液或血清 antigen；免疫低下者應檢查 HIV 與是否播散（骨髓、肝脾、腎上腺）。
臨床：播散性 histoplasmosis 可表現為發燒、全血球低下、肝脾腫大，並可繼發 HLH；治療以 liposomal amphotericin B 起始，後接 itraconazole。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 Leishmania amastigotes：兩者都在組織球內，但 Leishmania 有棒狀 kinetoplast 且 GMS 陰性；Histoplasma 的「halo」是收縮假影不是莢膜。

quiz.q: 圖中酵母菌周圍的透明空暈是真正的莢膜嗎？要與大小相近的 Leishmania 區分，看哪個構造？
quiz.a: 不是，是組織收縮假影（mucicarmine 陰性）；看有無 kinetoplast（Leishmania 有），或以 GMS 染色（Histoplasma 陽性）。

18327.recognize_zh: 臨床照片可見側胸腹至背部大片融合的深紫色皮下瘀斑，邊緣不規則且延伸至腋下，未見明顯外傷；在無出血病史的年長者出現這種大面積軟組織出血，應想到後天性血友病 A（AHA）。
features: Extensive confluent dark purple ecchymosis over the lateral chest, flank, and back
Irregular geographic margins with feathered, mottled edges fading into normal skin
Separate ecchymotic patch extending over the axillary/upper arm region
No visible petechiae, palpable purpura, or open wounds
Scattered small dark macules at the lower margin
18327.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows extensive, confluent, dark purple subcutaneous ecchymoses involving the lateral chest wall, flank, and back, with a separate patch extending toward the axilla. The margins are irregular and mottled, and there are no petechiae, palpable purpura, or skin breaks to suggest vasculitis or trauma. Large spontaneous soft-tissue bleeds of this type, in a patient without a prior bleeding history, are characteristic of acquired hemophilia A; the laboratory correlate is an isolated prolonged aPTT that does not correct on mixing, with low factor VIII activity and a factor VIII inhibitor measured by Bethesda assay.

ddx.vs: Drug-related bleeding is identified by medication history and prolonged PT/INR or anti-Xa activity, rather than an isolated aPTT prolongation that fails to correct on mixing.
DIC shows thrombocytopenia, low fibrinogen, elevated D-dimer, and schistocytes, whereas AHA has normal platelets, PT, and fibrinogen.

ddx.dx: Senile purpura or corticosteroid-induced skin fragility
ddx.vs: These cause smaller, flat, well-demarcated ecchymoses on sun-exposed forearms and hands with normal coagulation tests, not massive truncal hematomas.
Acquired VWS typically causes mucocutaneous bleeding with low VWF activity-to-antigen ratio, rather than a specific factor VIII inhibitor.

18071.recognize_zh: 細胞體積極大（遠大於旁邊紅血球與小淋巴球），細胞質塞滿粗大嗜天青顆粒並可見多條 Auer rods（左上成束），左下細胞核呈雙葉/摺疊狀，符合四倍體的巨大型急性前骨髓性白血病（APL）細胞。
features: Markedly enlarged promyelocytes, several times the diameter of adjacent RBCs and a small lymphocyte
Abundant cytoplasm densely packed with coarse azurophilic granules obscuring the nuclear border
Multiple Auer rods, including bundled rods (faggot-like) in the upper left inset
Irregular, bilobed/folded nucleus in the lower left inset
Fine chromatin partly obscured by granules; peripheral pale-blue agranular cytoplasmic rim
18071.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate composite shows markedly enlarged abnormal promyelocytes, much larger than neighboring erythrocytes and a small lymphocyte. The cells have abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse azurophilic granules that obscure the nuclear outline, and several contain multiple Auer rods, including a bundle in the upper left panel. Nuclei are irregular, with a bilobed or folded contour in the lower left panel. The giant cell size is in keeping with a near-tetraploid clone. Findings are consistent with hypergranular acute promyelocytic leukemia; confirmation of t(15;17)/PML::RARA is required.

ddx.vs: Blasts in t(8;21) usually show a single slender Auer rod, perinuclear hof and salmon-pink granules rather than cytoplasm packed with coarse granules and bundles of Auer rods.
Reactive promyelocytes have a paranuclear Golgi zone, round eccentric nucleus and no Auer rods, and show orderly maturation.
The microgranular variant shows bilobed nuclei with sparse or invisible granules, whereas these cells are overtly hypergranular.

ddx.dx: AML with RARA-variant or other retinoid-resistant APL-like leukemia
ddx.vs: Morphology cannot separate them reliably; FISH/RT-PCR for PML::RARA versus variant RARA partners is required.

exam.answer_en: Hypergranular acute promyelocytic leukemia (giant tetraploid variant) — huge promyelocytes packed with coarse granules and bundled Auer rods (faggot cells)
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著成束 Auer rods 的細胞問名稱→faggot cell；並追問必做的遺傳檢查：t(15;17)(q24.1;q21.2) PML::RARA（FISH 或 RT-PCR 可快速確認）。
這張的「巨大細胞」反映 near-tetraploid clone；細胞大小不影響診斷，只要 PML::RARA 陽性仍是 APL，治療與一般 APL 相同。
典型 flow：CD33 強陽、CD13 陽、CD117 常陽，CD34 與 HLA-DR 陰性，CD11b 陰性；MPO 細胞化學強陽性。
急症：APL 常合併 DIC 與纖溶亢進，懷疑時即應開始 ATRA、不必等基因確認，並積極補充 fibrinogen 與血小板以防致命出血。
WHO 5th 將 APL with PML::RARA 列為不需 blast 數門檻的 AML；ICC 2022 則要求 ≥10% blasts/promyelocytes。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 G-CSF 或骨髓恢復期的反應性前骨髓細胞；後者有核旁 Golgi 淡染區、成熟順序完整、無 Auer rods，而本圖有成束 Auer rods 與不規則雙葉核。

quiz.q: 圖中胞質內含成束 Auer rods 的巨大細胞稱為什麼？此病最需要立即處理的併發症是什麼？
quiz.a: Faggot cell（APL 的異常前骨髓細胞）；DIC／纖溶亢進造成的出血，應立即給 ATRA

17943.recognize_zh: 臉部嚴重疤痕與色素沉著、雙手指節殘缺變形與潰瘍（光敏感造成的毀損），牙齒在紫外光下發出粉紅螢光（erythrodontia），尿液紫外光下呈粉紅螢光（porphyrinuria），符合先天性紅血球生成性紫質症（congenital erythropoietic porphyria）。
features: Clinical photographs, not a microscopic image
Panel A: severe facial scarring and hyperpigmentation; hands with mutilating deformity, shortened digits, ulcers and crusts
Panel B: erythrodontia with reddish-pink fluorescence of teeth under UV light
Panel C: porphyrinuria with pink fluorescence of patient urine versus blue normal control under UV light
17943.describe_en: Clinical photographs (Balwani and Desnick, Hematology 2012) show severe cutaneous photosensitivity with facial scarring and hyperpigmentation, and mutilating deformities of both hands with digit loss, ulceration and crusting, consistent with repeated blistering, infection and scarring. Under ultraviolet light, the teeth show pink-red fluorescence (erythrodontia), and the patient's urine fluoresces pink compared with the blue fluorescence of a normal control (porphyrinuria). Findings are consistent with congenital erythropoietic porphyria (Gunther disease) due to uroporphyrinogen III synthase deficiency, typically accompanied by hemolytic anemia and splenomegaly.

ddx.vs: HEP can mimic CEP clinically but shows elevated urine uroporphyrin/heptacarboxyl porphyrin with isocoproporphyrin in feces and homozygous UROD deficiency rather than type I isomer predominance from UROS deficiency.
PCT presents in adulthood with milder blistering of the hands, without erythrodontia, hemolysis or mutilating deformity.
EPP causes painful non-blistering photosensitivity with normal urine porphyrins and no erythrodontia.
Dystrophic EB causes scarring and digit fusion but is trauma-related, without photosensitivity, fluorescent teeth or porphyrinuria.

exam.answer_en: Congenital erythropoietic porphyria (Gunther disease) — mutilating photosensitive scarring, erythrodontia and pink-fluorescent urine under UV light
pearls_zh: 考法：看到毀損性手部變形＋紫外光下牙齒粉紅螢光（erythrodontia），問診斷→CEP，並問缺乏的酵素：uroporphyrinogen III synthase（UROS）。
遺傳多為體染色體隱性 UROS 突變；少數由 X-linked GATA1 突變造成。堆積的是 type I isomer porphyrins（uroporphyrin I、coproporphyrin I）。
血液學連結：紅血球內 porphyrin 堆積導致溶血性貧血與脾腫大，嚴重者可在胎兒期表現為 hydrops fetalis。
治療：嚴格避光、輸血支持，脾腫大可切脾；目前唯一可能根治的是異體造血幹細胞移植（HSCT）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 PCT 混淆：PCT 為成人發病、僅手背輕中度水疱，無 erythrodontia、溶血或毀損性變形；CEP 自幼發病且合併溶血與脾腫大。

quiz.q: 圖中牙齒在紫外光下呈粉紅螢光稱為什麼？此病缺乏哪個酵素？
quiz.a: Erythrodontia；uroporphyrinogen III synthase（UROS），即 congenital erythropoietic porphyria

17751.recognize_zh: A 為骨髓切片觸印片（touch imprint），可見成群大型單核細胞、核圓、細胞質中等偏灰藍；B 為骨髓切片，細胞密集填滿髓腔、細胞間有透明間隙。重點在於骨髓抽不出（dry tap）時，觸印片仍可提供細胞學判讀。
features: Panel A (touch imprint): cohesive-appearing clusters of medium-to-large mononuclear cells with round nuclei and moderate grey-blue cytoplasm
Panel A: several cells show pale peripheral cytoplasm or perinuclear clearing; scattered small dark lymphocytes and smudged cells
Panel B (trephine section): diffusely hypercellular marrow packed with monotonous cells, obliterating fat
Panel B: cells separated by clear spaces/halos; one bony trabecula edge at right
Low resolution limits assessment of chromatin, nucleoli and cytoplasmic projections
17751.describe_en: Panel A shows a bone marrow touch imprint containing clusters of medium-to-large mononuclear cells with round nuclei, moderate grey-blue cytoplasm and occasional perinuclear or peripheral cytoplasmic clearing, admixed with a few small lymphocytes. Panel B shows the corresponding trephine biopsy, which is diffusely packed with a monotonous cellular infiltrate replacing normal fat and hematopoiesis, with cells separated by clear cytoplasmic spaces. Image resolution precludes assessment of fine nuclear detail and definitive lineage assignment. The figure illustrates that when a packed or fibrotic marrow yields a dry tap, a touch imprint of the core provides cytologic material; findings indicate a diffuse marrow-replacing infiltrate requiring immunophenotyping for classification.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells show fine circumferential cytoplasmic projections on imprints and a fried-egg pattern with reticulin fibrosis on biopsy, confirmed by CD11c, CD25, CD103, annexin A1 and BRAF V600E.
Blasts have fine chromatin with nucleoli and high N:C ratio, and are distinguished by CD34, MPO or TdT immunostaining rather than by this low-resolution image.
Myelofibrosis causes dry tap through fibrosis with clustered atypical megakaryocytes and streaming, not a monotonous sheet of mononuclear cells.
Metastatic carcinoma forms truly cohesive epithelial clusters with nuclear molding and is cytokeratin-positive and CD45-negative.

15767.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中的血小板偏大、呈淡灰藍色，幾乎看不到紫色 α 顆粒，看起來像「幽靈」血小板，這是灰色血小板症候群（gray platelet syndrome）的典型形態，易被誤診為 ITP。
features: Enlarged platelets approaching or exceeding the size of a small red cell
Platelets pale gray-blue and nearly devoid of purple azurophilic (alpha) granules
Irregular, ghost-like platelet outlines with homogeneous hyaline cytoplasm
Few platelets per field, consistent with thrombocytopenia
Red cells normocytic and normochromic; no leukocyte abnormalities in this field
15767.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows decreased platelets, and the platelets present are large with pale gray-blue, agranular cytoplasm and irregular ghost-like outlines, lacking the normal purple granulomere. Red cells are normocytic and normochromic. Findings are suggestive of gray platelet syndrome (NBEAL2-related alpha-granule deficiency); confirmation by electron microscopy showing absent alpha granules and reduced platelet factor 4/P-selectin content is recommended, and the patient should not be labeled as ITP.

ddx.vs: ITP may show large platelets but they retain normal purple alpha granules, and marrow megakaryocytes are not associated with myelofibrosis or emperipolesis.
Artifactual hypogranular platelets occur in delayed specimens and are corrected on a fresh smear, whereas GPS persists with EM-confirmed alpha-granule absence.
BSS shows giant platelets with normal granulation and absent ristocetin-induced aggregation due to GPIb-IX-V deficiency.
MYH9 disorders show giant granulated platelets with Döhle-like inclusions in neutrophils.

exam.answer_en: Gray platelet syndrome — thrombocytopenia with large pale gray-blue agranular (alpha-granule-deficient) ghost platelets
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著淡灰藍色、看不到紫色顆粒的大血小板問「顆粒到哪去了？」答：α-granule 缺乏，即 gray platelet syndrome。
典型 GPS 為 NBEAL2 突變、體染色體隱性；GATA1、GFI1B 等基因變異也可造成灰色血小板表型。確診靠電子顯微鏡看到 α-granule 缺乏。
α-granule 內容物（PF4、β-thromboglobulin、vWF、fibrinogen）與活化後 P-selectin（CD62P）表現降低；dense granules 正常。
臨床連結：輕中度出血、脾腫大與漸進性骨髓纖維化，並常見血清 vitamin B12 升高；易被誤診為 ITP。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤判為 ITP 的大血小板，或 EDTA 放置過久造成的去顆粒 artifact；ITP 大血小板保有紫色顆粒，artifact 在新鮮抹片會消失，GPS 則持續且 EM 證實 α-granule 缺乏。

quiz.q: 圖中血小板呈淡灰色無顆粒，缺乏的是哪一種顆粒？最常見的致病基因為何？
quiz.a: Alpha granules；NBEAL2

12695.recognize_zh: Chediak-Higashi 症候群患者的骨髓抹片中，顆粒球前驅細胞含有粗大、形狀不一的巨大嗜天青顆粒，箭頭處巨噬細胞吞噬紅血球與有核細胞（hemophagocytosis），代表已進入加速期（HLH 樣表現）。
features: Giant, coarse, irregular azurophilic/purple granules in myeloid precursors
Macrophages containing engulfed red cells and nucleated cells within vacuoles (arrows)
Cellular aspirate with mixed myeloid precursors, lymphocytes, and erythroid cells
Some cells show vacuolated cytoplasm
No blast population or Auer rods
12695.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears are cellular with maturing myeloid precursors that contain abnormally large, coarse azurophilic granules. Several macrophages show phagocytosis of erythrocytes and nucleated hematopoietic cells, consistent with hemophagocytosis. No increase in blasts is evident. In a child with known Chediak-Higashi syndrome, findings are consistent with the accelerated phase (hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis-like lymphohistiocytic activation).

ddx.vs: Toxic granules are fine, uniform, and confined to mature neutrophils, whereas CHS granules are giant, irregular, and present in multiple lineages including lymphocytes.
Alder-Reilly granules are dense, uniformly distributed metachromatic mucopolysaccharide granules without giant fused lysosomes and without hemophagocytosis.
Pseudo-CHS granules occur in leukemic blasts or dysplastic cells with an increased blast count and clonal cytogenetics, not in a child with albinism.

ddx.dx: Familial or secondary HLH without CHS
ddx.vs: Other HLH forms show hemophagocytosis but lack giant granules and partial oculocutaneous albinism, and genetics differ (PRF1, UNC13D, STX11, or LYST in CHS).

exam.answer_en: Chediak-Higashi syndrome, accelerated phase — giant azurophilic granules in myeloid precursors with hemophagocytosis
pearls_zh: 考法：先問粗大異常顆粒是什麼（CHS giant granules），再指箭頭巨噬細胞問 hemophagocytosis 代表什麼 → 進入 accelerated phase（HLH）。
遺傳：LYST 基因變異，體染色體隱性，造成溶酶體運輸異常；所有含顆粒細胞（中性球、淋巴球、黑色素細胞）都受影響。
臨床三聯：部分眼皮膚白化症（銀灰色頭髮）、反覆化膿性感染、出血傾向（dense granule 缺乏）；NK/細胞毒性 T 細胞功能缺損導致 HLH。
治療：accelerated phase 需依 HLH 方案控制（如 etoposide、dexamethasone），異體造血幹細胞移植可矯正血液與免疫缺陷，但無法預防晚發神經退化。
exam.pitfall_zh: 粗大顆粒易被誤認為感染的 toxic granulation 或 Alder-Reilly anomaly；CHS 顆粒巨大、數量少且形狀不一，並見於淋巴球，臨床有白化；pseudo-CHS 顆粒則見於 AML/MDS。

quiz.q: Chediak-Higashi 症候群病人骨髓中，箭頭所指巨噬細胞吞噬血球，表示疾病進入哪一期？致病基因為何？
quiz.a: Accelerated phase（HLH）；LYST

12567.recognize_zh: 范可尼貧血（Fanconi anemia）男孩大腿上有數個大型、邊界清楚的環狀紫紅色斑塊，部分中央潰瘍結痂；皮膚切片可見真皮內瀰漫浸潤的單核芽細胞，細胞化學染色呈紅色陽性顆粒，符合骨髓外的骨髓肉瘤（myeloid sarcoma，皮膚白血病）。
features: Clinical: multiple large annular violaceous-to-erythematous plaques on the thigh, some with central ulceration and eschar
Skin biopsy: diffuse dermal infiltrate of discohesive mononuclear cells splaying collagen bundles
Infiltrating cells are medium to large with round to indented nuclei
Enzyme cytochemistry on tissue: many infiltrating cells show red granular cytoplasmic positivity (POX/NACE per source)
Lower panel: positive cells infiltrate between collagen/muscle fibers in a single-file pattern
12567.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows multiple large, well-demarcated annular violaceous plaques on the lateral thigh, several with central ulceration and eschar. The skin biopsy shows a diffuse dermal infiltrate of discohesive medium-to-large mononuclear cells dissecting between collagen bundles and adnexal/muscle fibers. Enzyme cytochemical stains performed on tissue show granular red cytoplasmic positivity in many of the infiltrating cells, supporting myeloid (myelomonocytic) lineage; individual stains cannot be separated with certainty from the image alone. In a patient with Fanconi anemia and a non-leukemic, hypocellular marrow, findings are consistent with myeloid sarcoma (leukemia cutis) with myelomonocytic differentiation.

ddx.dx: Cutaneous B- or T-cell lymphoma / lymphoblastic lymphoma
ddx.vs: Lymphoid infiltrates are negative for myeloperoxidase and chloroacetate esterase and express CD20/CD3 or TdT rather than MPO, CD33, CD68, and lysozyme.
BPDCN also forms violaceous skin plaques but is MPO/NACE negative and expresses CD4, CD56, CD123, and TCF4.

ddx.dx: Leukocytoclastic vasculitis or infectious (ecthyma) lesions in cytopenic host
ddx.vs: Vasculitis and infection show neutrophil-rich vessel-centered inflammation or organisms, not a monotonous sheet of blasts.
Sweet syndrome shows a dermal infiltrate of mature neutrophils with papillary dermal edema rather than immature myelomonocytic blasts.

12567.stain: Clinical photo; cytochemistry: POX and NACE

11863.recognize_zh: 高倍周邊血液中兩顆淋巴球的核呈多葉、邊緣深凹的花瓣樣（flower cell），染色質略粗、胞質淡藍無顆粒，是 ATLL 最具辨識度的核型態。
features: Two medium-sized lymphoid cells with polylobated nuclei showing deep indentations (flower/cloverleaf shape)
Moderately condensed chromatin with an indistinct small nucleolus in one cell
Moderate rim of pale blue agranular cytoplasm
Background red cells normochromic; a single platelet present
11863.describe_en: High-power view of the peripheral blood smear shows atypical lymphocytes with moderate pale agranular cytoplasm and polylobated nuclei containing multiple deep indentations that produce a petal-like (flower cell) configuration. Chromatin is moderately condensed and nucleoli are inconspicuous. Findings are characteristic of adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma; confirmation with HTLV-1 serology and T-cell immunophenotyping (CD4+, CD25+, CD7-) is recommended.

ddx.vs: Sezary cells have cerebriform grooves rather than discrete petal-shaped lobes and occur without HTLV-1 infection.
Monocytes are larger with folded nuclei, lacy chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm with fine granules and vacuoles, rather than condensed chromatin with discrete lobes.
Hairy cells have oval or bean-shaped nuclei with circumferential hair-like cytoplasmic projections and are CD11c/CD25/CD103 positive B cells.

exam.answer_en: Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma — high-power flower cells with polylobated petal-like nuclei and agranular cytoplasm
pearls_zh: 考法：高倍特寫單一型態，直接問「這顆細胞的名稱與病因」；flower cell 是 ATLL 最具辨識度的單一形態線索。
診斷步驟：HTLV-1 抗體篩檢陽性後需確認試驗（如 line immunoassay 或 PCR）；腫瘤細胞中 HTLV-1 前病毒單株性嵌入可證明病毒與腫瘤相關。
伴隨問題：ATLL 病人細胞免疫低下，易發生 Pneumocystis、CMV 與 Strongyloides hyperinfection；化療前應篩檢並預防。
HTLV-1 另一相關疾病是 HTLV-1–associated myelopathy/tropical spastic paraparesis（HAM/TSP），常作為配對題。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為單核球（核折疊、胞質淡藍）：單核球較大、胞質灰藍常有細空泡與細顆粒、染色質細緻；flower cell 較小、染色質濃縮、核葉深切呈花瓣狀放射。

quiz.q: 圖中淋巴球的核型態叫什麼？HTLV-1 除 ATLL 外還會造成哪一種神經疾病？
quiz.a: Flower cell；HAM/TSP（HTLV-1–associated myelopathy/tropical spastic paraparesis）

3991.recognize_zh: 低倍下骨髓抹片出現大片、緊密黏在一起的深染小細胞團塊（cohesive clusters），跟周圍零散分布的造血細胞截然不同，提示非造血來源的轉移性腫瘤；甲狀腺髓質癌的確認需靠 calcitonin 等免疫染色。
features: Large cohesive sheets and clusters of tightly packed cells forming a dense, three-dimensional aggregate
Tumor cells small to intermediate with round, hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm at this magnification
Clusters wrap around fat spaces within aspirated particles
Sharp contrast with the dispersed, non-cohesive hematopoietic cells in the background
Cytologic detail (chromatin, nucleoli, granules) not assessable at this low power
3991.describe_en: Low-power view of a bone marrow aspirate smear shows large cohesive clusters and sheets of densely packed, hyperchromatic cells, partly surrounding fat spaces, set against a blood-rich background with scattered dispersed hematopoietic cells. The cohesive growth pattern indicates a non-hematopoietic (epithelial/neuroendocrine) process. Fine cytologic features cannot be evaluated at this magnification, and definitive classification requires the core biopsy and immunohistochemistry (e.g. keratin, synaptophysin/chromogranin, calcitonin, CEA, TTF-1). Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma, in keeping with the reported metastatic medullary thyroid carcinoma.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small cell carcinoma or neuroblastoma
ddx.vs: These also form cohesive small-cell clusters with molding; separation from medullary thyroid carcinoma requires calcitonin/CEA (MTC) versus clinical context and markers such as PHOX2B for neuroblastoma.

ddx.dx: Acute leukemia or lymphoma with clumped particles
ddx.vs: Hematopoietic blasts are dispersed and discohesive, whereas true tumor clusters remain tightly cohesive at the smear edges.
A normal particle contains a heterogeneous mix of maturing myeloid, erythroid and megakaryocytic cells rather than a monotonous cohesive population.
Osteoblasts are larger with eccentric nuclei, abundant basophilic cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof, and are loosely rather than densely aggregated.

5911.recognize_zh: 一群異常前骨髓細胞幾乎每顆都有成束、交錯的 Auer 小體（faggot cell），核折疊不規則、細胞質顆粒粗，這樣密集的柴束細胞高度提示急性前骨髓細胞白血病（APL）。
features: Cluster of large abnormal promyelocytes with folded or irregular nuclei
Moderate N:C ratio with nuclei partly obscured by granules and rods
Numerous Auer rods in crisscrossing bundles within most cells (faggot cells)
Abundant cytoplasm with coarse azurophilic granules and a paler peripheral rim
Background normocytic red cells without mature neutrophils in the field
5911.describe_en: Smear shows a cluster of large abnormal promyelocytes with irregular folded nuclei and abundant granular cytoplasm. Most cells contain multiple Auer rods arranged in bundles (faggot cells). No maturing granulocytes are present in this field. Findings are consistent with acute promyelocytic leukemia with PML::RARA; this is a medical emergency warranting immediate ATRA and evaluation for DIC while genetic confirmation is pending.

ddx.vs: Blasts in t(8;21) contain single long tapered Auer rods and a perinuclear hof, not multiple bundled rods in hypergranular promyelocytes.
Auer rods are usually single and sparse, with multilineage dysplasia in the background rather than sheets of faggot cells.

ddx.dx: Reactive left shift with toxic granulation
ddx.vs: Toxic granulation affects maturing neutrophils with round or segmented nuclei and Döhle bodies, and Auer rods are never present.

exam.answer_en: Acute promyelocytic leukemia with PML::RARA — cluster of abnormal promyelocytes, most containing bundled Auer rods (faggot cells)
pearls_zh: 考法：一群細胞幾乎都有成束 Auer rods，考官問「看到這張圖第一步該做什麼」；答案是視為醫療急症，懷疑即開始 ATRA 並處理凝血，不等基因確認。
確診：FISH 或 RT-PCR 證實 PML::RARA；RT-PCR 可區分 bcr1/bcr2/bcr3 斷點，並作為後續 MRD 追蹤的基準。
分類：WHO 5th 將 APL with PML::RARA 列為不需最低母細胞比例的遺傳定義型；ICC 2022 則要求母細胞/異常前骨髓細胞 ≥10%。
支持治療：積極輸注血小板、cryoprecipitate/fibrinogen 與 FFP 以矯正凝血；凝血未穩定前避免不必要的侵入性處置（如 LP、中央靜脈導管）。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為化療後或 G-CSF 恢復期的反應性前骨髓細胞增多：反應性前骨髓細胞有明顯核旁淡區（Golgi）、核圓規則、無 Auer rods 且伴後續成熟階段；此圖為核折疊並大量 faggot cells。

quiz.q: 看到此圖中大量含成束 Auer rods 的前骨髓細胞，在基因結果出來前應立即給予什麼藥物？要緊急檢查哪一類併發症？
quiz.a: ATRA（all-trans retinoic acid）；DIC／凝血異常（PT、aPTT、fibrinogen、D-dimer、血小板）

1367.recognize_zh: 臨床照片中大腿近膝處有一個橢圓形瘀斑（ecchymosis），中央轉為黃綠色、外圍呈紫褐色，表示不同時期的皮下出血吸收中；皮膚未見壞死或隆起，屬血小板低下常見的皮膚出血表現但不具特異性。
features: Oval ecchymosis on the anterior thigh above the knee
Central yellow-green discoloration with a purple-brown periphery indicating resolving hemorrhage
Flat, non-palpable lesion without necrosis or ulceration
Faint additional bruising near the knee
No petechiae clearly resolved at this photographic resolution
1367.describe_en: Clinical photograph shows a flat, oval ecchymosis on the anterior thigh with a yellow-green center and purple-brown rim, indicating resolving subcutaneous hemorrhage, with faint additional bruising near the knee. There is no skin necrosis, palpable purpura, or hematoma swelling. Mucocutaneous bleeding of this type is compatible with immune thrombocytopenia, but the finding is nonspecific; a complete blood count with smear review is required to document isolated thrombocytopenia.

ddx.vs: Ordinary bruising occurs with normal platelet count and coagulation studies; only laboratory testing separates it.

ddx.dx: Von Willebrand disease or other platelet function disorder
ddx.vs: Bruising is similar but platelet count is normal with abnormal VWF studies or platelet function testing.
Thrombocytopenia is accompanied by anemia, abnormal white count or circulating blasts on the smear.
Suggested by patterned bruises in unusual locations with inconsistent history and normal hemostatic testing.

2711.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中，造血組織間散布成群、成片的大型淡灰粉紅色組織球，細胞質豐富如皺紙、核小而偏心，取代部分正常骨髓，符合高雪氏病（Gaucher disease）的浸潤。
features: Clusters and sheets of large histiocytes with abundant pale gray-pink cytoplasm interspersed among hematopoietic cells
Small, round to oval, eccentric nuclei within the histiocytes
Cytoplasm has a faintly fibrillary, glassy texture at this power
Residual trilineage hematopoiesis between histiocytic aggregates
Bony trabeculae without obvious abnormality
2711.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows a cellular marrow with numerous clusters and confluent sheets of large histiocytes that have abundant pale gray-pink, faintly fibrillary cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei. These histiocytes infiltrate interstitially and displace residual trilineage hematopoiesis. Trabecular bone is present without significant change in this field. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by Gaucher disease; confirmation by glucocerebrosidase enzyme activity or GBA genotyping is recommended.

ddx.dx: Pseudo-Gaucher cells in chronic myeloid leukemia or myeloma
ddx.vs: Pseudo-Gaucher cells occur in a marrow dominated by the underlying neoplasm (granulocytic hyperplasia or plasma cells) and have normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Niemann-Pick cells have finely vacuolated, foamy (soap-bubble) cytoplasm rather than dense fibrillary cytoplasm.
MAC-laden histiocytes may mimic Gaucher cells but contain acid-fast bacilli and are often accompanied by granulomas.

exam.answer_en: Gaucher disease involving marrow — clusters and sheets of large pale histiocytes with fibrillary cytoplasm displacing hematopoiesis (core biopsy)
pearls_zh: 考法：切片低中倍問「造血組織間這些淡染大細胞是什麼、呈何種分布」；答 Gaucher cells 呈 interstitial 群聚至成片浸潤，取代部分骨髓。
Gaucher 骨髓浸潤程度與血球低下相關，脾腫大造成 hypersplenism 也會加重血小板低下；splenectomy 後骨病變可能惡化，目前以藥物治療為主。
骨骼表現：骨痛、bone crisis、avascular necrosis（股骨頭）、股骨遠端 Erlenmeyer flask deformity；MRI 可評估骨髓浸潤負擔。
高風險族群：Ashkenazi Jewish 人群帶因率高，N370S（p.N409S）是 type 1 常見等位基因，帶有此等位基因者通常無神經侵犯。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 Niemann-Pick 泡沫細胞混淆；Niemann-Pick 胞質呈細小空泡肥皂泡狀，Gaucher 為皺紙纖維狀、較少空泡。

quiz.q: 圖中造血組織間成片的淡灰粉紅大型組織球最可能是什麼細胞？此病以何種藥物治療為主？
quiz.a: Gaucher cells；enzyme replacement therapy（如 imiglucerase）或 substrate reduction therapy（如 eliglustat）

2583.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指是一顆圓形、無細胞核、淡藍色並帶數個小空泡的細胞質碎片，大小接近旁邊的淋巴球，並非真正的血小板或細胞；這種細胞質碎片可被自動計數儀誤算為血小板（偽血小板）。
features: Arrowed round anucleate fragment of pale blue cytoplasm with a few small clear vacuoles
Fragment about the size of the adjacent lymphocyte, much larger than a normal platelet
No azurophilic granules or granulomere typical of platelets
Adjacent small lymphocyte and segmented neutrophil for comparison
Thick background with overlapping, crenated red cells and drying artifact
2583.describe_en: The smear shows a thick area with overlapping, crenated red cells, a small lymphocyte and a segmented neutrophil. The arrow indicates a round, anucleate fragment of pale blue cytoplasm containing a few small clear vacuoles and no platelet-type granules, approximately the size of the nearby lymphocyte. This represents a cytoplasmic fragment (pseudothrombocyte) rather than a true platelet; such fragments, commonly derived from leukemic or other fragile cells, can be counted as platelets by automated analyzers and falsely elevate the platelet count.

ddx.vs: Giant platelets contain a central purple granulomere with azurophilic granules, whereas this fragment is agranular pale blue cytoplasm.
Red cell fragments stain pink-orange like other erythrocytes and lack blue cytoplasm with vacuoles.
Smudge cells and bare nuclei show purple chromatin, whereas this fragment has no nuclear material.
Yeasts are smaller, oval, often budding, with a refractile wall and a dark staining center rather than pale blue vacuolated cytoplasm.

1239.recognize_zh: 視野內有許多核圓、染色質細緻、胞質藍的母細胞，但同時穿插帶粗大嗜天青顆粒的前骨髓細胞與開始出現核周淡染區（hof）的較成熟細胞；母細胞增加又能看到顆粒球往下成熟，符合有成熟的 AML（AML with maturation）。
features: Numerous blasts with round nuclei, fine chromatin, small nucleoli and basophilic cytoplasm
Admixed promyelocytes and myelocytes with abundant coarse azurophilic granules
Some cells with eccentric nuclei and perinuclear hof, indicating granulocytic maturation
Cells with variable granulation, including hypogranular forms
Very cellular aspirate with few erythroid precursors
1239.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is densely cellular and composed of increased myeloblasts with round nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and moderately basophilic cytoplasm. Admixed are numerous promyelocytes and myelocytes with coarse azurophilic granules and perinuclear hofs, demonstrating granulocytic maturation, with variable granulation among maturing cells. Erythroid precursors are sparse. No convincing Auer rods are identified at this magnification. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with maturation, pending blast enumeration and cytogenetic studies to exclude t(8;21) and other defining abnormalities.

ddx.vs: Often looks like AML with maturation, but t(8;21) blasts are large with salmon-colored cytoplasm, single slender Auer rods and pseudo-Chediak-Higashi granules, and the translocation is confirmatory.
APL shows a near-uniform population of hypergranular abnormal promyelocytes with bilobed nuclei and Auer rod bundles, rather than a mix of blasts and orderly maturing granulocytes.
MDS-IB has <20% blasts in marrow, so the distinction rests on the blast count.

exam.answer_en: Acute myeloid leukemia with maturation — increased blasts admixed with promyelocytes, myelocytes and hof-bearing maturing granulocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指著有核周 hof、偏心核的細胞問「這是漿細胞嗎？」；在 AML 背景下應答 maturing granulocyte，且若大量出現需聯想 t(8;21) RUNX1::RUNX1T1。
t(8;21) AML 特徵：長細且單一的 Auer rods、胞質 salmon 色顆粒、成熟嗜中性球顆粒減少；flow 常見 CD34+ 並異常表現 CD19、PAX5、CD56；KIT 突變可能影響預後。
WHO 5th 對 RUNX1::RUNX1T1 等 defining genetic abnormalities 取消 20% blast 門檻；ICC 2022 則以 ≥10% blasts 為門檻，因此所有 AML 必做 karyotype/FISH/RT-PCR。
Core binding factor AML（t(8;21)、inv(16)）屬 ELN favorable risk，鞏固治療以 high-dose cytarabine 為主，並以 RT-PCR 追蹤融合轉錄本 MRD。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 MDS-IB 或 G-CSF 後的 left shift 混淆：須精確計數 blasts 是否 ≥20%；G-CSF 或恢復期骨髓以 promyelocytes/myelocytes 為主、真正 blasts 少且成熟有秩序。

quiz.q: AML with maturation 伴有核周 hof 的顆粒球與長細 Auer rod 時，最應檢查的融合基因為何？

1303.recognize_zh: 中倍下骨髓內淋巴聚集由大量小型、深染、圓核淋巴球組成，中央區夾雜紅血球與小血管、細胞密度略不均，邊緣與周圍造血組織交界清楚，是骨髓反應性淋巴濾泡的放大觀察。
features: Dense lymphoid aggregate composed of small lymphocytes with round, hyperchromatic nuclei and scant cytoplasm
Slightly looser central area with interspersed red cells and a small capillary
No sheets of large atypical cells; no obvious centroblasts or tingible-body macrophages resolved at this power
Aggregate edge merges with surrounding hematopoietic marrow containing erythroid and myeloid cells
Adipocytes at the periphery
1303.describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy at intermediate power shows a dense lymphoid aggregate composed predominantly of small, mature-appearing lymphocytes with round hyperchromatic nuclei. The central area is slightly looser with interspersed red cells and small vessels; distinct germinal center cells (centroblasts, tingible-body macrophages) are not clearly resolved at this magnification. No large atypical cells or sheets of blasts are identified. Findings are suggestive of a benign lymphoid aggregate/follicle; immunohistochemistry (CD20, CD3, CD10, BCL6, BCL2) would help confirm a reactive germinal center.

ddx.vs: Neoplastic follicles are typically paratrabecular with monotonous centrocytes and BCL2-positive follicle center cells.
CLL cells are CD5+/CD23+ small lymphocytes forming irregular aggregates with pale proliferation centers of prolymphocytes and paraimmunoblasts.
Mastocytosis lesions contain spindle mast cells with clear cytoplasm, eosinophils and fibrosis, confirmed by tryptase/CD117/CD25.

1111.recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫組織化學染色中，許多大細胞的胞質呈強烈棕色、並呈多顆粒球狀（桑椹狀），對應充滿免疫球蛋白的 Mott 細胞；背景淋巴細胞與骨髓細胞為弱染或陰性。
features: Numerous large cells with intense brown cytoplasmic staining in globular/mulberry pattern
Staining outlines discrete Russell body globules within the cytoplasm
Positive cells distributed interstitially between fat spaces
Weak granular background staining in interstitium; small hematopoietic cells largely negative
Hematoxylin counterstain shows blue nuclei of background cells
1111.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a bone marrow biopsy shows numerous large cells with strong brown cytoplasmic staining in a globular, mulberry-like pattern corresponding to Russell body-laden plasma cells (Mott cells), distributed interstitially between fat spaces. Small background hematopoietic and lymphoid cells are largely negative, with weak granular interstitial background staining. The specific antibody is not stated; the pattern is compatible with an immunoglobulin light chain or plasma cell marker. Paired kappa and lambda staining is required to determine whether the plasmacytic component is monotypic, as in marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocyte IHC gives homogeneous cytoplasmic staining of large lobated cells rather than discrete globular Russell bodies.

ddx.dx: Polytypic reactive plasmacytosis with Mott cells
ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells show a mixed kappa and lambda pattern, whereas a lymphoma-associated clone shows single light chain restriction.
Myeloma shows sheets or nodules of CD138+ monotypic plasma cells, often >10% with cytologic atypia, rather than scattered Mott cells with a lymphoid component.

1111.stain: IHC (antibody not specified; likely light chain or CD138)

4247.recognize_zh: 一顆巨大的巨噬細胞，細胞質內塞滿被吞噬的中性球、單核細胞核與紅血球（部分位於空泡內），這就是噬血現象（hemophagocytosis），可見於續發性噬血症候群。
features: Very large macrophage with abundant pale vacuolated cytoplasm
Multiple engulfed intact nucleated cells, including segmented neutrophils and mononuclear cells, within phagocytic vacuoles
Several engulfed red cells and red-cell fragments in the cytoplasm
Macrophage's own nucleus obscured by ingested material
Background of hematopoietic cells and red cells in an aspirate smear
4247.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large macrophage whose cytoplasm contains numerous phagocytosed hematopoietic elements, including several segmented neutrophils, mononuclear nucleated cells and red cells, many within clear vacuoles. Surrounding marrow cells are unremarkable in this field. Findings demonstrate hemophagocytosis and, in the appropriate clinical and laboratory setting, are consistent with hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis; hemophagocytosis alone is not diagnostic of HLH.

ddx.vs: Tingible body macrophages contain apoptotic nuclear debris rather than intact neutrophils, nucleated cells and red cells.
Emperipolesis shows intact cells passing through a megakaryocyte with a large lobulated nucleus and granular cytoplasm, not phagolysosomal digestion in a macrophage.
Rosai-Dorfman histiocytes are S100-positive and contain intact lymphocytes and plasma cells, typically in lymph nodes rather than a marrow aspirate.

exam.answer_en: Hemophagocytosis — marrow macrophage engulfing intact neutrophils, nucleated cells and red cells (supports HLH in the right clinical setting)
pearls_zh: 考法：指巨大細胞問名稱及被吞噬的內容物。答 hemophagocytic macrophage，內含完整中性球、有核細胞與紅血球。
HLH-2004：8 項中 5 項——發燒、脾腫大、≥2 系 cytopenias、高三酸甘油酯/低纖維蛋白原、hemophagocytosis、NK 活性低、ferritin ≥500 ng/mL、sCD25 ≥2400 U/mL；或有 HLH 基因突變。
Hemophagocytosis 單獨不足以診斷 HLH（輸血、敗血症後也可見），也不是必要條件；成人常用 HScore 評估。
成人續發性 HLH 常見觸發：EBV 等感染、T/NK-cell lymphoma、自體免疫（MAS）；治療以 dexamethasone ± etoposide（HLH-94 架構）並同時處理誘因。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 megakaryocyte emperipolesis 或 tingible body macrophage：emperipolesis 的母細胞有大型分葉核、被穿入細胞完整未被消化；tingible body macrophage 只含凋亡核碎屑。

quiz.q: 圖中巨大細胞所呈現的現象是什麼？它是否足以單獨診斷 HLH？
quiz.a: Hemophagocytosis；不足，需符合 HLH-2004 criteria（8 項中 5 項）

4055.recognize_zh: 緊貼骨小樑的病灶由梭形到卵圓形、胞質淡嗜酸性且透亮的細胞鬆散排列成片，伴隨纖維基質，與周圍含嗜酸性球的正常造血骨髓分界清楚，這是系統性肥大細胞增生症常見的骨小樑旁病灶。
features: Paratrabecular lesion abutting a bony trabecula
Spindled to ovoid cells with bland oval nuclei and pale eosinophilic to clear cytoplasm
Loose fibrotic stroma within the lesion
Adjacent hematopoietic marrow with eosinophils and granulocytic precursors
Scattered small lymphocytes; no granulomas or atypical large cells
4055.describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy shows a paratrabecular lesion composed of loosely arranged spindled to ovoid cells with bland oval nuclei and pale eosinophilic cytoplasm in a fibrotic stroma. The surrounding marrow is cellular with granulocytic precursors and conspicuous eosinophils. No granulomas or large atypical cells are identified. Findings are consistent with bone marrow involvement by systemic mastocytosis; confirmation with tryptase, CD117 and CD25 immunostains is recommended.

ddx.vs: Granulomas contain plump epithelioid histiocytes and giant cells that are CD68-positive and tryptase-negative.
Myelofibrosis shows diffuse fibrosis with clustered atypical megakaryocytes and streaming, not a discrete spindle mast cell lesion.
Metastatic tumors show nuclear atypia and keratin or S100 positivity rather than tryptase/CD117 expression.

ddx.dx: Chronic eosinophilic leukemia / myeloid neoplasm with eosinophilia
ddx.vs: These show diffuse eosinophilia without a compact spindle mast cell lesion and harbor PDGFRA/PDGFRB/FGFR1 rearrangements.

exam.answer_en: Systemic mastocytosis, BM biopsy — paratrabecular sheet of spindled to ovoid mast cells with clear cytoplasm in fibrotic stroma
pearls_zh: 考法：指著骨小樑旁透亮梭形細胞片問身分，答 atypical mast cells；H&E 上不易看到顆粒，需 tryptase/CD117 IHC。
異常表型：CD25（WHO/ICC 準則）、CD2、CD30 表現支持腫瘤性肥大細胞；正常肥大細胞 CD25 陰性。
Serum tryptase 持續 >20 ng/mL 為次要準則；若合併髓系腫瘤，tryptase 解讀需謹慎。
Advanced SM（aggressive SM、SM-AHN、mast cell leukemia）以 midostaurin 或 avapritinib 治療，ISM 以症狀控制為主。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 fibroblast 增生、PMF 的纖維化或 hairy cell leukemia 的「煎蛋」浸潤：SM 病灶為骨小樑旁/血管旁聚集、伴嗜酸性球，IHC tryptase/CD117 陽性。

quiz.q: 圖中骨小樑旁梭形細胞若為腫瘤性肥大細胞，哪個 IHC 異常表現最具診斷意義？
quiz.a: CD25（亦可 CD2、CD30）

4183.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片可見含大量脂肪空泡的骨髓顆粒與周邊造血細胞，左上角有一團深紫色、顆粒密集的細胞聚集，可能為肥大細胞群；但此倍率無法確認個別肥大細胞的形態，需高倍觀察梭形或低顆粒的異常肥大細胞。
features: Low-power aspirate showing marrow particles with numerous fat spaces
Hematopoietic cells lining fat spaces and scattered in the smear
Dense dark purple granular cluster at the upper left, possibly a mast cell aggregate within a particle
Individual cell granularity and shape not resolvable at this magnification
Background red cells in rouleaux-free monolayer
4183.describe_en: Low-power bone marrow aspirate smear shows marrow particles with abundant fat spaces and associated hematopoietic cells. A dense, dark purple, granular cluster at the upper left may represent an aggregate of mast cells within a particle, but individual cellular detail cannot be resolved at this magnification. Neoplastic mast cells in systemic mastocytosis are typically spindled, hypogranular or with eccentric nuclei and tend to be trapped in particles; high-power evaluation and flow cytometry for CD117+/CD25+ mast cells are required. The image is only partially informative for the stated diagnosis.

ddx.vs: Megakaryocytes are large cells with lobulated nuclei and pink granular cytoplasm rather than densely purple-black metachromatic granules.

ddx.dx: Reactive mast cells in hypocellular marrow
ddx.vs: Reactive mast cells are round, well granulated and scattered singly, and are CD25-negative.
Precipitate is extracellular, irregular and lies on a different focal plane from cells.

4119.recognize_zh: 許多紅血球的中央淡染區不是圓形，而是細長的裂縫狀或嘴巴狀（箭頭），這就是口形紅血球（stomatocyte）；另可見三角形淡染區的變形。
features: Numerous red cells with a slit-like or mouth-shaped linear central pallor (arrows)
Some cells show triangular or irregular central pallor variants
Red cells are otherwise of fairly uniform size and normochromic
No spherocytes, target cells, schistocytes or inclusions identified
Scattered small platelets in the background
4119.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous red cells with elongated slit-like central pallor, imparting a mouth-like appearance, along with occasional cells with triangular pallor. Red cells are otherwise relatively uniform in size and hemoglobinization, with no spherocytes, target cells, or fragments. Because stomatocytes can arise as a drying artifact, their presence in a well-made thin area of the smear is required for significance. Findings are consistent with stomatocytosis, which may reflect hereditary stomatocytosis, Rh-null phenotype, or acquired causes such as alcohol use and liver disease.

ddx.vs: Artifacts occur in thick areas and variably across the slide, while true stomatocytes persist in thin areas and on wet preparations.
Cells are oval with one or two transverse slits or bars (knizocyte-like) and are rigid, with SLC4A1 27-bp deletion.
Features dense spherocytes lacking central pallor rather than slit-like pallor, and increased osmotic fragility/EMA reduction.
Target cells have a central dense hemoglobin spot surrounded by a pale ring rather than a linear slit.

exam.answer_en: Stomatocytes — numerous RBCs with slit-like, mouth-shaped central pallor
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指的紅血球問名稱與病因；答 stomatocyte，最常見為後天因素（酒精、肝病、藥物），也見於遺傳性膜病。
Hereditary stomatocytosis 分 overhydrated 與 dehydrated（hereditary xerocytosis，PIEZO1 最常見）；xerocytosis 抹片口形紅血球反而不多、可見 target cells，MCHC 上升。
遺傳性 stomatocytosis 不宜脾切除：溶血改善有限且血栓風險增加，這是必考臨床連結。
Southeast Asian ovalocytosis（SLC4A1 27-bp deletion）呈口形卵圓紅血球，可見於東南亞族群。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常見的誤判是抹片厚區或乾燥造成的 stomatocyte-like artifact：真正口形紅血球應在單層薄區判讀、且大量均勻出現。

quiz.q: 圖中紅血球呈嘴巴狀淡染區稱為什麼？遺傳性病因者為何避免脾切除？
quiz.a: Stomatocytes；脾切除後血栓風險增加

3927.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片可見骨小樑明顯增厚、不規則並互相吻合連結（osteosclerosis），骨小樑之間是纖維化基質與成群的巨核細胞，符合原發性骨髓纖維化相關的骨硬化。
features: Markedly thickened, irregular, anastomosing bony trabeculae with new bone formation
Reduced intertrabecular marrow space
Fibrotic, streaming stroma between trabeculae
Clusters of enlarged megakaryocytes within the residual marrow
Dilated sinusoids and reduced normal hematopoiesis
3927.describe_en: Low-power view of the bone marrow biopsy shows markedly thickened, irregular and anastomosing bony trabeculae with appositional new bone formation, substantially narrowing the marrow space. The intertrabecular areas contain a fibrotic, streaming stroma with clusters of enlarged megakaryocytes, dilated sinusoids and reduced normal hematopoiesis. Findings are consistent with osteomyelosclerosis in the setting of primary myelofibrosis; reticulin and trichrome stains are recommended for fibrosis grading.

ddx.vs: Osteoblastic metastases also cause new bone formation but contain cohesive tumor nests that are keratin positive, rather than clustered atypical megakaryocytes.
Renal osteodystrophy shows paratrabecular fibrosis with osteoclastic tunneling resorption and osteoid seams, without MPN megakaryocytic proliferation.
Mastocytosis produces osteosclerosis around paratrabecular spindle mast cell aggregates with eosinophils, identified by tryptase/CD117/CD25.
Paget disease shows a mosaic pattern of cement lines with prominent osteoclasts and lacks megakaryocyte clusters.

exam.answer_en: Osteomyelosclerosis in primary myelofibrosis — thickened anastomosing bony trabeculae with fibrotic stroma and clustered megakaryocytes
pearls_zh: 考法：低倍 H&E 指增厚、互相吻合的骨小樑問「osteosclerosis」，並要求列出鑑別：PMF、osteoblastic metastasis、systemic mastocytosis、腎性骨病。
骨硬化代表 PMF 晚期纖維化階段，常伴 reticulin MF-2/3 與 collagen 沉積；影像上可見骨密度增加。
要確認 MPN 本質：尋找成群異型巨核細胞，並做 JAK2 V617F、CALR、MPL 檢測；triple-negative 時可找其他克隆性突變。
臨床表現：髓外造血導致巨脾、leukoerythroblastic blood picture 與 teardrop cells、骨髓抽吸 dry tap。
預後評分如 DIPSS／DIPSS-plus、MIPSS70 用來決定是否轉 allogeneic HSCT。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 osteoblastic metastatic carcinoma（如攝護腺癌）；轉移癌在骨小樑間有凝聚性上皮巢（keratin 陽性），PMF 則是成群異型巨核細胞與纖維化。

quiz.q: 低倍骨髓切片見骨小樑增厚互相吻合、間質纖維化並有成群巨核細胞，這種變化稱為什麼？最可能的背景疾病為何？
quiz.a: Osteomyelosclerosis（骨硬化）；primary myelofibrosis
