3863.recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓抹片中，大量胞質嗜鹼性、核型不規則的大型淋巴樣細胞散布在正常小淋巴球與造血細胞之間，大細胞明顯占多數，符合 DLBCL 侵犯骨髓。
features: Numerous large atypical lymphoid cells with round to irregular nuclei
Moderate to abundant basophilic cytoplasm, some with fine vacuoles
Admixed small mature lymphocytes and occasional erythroid precursors
Crowded cellular aspirate with red cell stacking; some cells distorted by thick smear areas
Nucleoli and chromatin detail only partly assessable at this magnification
3863.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at low to intermediate power is cellular and contains a prominent population of large atypical lymphoid cells with round to irregular nuclei and moderate to abundant basophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm. These are admixed with small mature lymphocytes and scattered erythroid precursors, with reduced normal myeloid elements in this field. Fine nuclear detail is limited in thicker areas. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, to be confirmed by flow cytometry and biopsy immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: AML blasts show fine chromatin, possible granules/Auer rods and CD34/CD117/MPO positivity rather than mature B-cell markers.

ddx.dx: Plasma cell myeloma with immature morphology
ddx.vs: Myeloma cells have eccentric nuclei with paranuclear hof and are CD138-positive with cytoplasmic light chain restriction.

ddx.dx: Metastatic small round cell tumor or carcinoma
ddx.vs: Metastatic tumor cells form cohesive clusters with nuclear molding and are CD45-negative with epithelial or neuroendocrine markers.

3735.recognize_zh: 鐵染色下多顆紅血球母細胞的粉紅色細胞核，外圍都被一圈藍綠色鐵顆粒環繞，形成一個個「藍色項鍊」，同一視野中多顆環狀鐵粒母細胞（ring sideroblasts）聚集；另有一團較大的藍色鐵塊。影像略為失焦。
features: Multiple erythroid precursors with pink-red nuclei (counterstain) in a marrow particle
Coarse blue siderotic granules arranged circumferentially around each nucleus
Perinuclear rings involve more than one third of the nuclear circumference in most cells
Scattered coarse extracellular/macrophage iron clumps
Larger unstained precursor nuclei without granules for comparison
Mild blur limits granule counting
3735.describe_en: Iron-stained bone marrow aspirate smear (Prussian blue with red counterstain) shows numerous erythroid precursors with coarse blue siderotic granules arranged in perinuclear rings around most of the nuclear circumference. Several ring sideroblasts are clustered in a single field, together with occasional coarse storage iron clumps. Other larger precursor nuclei lack siderotic granules. Although the image is slightly out of focus, findings are consistent with increased ring sideroblasts, which should prompt evaluation for MDS with ring sideroblasts/SF3B1 mutation and for acquired causes such as alcohol, copper deficiency or drugs.

ddx.vs: Normal sideroblasts show only a few fine scattered granules without a perinuclear ring arrangement.

ddx.dx: Increased storage iron without ring sideroblasts (e.g., transfusional overload)
ddx.vs: Iron overload increases macrophage iron clumps, but erythroblasts lack circumferential perinuclear granules.
Both show ring sideroblasts; congenital forms (e.g., ALAS2) present with microcytosis in youth, while MDS-RS shows dysplasia, macrocytosis and SF3B1 mutation.

exam.answer_en: Increased ring sideroblasts (Prussian blue) — multiple erythroblasts with perinuclear rings of siderotic granules, suggesting sideroblastic anemia/MDS with SF3B1
pearls_zh: 考法：多顆 ring sideroblasts 聚集，考官問「計數怎麼算、下一步做什麼」：以紅血球母細胞為分母計算百分比，並安排 SF3B1 等 NGS 與染色體。
可逆性原因必考：酒精、銅缺乏（常因過量鋅攝取或胃繞道手術）、藥物如 isoniazid、linezolid、chloramphenicol，以及鉛中毒；診斷 MDS 前需排除。
先天性 sideroblastic anemia：最常見為 X-linked ALAS2 突變，多為小球性，部分對 pyridoxine（vitamin B6）有反應；MDS 則常為大球性並有 dysplasia。
MDS/MPN with SF3B1 mutation and thrombocytosis（舊稱 MDS/MPN-RS-T）：血小板 ≥450×10^9/L，常合併 SF3B1 與 JAK2 V617F。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易把巨噬細胞內的粗大儲存鐵團塊當成 ring sideroblast；儲存鐵是細胞外或巨噬細胞內不規則藍塊，ring sideroblast 是紅血球母細胞核周的一圈細顆粒。

quiz.q: 骨髓鐵染色出現這麼多 ring sideroblasts，診斷 MDS 前應排除哪兩個常見可逆原因？
quiz.a: 酒精、銅缺乏（或藥物如 isoniazid / linezolid）

3671.recognize_zh: 非顯影劑頭部電腦斷層軸切面，雙側側腦室內充滿大片高密度（亮白）急性血塊並延伸至腦實質，周圍有低密度水腫，另見一小點金屬密度可能為引流管，為顱內出血的影像表現。
features: Axial non-contrast head CT image
Large hyperdense (acute blood) collection filling and expanding the lateral ventricles, most marked centrally and in the occipital horns
Blood-fluid level/layering of hyperdense blood in the dependent posterior horns
Surrounding periventricular hypodensity consistent with edema or transependymal fluid
Small focal very high-density dot in the right frontal region, possibly a ventricular catheter
Morphologic cell detail is not applicable to this image type
3671.describe_en: Axial non-contrast CT of the head shows extensive hyperdense acute hemorrhage filling and expanding the lateral ventricles, with dependent layering in the occipital horns and likely parenchymal extension centrally. There is surrounding periventricular hypodensity suggesting edema, and a small punctate high-density focus in the right frontal region that may represent a ventricular drain. This is a radiologic image, so no cellular morphology can be assessed. Findings are consistent with major intracranial (intraventricular and intraparenchymal) hemorrhage; in a hematology context this prompts evaluation for thrombocytopenia, coagulation factor deficiency (e.g., hemophilia, vitamin K deficiency), anticoagulant effect or DIC.

ddx.vs: Typically shows patchy hyperdensity within a vascular-territory hypodense infarct rather than dense blood casting the ventricular system.

ddx.dx: Hemorrhagic tumor (e.g., leukemic or metastatic deposit)
ddx.vs: Often shows an underlying enhancing mass and disproportionate edema, requiring contrast MRI to distinguish from primary coagulopathy-related bleeding.

ddx.dx: Cerebral venous sinus thrombosis with hemorrhage
ddx.vs: Shows a hyperdense dural sinus or cortical vein and venous infarcts, and needs CT or MR venography for confirmation.

3479.recognize_zh: 數個大型細胞具有豐富、灰藍色、帶尾狀或多角形的細胞質，核圓、染色質細緻，其中一個為雙核；細胞外型遠大於造血細胞且與漿細胞不同（無核周淡染區），符合轉移性尿路上皮癌細胞。
features: Large cells with abundant finely granular grey-blue cytoplasm and irregular, tailed, or polygonal outlines
Round nuclei with fine granular chromatin; one cell binucleated with two apposed nuclei
No perinuclear hof or cytoplasmic granules
Cells substantially larger than normal hematopoietic cells
Background clumped red cells typical of an aspirate smear
3479.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows large cells with abundant grey-blue, finely granular cytoplasm with tapering tails and polygonal outlines, and round nuclei with fine chromatin; one cell is binucleated. There is no perinuclear hof, and the cells are much larger than the hematopoietic elements. Findings are consistent with metastatic carcinoma, compatible with metastatic urothelial (bladder) carcinoma in the appropriate clinical context; confirmation with keratin, GATA3, and p63 immunostains on the trephine biopsy is recommended.

ddx.vs: Myeloma cells have clock-face chromatin, a perinuclear hof, and are CD138+ with light chain restriction and keratin-negative.
Osteoblasts show a clear paranuclear zone separate from an eccentric nucleus and lack the tailed epithelial cytoplasm and atypia.
Megakaryocytes are much larger with lobulated nuclei and granular pink cytoplasm, not round single or binucleated nuclei in blue cytoplasm.

3351.recognize_zh: 免疫染色呈純細胞核陽性，大量大型不規則的腫瘤細胞核被染成深棕色，小淋巴球多為陰性；陽性比例很高、強度不一，最像 Ki-67 高增生指數，反映 ALCL 屬於高度惡性淋巴瘤。
features: Nuclear-only brown staining in a large fraction of cells
Positive nuclei are large, irregular and pleomorphic, with variable staining intensity
Granular to coarse speckled nuclear staining pattern in some cells
Many small background lymphocytes and stromal nuclei are negative
No cytoplasmic or membranous staining
3351.describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a lymph node shows nuclear positivity in a large proportion of cells, predominantly large pleomorphic tumor nuclei, with variable intensity and a speckled pattern in some cells. Small background lymphocytes and stromal cells are largely negative, and there is no cytoplasmic or membranous staining. The antibody is not labeled; the purely nuclear pattern in a high fraction of tumor cells is most consistent with Ki-67, indicating a high proliferation index. Findings support a high-grade lymphoma, consistent with anaplastic large cell lymphoma in context.

ddx.vs: ALK in NPM1::ALK-positive ALCL gives combined nuclear and cytoplasmic staining, whereas this stain is purely nuclear.
Proliferation markers in Hodgkin lymphoma highlight scattered large cells and reactive cells rather than sheets of large pleomorphic nuclei.
DLBCL can have a similar high Ki-67 fraction, so B-cell versus T-cell/CD30/ALK markers, not the proliferation index, separate them.

3351.stain: IHC: nuclear marker, presumed Ki-67 (not labeled)

3287.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片羽狀邊緣可見一大團緊密相黏的淋巴樣細胞，細胞核彼此擠壓成多角形（molding），部分核有凹陷或裂溝，細胞質少，旁邊有正常中性球；這種成團聚集而非散在分布就是淋巴球凝集（lymphocyte agglutination），常與淋巴瘤細胞相關，可能造成白血球計數假性偏低。
features: Large cohesive aggregate of small to intermediate lymphoid cells at the smear edge
Tightly apposed cells with polygonal, molded outlines
Nuclei with moderately condensed chromatin; some irregular, indented or cleaved contours
Scant pale basophilic cytoplasm
Two normal-appearing segmented neutrophils adjacent to the aggregate
Background normochromic red cells without platelet clumps
3287.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large cohesive aggregate of small to intermediate lymphoid cells near the feathered edge, adjacent to normal-appearing segmented neutrophils. The aggregated cells are tightly apposed with polygonal molded outlines, scant pale cytoplasm, moderately condensed chromatin and focally irregular or cleaved nuclear contours. The clumping involves lymphoid cells selectively rather than platelets or neutrophils. Findings are consistent with lymphocyte agglutination, an in vitro phenomenon that may be associated with a circulating lymphoma (in context follicular lymphoma) and can cause spuriously low automated white cell counts; a fingerstick or non-EDTA smear and flow cytometry are recommended.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells are larger with abundant cytoplasm, prominent nucleoli and true epithelial cohesion, and are CD45-negative.
Blasts have fine chromatin and nucleoli and are usually dispersed, whereas these cells have condensed chromatin.
Platelet clumps consist of anucleate granular fragments, and satellitism shows platelets rimming neutrophils rather than lymphoid cell aggregates.

ddx.dx: Smear edge artifact with overlapping cells
ddx.vs: Overlap from thick areas lacks the discrete aggregation of a single lineage in an otherwise monolayer field.

3415.recognize_zh: 箭頭所指的漿細胞（plasma cell）細胞質內塞滿粉紅色圓形玻璃樣小球，有的呈多顆葡萄串狀（Mott cell），有的是單顆大球把核擠到一側，即 Russell bodies。
features: Plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei and clock-face chromatin
Cytoplasm distended by multiple round, homogeneous eosinophilic globules (Russell bodies; Mott cell pattern)
Some globules compress and displace the nucleus to the periphery
Numerous plasma cells admixed with myeloid and erythroid precursors
Fat space at upper right; no crystalline or needle-shaped inclusions seen
3415.describe_en: Bone marrow section (H&E) shows a cellular marrow with numerous plasma cells admixed with maturing granulocytic and erythroid elements. Several plasma cells (arrows) contain round, glassy eosinophilic cytoplasmic globules, either multiple in a grape-like arrangement (Mott cells) or as a large globule displacing the nucleus. These represent Russell bodies, dilated endoplasmic reticulum cisternae filled with retained immunoglobulin. Russell bodies are nonspecific and occur in reactive plasmacytosis as well as plasma cell neoplasms; clonality should be assessed by kappa/lambda staining and plasma cell quantitation.

ddx.vs: Dutcher bodies are PAS-positive immunoglobulin pseudoinclusions that overlie or invaginate the nucleus, whereas Russell bodies lie in the cytoplasm beside the nucleus.

ddx.dx: Crystal-storing histiocytosis / crystalline plasma cell inclusions
ddx.vs: Crystal-storing cells contain elongated, needle- or rhomboid-shaped crystals rather than round homogeneous globules.
Signet ring carcinoma cells contain a single mucin vacuole with crescentic nucleus and are keratin-positive, lacking plasma cell chromatin and CD138/light chain expression.
Phagocytosed red cells have biconcave outlines and hemoglobin-orange color within a macrophage with a bland oval nucleus, not uniform glassy globules in a plasma cell.

exam.answer_en: Russell bodies in plasma cells (Mott cells) — round glassy eosinophilic cytoplasmic immunoglobulin globules
pearls_zh: 考法：箭頭指漿細胞胞質內粉紅色玻璃樣圓球，問名稱（Russell body / Mott cell）與成分（堆積在 ER 內的免疫球蛋白）。
位置區分：Russell body 在細胞質；Dutcher body 看似核內（實為核膜凹入的胞質免疫球蛋白），較常見於 LPL、MZL 等 B 細胞腫瘤。
Russell bodies 不具特異性，可見於 reactive plasmacytosis、慢性發炎與 plasma cell neoplasm；克隆性需以 kappa/lambda ISH 或 IHC 判定。
骨髓切片漿細胞定量以 CD138 IHC 較準確；plasma cell myeloma 需 clonal BM plasma cells ≥10%（或 plasmacytoma）加上 myeloma-defining events。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤為 signet ring cell carcinoma：印戒細胞為單一黏液空泡、keratin 陽性；含 Russell body 的細胞仍有漿細胞 clock-face 染色質且 CD138 與輕鏈陽性。

quiz.q: 箭頭所指漿細胞內的粉紅色圓球叫什麼？成分為何？
quiz.a: Russell bodies（Mott cell）；免疫球蛋白

2519.recognize_zh: 周邊血液中出現多顆漿細胞：核偏位、染色質呈車輪狀（clockface），胞質深藍並有核旁淡染區（hof），背景紅血球有疊錢狀排列（rouleaux），符合漿細胞白血病。
features: Several circulating plasma cells in peripheral blood
Round eccentric nuclei with coarse clockface chromatin
Abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof
Rouleaux formation of red cells in the background
Scattered platelets; no blasts identified
2519.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows multiple circulating plasma cells with eccentric round nuclei, coarse clockface chromatin and abundant deeply basophilic cytoplasm with a perinuclear hof. Red cells display rouleaux formation, consistent with a serum paraprotein. No blasts are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with plasma cell leukemia in the appropriate context, currently defined by at least 5% circulating plasma cells; flow cytometry for clonal CD138+/CD38+ cells with light chain restriction is recommended.

ddx.vs: Reactive circulating plasma cells (viral infection, sepsis) are polytypic, transient and usually few, without rouleaux from a monoclonal protein.
LPL shows a spectrum of small lymphocytes, plasmacytoid lymphocytes and plasma cells with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P, rather than a pure plasma cell population.
Reactive lymphocytes have central nuclei and cytoplasm hugging adjacent red cells, without eccentric nuclei, clockface chromatin or a hof.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell leukemia — multiple circulating plasma cells with eccentric clockface nuclei and perinuclear hof, background rouleaux
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指周邊血中核偏位、胞質深藍有 hof 的細胞，問名稱，再問 plasma cell leukemia 的診斷門檻。
IMWG 2021 與 WHO 5th：周邊血 circulating plasma cells ≥ 5% 即定義為 plasma cell leukemia（舊標準為 ≥ 20% 或 > 2 × 10^9/L）。
Flow：CD38+、CD138+、CD19−、cytoplasmic light chain restriction；primary PCL 常 CD56−，t(11;14) 比例較高。
Primary PCL 預後差，易合併 hypercalcemia、腎衰竭、LDH 上升；t(11;14) 族群可考慮 venetoclax。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 reactive lymphocyte 或 LPL：reactive lymphocyte 核居中、胞質包繞紅血球無 hof；LPL 為小淋巴球到漿細胞的連續譜系並多見 MYD88 L265P。

quiz.q: 圖中周邊血出現這些細胞，依現行 IMWG／WHO 5th，佔多少比例即可診斷 plasma cell leukemia？
quiz.a: Circulating plasma cells ≥ 5%

2455.recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片充滿各成熟階段的顆粒球（以骨髓細胞為主，並有後骨髓細胞、帶狀核中性球），右上方可見顆粒粗大深紫的嗜鹼性球與嗜伊紅性前驅細胞，原始細胞少，符合慢性期 CML。
features: Hypercellular aspirate with granulocytic hyperplasia
Myelocytes predominate, with promyelocytes, metamyelocytes and band neutrophils
Basophil with coarse dark purple granules (upper right)
Eosinophilic precursors with orange-pink granules
Rare blasts; erythroid precursors sparse
2455.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is hypercellular and composed predominantly of granulocytic cells at all stages of maturation, with a predominance of myelocytes and numerous metamyelocytes and band forms. Basophils and eosinophil precursors are present, blasts are not increased, and erythroid precursors are sparse. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia in chronic phase; BCR-ABL1 testing by cytogenetics, FISH or RT-PCR is required for confirmation.

ddx.vs: Reactive marrow lacks basophilia and eosinophilia, shows toxic changes, and is BCR-ABL1 negative.
CMML shows prominent monocytes and dysplasia rather than a myelocyte peak with basophilia.
Other MPNs lack the marked myelocyte bulge and basophilia and are driven by JAK2, CALR or MPL rather than BCR-ABL1.

exam.answer_en: CML, chronic phase — hypercellular marrow of maturing granulocytes with myelocyte peak, basophils and eosinophil precursors, few blasts
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指右上方深紫顆粒的 basophil 與橘紅顆粒嗜酸前驅細胞，問這些細胞對診斷的意義 → 支持 CML 而非反應性增生。
CML 骨髓巨核細胞常為小型低分葉的 dwarf megakaryocytes；也可見 pseudo-Gaucher cells 與 sea-blue histiocytes。
分期關鍵是 blast 計數：WHO 5th blast phase 為 blasts ≥ 20%、髓外 blast 增生或周邊血／骨髓出現增加的 lymphoblasts。
預後評分：ELTS score 用於 TKI 年代預測 CML 相關死亡；Sokal score 亦常用。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易與 CMML 或其他 MPN 混淆：CMML 以單核球增多與 dysplasia 為主；PMF／ET 缺乏 myelocyte 高峰與 basophilia，驅動基因為 JAK2／CALR／MPL。

quiz.q: 圖中骨髓以哪個成熟階段的顆粒球為主？伴隨哪些細胞增加支持 CML？
quiz.a: Myelocytes 為主；basophils 與 eosinophils（含前驅細胞）增加

2199.recognize_zh: 抹片中央為一顆有兩團不規則深染核樣結構的單核／組織球樣細胞，左側另有一顆破裂細胞釋出細小顆粒；未能清楚看到弓形蟲新月形速殖體，本圖只能作為可疑寄生物的背景參考。
features: Central mononuclear cell with two irregular, dense nucleus-like masses and pale granular cytoplasm
Small dark inclusion near the top of the central cell's cytoplasm
Adjacent disrupted cell releasing fine granular material
Surrounding monocytoid cells with folded nuclei
Discrete crescent-shaped tachyzoites not clearly resolved
2199.describe_en: Smear at high magnification shows a mononuclear cell containing two irregular, dense nucleus-like masses in pale finely granular cytoplasm, with a small dark cytoplasmic inclusion. An adjacent disrupted cell releases fine granular material, and nearby monocytoid cells have folded nuclei. Although the clustered chromatin-rich material may represent intracellular organisms, discrete crescent-shaped tachyzoites with single central nuclei cannot be confidently identified. The image is suggestive at most of Toxoplasma infection and requires confirmation by serology, PCR or immunostaining.

ddx.vs: A binucleate host cell has two nuclei with regular chromatin and nuclear membranes, whereas tachyzoite clusters form multiple small crescentic bodies each with its own nucleus.
Leishmania amastigotes are small oval bodies with a nucleus plus bar-shaped kinetoplast, absent in Toxoplasma.
Histoplasma yeasts are uniform oval forms with a surrounding halo and are GMS/PAS positive.

2071.recognize_zh: 這是切開的胃大體標本，胃體部黏膜皺褶明顯變粗、扭曲成腦回狀，局部黏膜增厚並有少許出血斑，但沒有明顯的單一潰瘍腫塊；瀰漫性皺褶肥厚是胃 MALT 淋巴瘤可能的大體表現之一，但並不具特異性。
features: Opened gastrectomy specimen photographed on a dark background
Markedly thickened, tortuous, cerebriform rugal folds in the body of the stomach
Diffuse mucosal thickening with focal hemorrhagic discoloration
No discrete ulcerated or fungating mass evident
Findings are gross only and not specific for lymphoma
2071.describe_en: Gross photograph of an opened stomach shows diffusely thickened, convoluted rugal folds with a cerebriform appearance and focal mucosal hemorrhage. No discrete ulcerated or exophytic mass is identified. These gross changes are nonspecific and can be seen in lymphoma, hypertrophic gastropathy or infiltrative carcinoma. In the given context, the findings are compatible with gastric MALT lymphoma, which requires histologic confirmation.

ddx.vs: Ménétrier disease shows foveolar hyperplasia with glandular atrophy on histology and lacks a lymphoid infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Diffuse-type (signet ring) gastric carcinoma, linitis plastica
ddx.vs: Linitis plastica produces a rigid, thickened wall with flattened folds, and histology shows cytokeratin-positive signet ring cells.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma of the stomach
ddx.vs: DLBCL more often forms bulky ulcerated masses, and histology shows sheets of large cells.

1879.recognize_zh: 箭頭指向中性球上方核葉邊緣一個細小、深染的圓形染色質突起，緊貼核葉而無明顯細柄，屬於正常中性球的核附屬物（nuclear appendage）。
features: Mature neutrophil with three to four nuclear lobes and condensed chromatin
Very small, dense round chromatin tag projecting from the edge of a lobe (arrow)
No well-formed head-and-stalk drumstick configuration
Pale cytoplasm with fine neutrophilic granules
Background red cells unremarkable; a platelet nearby
1879.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature segmented neutrophil with condensed chromatin and fine neutrophilic granules. A very small, dense round chromatin tag projects from the margin of one nuclear lobe (arrow) without a defined stalk. No toxic changes or cytoplasmic inclusions are present. Findings represent a small nuclear appendage in a normal neutrophil, a normal morphologic variant.

ddx.vs: A drumstick has a larger (~1.5 µm) round head joined to the lobe by a thin stalk, whereas this tag is smaller and sessile.
Pelger-Huët cells have bilobed spectacle-shaped or round nuclei, whereas this cell has normal lobation with only a tiny chromatin tag.
Ingested material lies free within the cytoplasm, often in a vacuole, rather than being continuous with a nuclear lobe.

1815.recognize_zh: 視野中幾乎全是漿細胞，核偏位、染色質呈粗塊狀（車輪樣），細胞質豐富淡藍並有核周亮區，部分細胞體積大且有雙核，提示成片的腫瘤性漿細胞（多發性骨髓瘤）。
features: Sheets of plasma cells with abundant pale to mid-blue cytoplasm
Eccentric round nuclei with coarse, clumped 'clock-face' chromatin
Distinct perinuclear hofs in many cells
Size variation with large and binucleate plasma cells
Scarce residual hematopoietic cells; fat vacuole at upper left
1815.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows sheets of plasma cells that virtually replace normal marrow elements. The cells have eccentric round nuclei with coarse clumped chromatin, abundant blue cytoplasm and prominent perinuclear hofs. There is variation in cell size, with large and binucleate forms. Findings are consistent with a plasma cell neoplasm such as plasma cell myeloma, pending plasma cell quantitation and demonstration of clonality.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells are mature, polytypic and not arranged in sheets, typically below 10% of marrow cells.
Includes small lymphocytes and plasmacytoid lymphocytes, with IgM paraprotein and MYD88 L265P.
Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters lacking the eccentric nuclei, clock-face chromatin and perinuclear hof.
Cells are immunoblastic with large central nucleoli and high proliferation, often EBER-positive.

exam.answer_en: Plasma cell myeloma — near-total marrow replacement by plasma cells with clock-face chromatin, perinuclear hofs, large and binucleate forms
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指核偏位、有核周亮區的細胞問「這是什麼？」答 plasma cell；核周亮區為 Golgi 區，染色質呈 clock-face。
骨髓幾乎全被取代時，克隆漿細胞比例若 ≥60% 即屬 SLiM 標準，不需 CRAB 也可診斷為需治療的 myeloma。
相關檢查：血清/尿液蛋白電泳與免疫固定、血清 free light chain、β2-microglobulin、LDH（R-ISS 分期），加上全身影像（低劑量 CT、PET-CT 或 MRI）。
抹片旁可見 rouleaux（紅血球錢串）為 M 蛋白間接線索；骨骼 X 光上的 lytic lesion 與破骨活化有關。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為轉移性癌細胞；癌細胞緊密成團、核無偏位、無 clock-face 染色質與核周亮區，且 keratin 陽性、CD138 可能陽性但 κ/λ 無限制。

quiz.q: 圖中漿細胞核旁的淡染區叫什麼？在細胞構造上對應什麼？
quiz.a: Perinuclear hof；對應發達的 Golgi apparatus（製造免疫球蛋白）。

1623.recognize_zh: Giemsa 高倍下可見生發中心的混合細胞：核大、染色質開放並有周邊核仁的中心母細胞（centroblast），核有切跡的中心細胞（centrocyte），以及右上角核大而淡、核膜細薄的濾泡樹突細胞（FDC），細胞大小不一。
features: Large cells with round vesicular nuclei and one to several nucleoli, some abutting the nuclear membrane (centroblasts)
Smaller cells with irregular, cleaved or indented nuclei and scant cytoplasm (centrocytes)
Cell with a large pale oval nucleus, very fine chromatin and thin membrane (follicular dendritic cell) at the upper right
Cell with clear cytoplasm and a pale nucleus at the lower left (macrophage)
Heterogeneous mixture of cell sizes and nuclear shapes
1623.describe_en: Giemsa-stained section at oil-immersion power shows a heterogeneous germinal center population consisting of large centroblasts with vesicular nuclei and membrane-bound nucleoli, admixed smaller centrocytes with cleaved nuclei. A cell with a large pale nucleus and delicate chromatin consistent with a follicular dendritic cell and a macrophage with clear cytoplasm are also present. The mixture of cell types argues against a clonal proliferation. Findings are consistent with a normal reactive germinal center.

ddx.vs: Grade 3 FL shows follicles dominated by sheets of centroblasts (>15/hpf) with few FDCs and macrophages, and is often BCL2/CD10 positive with loss of polarization.
DLBCL shows diffuse sheets of large atypical cells effacing architecture, whereas this field shows a mixed centroblast-centrocyte-FDC population.
Burkitt cells are monotonous medium-sized cells with multiple small nucleoli and deeply basophilic vacuolated cytoplasm, unlike this heterogeneous population.

1431.recognize_zh: 高倍骨髓切片中，箭頭指出一個體積小、只有單一圓形核和少量粉紅色胞質的巨核細胞（micromegakaryocyte / hypolobated megakaryocyte），其大小接近周圍前驅細胞，與正常多分葉的大型巨核細胞明顯不同，代表巨核細胞系異常增生。
features: Arrowed small megakaryocyte with a single round, non-lobated nucleus with coarse chromatin and a small nucleolus
Modest eosinophilic cytoplasm tapering into an elongated tail
Megakaryocyte size approaching that of surrounding myeloid precursors
Background of erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei and granulocytic precursors
Adjacent fat space; no blast sheets in this field
1431.describe_en: High-power bone marrow biopsy section shows a small megakaryocyte, indicated by the arrow, with a single round non-lobated nucleus and a modest amount of eosinophilic cytoplasm, approaching the size of the surrounding precursor cells. The background contains erythroid and granulocytic precursors without sheets of blasts in this field. This megakaryocyte represents a dysplastic hypolobated or micromegakaryocytic form. In conjunction with dysplasia in other lineages and fewer than 5% blasts, findings are consistent with myelodysplastic neoplasm with multilineage dysplasia.

ddx.vs: del(5q) megakaryocytes are usually normal-sized with round monolobated nuclei and require karyotype for distinction.
Immature megakaryocytes are few, have deeply basophilic cytoplasm and occur with normal lobated forms, whereas dysplastic forms have mature cytoplasm with an abnormal nucleus.
AMKL shows sheets of megakaryoblasts with at least 20% blasts, CD41/CD61 positivity and often fibrosis, not isolated small megakaryocytes.

60311.recognize_zh: 視野中散在數顆一端圓鈍、另一端拉長成單一尾巴的淚滴狀紅血球（dacrocytes），尾巴方向各不相同，而非全部朝同一方向，較支持真正的淚滴細胞而非推片假影。
features: Several red cells tapering to a single elongated tail at one end (teardrop cells/dacrocytes)
Tails point in different directions, favoring true dacrocytes over spreading artifact
Background red cells are mostly round with mild anisocytosis
Occasional small dense cells lacking central pallor
No leukocytes, nucleated red cells or inclusions in this field
60311.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows red cells with mild anisopoikilocytosis. Scattered teardrop-shaped cells are present, each with a rounded body tapering to a single tail, and the tails are randomly oriented. Occasional small dense cells are also noted. No nucleated red cells or immature myeloid cells are seen in this field. Findings are consistent with dacrocytes, which should prompt evaluation for marrow infiltration or fibrosis (a leukoerythroblastic picture), extramedullary hematopoiesis, thalassemia or megaloblastic anemia.

ddx.vs: Artifactual teardrops have very sharp tails all pointing in the same direction, whereas these tails are blunt and randomly oriented.
Sickle cells taper at both ends into a crescent, whereas dacrocytes have one rounded end and one tail.
Schistocytes are fragments with straight cut edges and sharp corners rather than intact cells with a single tapering tail.
Elliptocytes are symmetric ovals with both ends rounded, without a single drawn-out tail.

exam.answer_en: Dacrocytes (teardrop cells) — red cells with a rounded body tapering to a single randomly oriented tail
pearls_zh: 考法：考官指淚滴狀紅血球問名稱，並追問「尾巴方向一致代表什麼？」方向一致多為推片假影，方向隨機才是真的。
機轉：紅血球擠過纖維化或被浸潤的骨髓、或經脾臟時被拉扯變形。
大量 dacrocytes 合併 leukoerythroblastosis（nucleated RBC、immature granulocytes）要想到 primary myelofibrosis 或骨髓轉移癌浸潤；骨髓抽吸常 dry tap，需做 biopsy 與 reticulin 染色。
PMF driver mutations：JAK2 V617F、CALR、MPL；三者皆陰性為 triple-negative，預後較差。
其他原因：thalassemia、megaloblastic anemia、extramedullary hematopoiesis。
exam.pitfall_zh: 最常與推片假影混淆：假影的尾巴都朝同一方向且常很尖；也要與 sickle cell 區分，sickle 為兩端皆尖的新月形，dacrocyte 只有單一尾巴。

quiz.q: 血片大量淚滴細胞且骨髓抽吸 dry tap，下一步應做什麼檢查？
quiz.a: Bone marrow biopsy（含 reticulin 染色），並送 JAK2/CALR/MPL 突變檢測

87.recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中紅血球普遍比旁邊小淋巴球的核還小（小球性），可見少數靶形細胞（target cell）、橢圓與淚滴狀紅血球，但貧血輕微；HPLC 圖上 HbA2 峰（3.68 分）明顯升高、HbF 略升高，另有 4.53 分處的 HbA2′ 變異峰，計算總 HbA2 時需將兩者相加，符合 β 型地中海貧血帶因者。
features: Red cells are uniformly small (microcytic), most smaller than the nucleus of the adjacent small lymphocyte, with preserved to mildly increased central pallor
Scattered target cells and occasional stomatocyte-like cells with a slit-like central pallor
Mild poikilocytosis with ovalocytes and occasional teardrop or tapered forms; no schistocytes or basophilic stippling evident at this magnification
Normal-appearing small lymphocyte and scattered platelets

HPLC chromatogram: dominant HbA0 peak (2.48 min), increased shaded HbA2 peak (3.68 min), small HbF peak (1.11 min) and an additional sharp peak at 4.53 min consistent with the HbA2-prime (delta-chain) variant
87.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a microcytic red cell population with mild anisopoikilocytosis, including scattered target cells, ovalocytes and occasional teardrop forms; a small lymphocyte provides a size reference. White cells and platelets appear unremarkable in these fields. Cation-exchange HPLC shows a predominant HbA0 peak with an increased HbA2 fraction (3.68 min) and mildly increased HbF (1.11 min), plus a separate peak at 4.53 min representing the HbA2-prime delta-chain variant, which must be added to HbA2 to avoid underestimating total HbA2 (total about 6% in this case). Together with the elevated RBC count and low MCV/MCH, findings are consistent with beta-thalassemia trait.

ddx.vs: Iron deficiency also causes microcytosis and pencil cells but has a low or normal RBC count, low ferritin and normal or reduced HbA2, unlike the high RBC count and elevated HbA2 here.
Alpha-thalassemia trait has a similar smear and high RBC count but a normal or low HbA2 on HPLC, requiring alpha-globin gene deletion testing for confirmation.
HbE co-elutes in the HbA2 window on cation-exchange HPLC and gives a much larger peak (typically about 25-30%), whereas true beta-thalassemia trait shows HbA2 of about 3.5-8%.
An HbS peak also elutes near the 4.5-min window but typically makes up about 35-40% of total hemoglobin, whereas the HbA2-prime peak is small (roughly 1-2%) and is paired with HbA2.

captions: Peripheral blood smear: microcytic red cells with scattered target cells beside a small lymphocyte
Peripheral blood smear: microcytes with target cells, ovalocytes and occasional teardrop forms
HPLC: increased HbA2 (3.68 min), mildly increased HbF, and a separate HbA2-prime variant peak at 4.53 min

exam.answer_en: Beta-thalassemia trait — microcytic RBCs with target cells and mild anemia; HPLC shows raised HbA2 (plus HbA2-prime variant peak to be added)
pearls_zh: 考法：HPLC 圖考官會指 3.68 分的 HbA2 峰與 4.53 分的 HbA2′ 峰，問總 HbA2 如何計算——兩者須相加，否則低估而漏診帶因者。
HbA2 >3.5% 是 β-thal trait 的篩檢依據；Mentzer index（MCV/RBC）<13、RBC 數偏高、RDW 常正常，支持海洋性貧血而非缺鐵。
合併缺鐵會壓低 HbA2，可能遮蔽 β-thal trait，需補鐵後複驗。
HbE 在 cation-exchange HPLC 與 HbA2 同一窗口洗出，HbA2 值若明顯高（如 >10%）要懷疑 HbE。
遺傳諮詢：配偶也需篩檢，夫妻皆為 β-thal 帶因者時胎兒有 1/4 機率為重型。
exam.pitfall_zh: 小球性靶形細胞常被當成缺鐵性貧血：缺鐵為 RBC 數低、RDW 高、ferritin 低、HbA2 不升；α-thal trait 則 HbA2 正常，需分子檢測。

quiz.q: HPLC 同時出現 HbA2 與 HbA2′ 峰時，總 HbA2 應如何計算？
quiz.a: 兩峰百分比相加

23.recognize_zh: 血球抹片只見非特異的正球性貧血、血小板少，骨髓則為紅血球系增生（網狀紅血球升高代表溶血性代償）；真正確立診斷的是流式細胞儀：顆粒球有超過 85% 同時失去 FLAER 與 CD55/CD59（GPI 錨定蛋白），代表大型 PNH 克隆。
features: PB: normocytic red cells with mild anisocytosis, occasional polychromatophilic cells, marked reduction of platelets and leukocytes; no schistocytes or spherocytes prominent
BM aspirate: erythroid hyperplasia with erythroid precursors at all stages of maturation, a mitotic figure, and occasional nuclear budding; blasts not increased
BM core: mildly hypercellular marrow with erythroid predominance and decreased megakaryocytes and myeloid precursors
Flow cytometry: granulocytes gated on SSC vs CD15 show a dominant population (85.83%) negative for FLAER and CD55/CD59, with a residual normal population (12.79%)
23.describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic anemia with occasional polychromatophilic red cells, leukopenia and thrombocytopenia, without significant schistocytes. The bone marrow aspirate and core biopsy show a mildly hypercellular marrow with erythroid hyperplasia and occasional nuclear budding, decreased megakaryocytes and myeloid precursors, and no increase in blasts or CD34-positive cells. High-sensitivity flow cytometry of peripheral blood granulocytes demonstrates loss of FLAER binding and CD55/CD59 expression in approximately 86% of granulocytes. Findings are consistent with paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria with a large PNH clone; morphology alone is nonspecific and the diagnosis rests on the flow cytometric result.

ddx.vs: The marrow is markedly hypocellular with fatty replacement rather than erythroid hyperplasia, although small PNH clones may coexist and must be sought by FLAER flow.
Shows significant multilineage dysplasia, ring sideroblasts or clonal cytogenetic abnormalities, and GPI-anchored proteins are retained on granulocytes.
Spherocytes and a positive direct antiglobulin test are present, with normal FLAER and CD55/CD59 expression.
Erythroid precursors show nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony with open chromatin, and blood shows macro-ovalocytes and hypersegmented neutrophils.

captions: Peripheral blood: normocytic anemia with leukopenia and thrombocytopenia
Marrow aspirate: erythroid hyperplasia with occasional nuclear budding
Core biopsy: mildly hypercellular marrow with erythroid hyperplasia and decreased megakaryocytes
Flow cytometry: 85.83% of granulocytes lack FLAER and CD55/CD59, a large PNH clone

exam.answer_en: Paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria — nonspecific cytopenias with erythroid hyperplasia; flow shows ~86% granulocytes lacking FLAER and CD55/CD59 (large PNH clone)
pearls_zh: 考法：流式圖考官會問 FLAER 與 CD59 雙陰性族群代表什麼——GPI 錨定蛋白缺失的 PNH 克隆，並問為何以顆粒球而非紅血球定克隆大小。
機轉：造血幹細胞 PIGA 後天突變致 GPI 錨缺失，失去 CD55/CD59 補體調節，造成補體媒介血管內溶血；DAT 陰性。
FLAER 直接結合 GPI 錨，最適合用於顆粒球與單核球；紅血球受輸血與溶血影響，會低估克隆大小。
臨床三聯：溶血、血栓（如 Budd-Chiari）、骨髓衰竭；常與再生不良性貧血共存。
治療：C5 抑制劑 eculizumab、ravulizumab；近端補體抑制劑如 pegcetacoplan、iptacopan；使用前需接種腦膜炎雙球菌疫苗。
exam.pitfall_zh: 血液與骨髓形態無特異性，易被當成再生不良性貧血或 MDS 而漏診；溶血且 DAT 陰性、LDH 高、血栓時應安排高敏感度流式 PNH 檢測。

quiz.q: 流式中顆粒球 失去 FLAER 結合與 CD55/CD59 表現，代表哪個基因突變造成的缺陷？
quiz.a: PIGA 突變致 GPI 錨定蛋白缺失（PNH）

62039.recognize_zh: 高倍免疫染色（紅色呈色，標記未註明）中，箭頭指向數顆大型、核呈淡染泡狀且輪廓不規則分葉的 LP 細胞（爆米花細胞），它們在這個標記為陰性；視野中只有一顆大型細胞呈強陽性，背景淋巴球也多為陰性，須對照同病例其他染色才能判讀。
features: Large atypical cells (arrows) with vesicular, pale, lobulated or folded nuclei and small nucleoli, consistent with LP (popcorn) cells
Arrowed LP cells negative for the illustrated red-chromogen marker
Single large cell with strong red membranous/cytoplasmic positivity (upper center)
Background of numerous small to medium lymphoid cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, largely negative
Marker identity not labeled on the image, limiting interpretation
62039.describe_en: High-power immunohistochemical stain with a red chromogen (marker not specified on the image) shows a dense lymphoid background containing several large atypical cells with vesicular, lobulated nuclei (arrows), morphologically consistent with lymphocyte-predominant (LP) cells. The LP cells are negative for this marker, while a single large cell elsewhere in the field is strongly positive and the small background lymphocytes are largely negative. Because the marker is not identified, the stain is best interpreted as a negative result in LP cells (for example, CD30 or CD15 negativity, which would argue against classic Hodgkin lymphoma) and must be correlated with the full panel. Findings are consistent with nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma in the reported context of variant patterns with progression.

ddx.vs: Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells are CD30+/CD15+ with weak PAX5 and loss of OCT2/BOB1, whereas LP cells are CD30/CD15-negative and strongly CD20/OCT2/BOB1-positive.

THRLBCL has scattered large B cells in a diffuse T-cell and histiocyte background without residual small B-cell nodules or FDC meshworks, which mirrors NLPHL pattern E and requires the full architectural panel.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma arising from NLPHL
ddx.vs: Transformation is recognized when large B cells form confluent sheets rather than scattered single LP cells as seen here.
PTGC lacks LP cells and shows fragmented CD10+/BCL6+ germinal center remnants within enlarged nodules.

3095.recognize_zh: 數顆大型細胞核偏位、呈圓至腎形，染色質稍凝集，細胞質豐富且滿布粗大的紫紅色嗜天青顆粒（azurophilic granules），部分核旁有淡染的高基氏區（hof）；這是正常的前骨髓細胞（promyelocyte）。
features: Large cells, larger than myeloblasts, with moderate N:C ratio
Round to oval or slightly indented, eccentric nuclei
Moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous at this focus
Abundant basophilic cytoplasm filled with coarse purple-red azurophilic (primary) granules overlying the nucleus
Paranuclear pale Golgi zone (hof) visible in some cells; no Auer rods
3095.describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cluster of large myeloid cells with eccentric round to slightly indented nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin, and abundant basophilic cytoplasm containing numerous coarse azurophilic granules that overlie the nucleus. A pale perinuclear Golgi zone is evident in some cells. Auer rods and bilobed nuclei are absent. These are normal promyelocytes, the stage after the myeloblast and before the myelocyte.

ddx.dx: Abnormal promyelocyte of acute promyelocytic leukemia
ddx.vs: APL cells have bilobed/folded nuclei, very dense or dust-like granules, and faggot cells with bundles of Auer rods, lacking the orderly Golgi hof.
Myelocytes are smaller with more condensed chromatin, pinker cytoplasm with fine secondary granules, and fewer primary granules.
Seen in mature segmented neutrophils with condensed lobulated nuclei, not in large immature cells.
These also have an eccentric nucleus and hof but have agranular deep blue cytoplasm and clock-face chromatin (plasma cell).

exam.answer_en: Normal promyelocytes — large cells with eccentric nuclei, perinuclear Golgi hof and abundant coarse azurophilic granules
pearls_zh: 考法：辨認顆粒球成熟序列：myeloblast → promyelocyte（primary azurophilic 顆粒、hof）→ myelocyte（出現 secondary 顆粒、胞質轉淡）。
Primary 顆粒含 MPO，promyelocyte 是 MPO 強陽性的階段。
APL 異常 promyelocyte：核雙葉或腎形、顆粒極多或 hypogranular、faggot cells；t(15;17) PML::RARA，常合併 DIC，屬急症。
正常骨髓中 promyelocyte 與其他各階段顆粒球混雜、呈有序成熟，而非單一族群堆積。
exam.pitfall_zh: 易誤認為 APL 異常前骨髓細胞；正常 promyelocyte 核圓偏位、有 Golgi hof、無成束 Auer rods，且與各成熟階段混雜。

quiz.q: Promyelocyte 與 myelocyte 最關鍵的區分特徵？
quiz.a: Myelocyte 出現 secondary (specific) 顆粒、胞質轉淡；promyelocyte 以 primary azurophilic 顆粒為主並有 hof
